- The AGEFIPH/FIPHFP wording is imprecise rather than fabricated: both bodies fund workplace-adaptation equipment for workers with a recognised disability, case by case.

Occupational search results
- Generic TMS queries ('sac à dos TMS travail', 'exosquelette passif prévention TMS') return only institutional sources: INRS, OSHA, DREETS, CRAMIF, FFB, INSPQ. A brand page will rarely rank there, so a vendor guide is an opportunity, not a defect.
- A zero result for a query combining 'Gravipack' with TMS terms is an artefact of the search tool, since the product pages do contain that wording.
- OPPBTP's preventionbtp.fr 'solutions' sheet ranks #7 for 'sac à dos porte-outils', near the Gravipack outillage hub at #9.

B2B search demand has not been quantified (no volume data), hence Medium.

Why it matters: B2B buyers (HSE managers, médecins du travail, CSE members, buyers in collectivités, maintenance managers) search for a job to be done: équiper des agents terrain, prévenir les TMS liés au port de charge, cadeaux CSE personnalisés, achats publics. They expect a page that presents the offer, the proof, the process and a way to request a quote.

Today that information is scattered across consumer product sheets, news posts and 'products' that are really services. As a result, no URL can rank for those queries, collect B2B links (RATP, OPPBTP, trade media) or convert visitors through a clear path.

The claims that would be reused for B2B (TMS prevention, prescription, funding) are YMYL-adjacent. They must be accurate before they are concentrated on a hub.

Effect on SEO: A hub-and-spoke /entreprises/ section would:
- create indexable landing pages for B2B intent;
- consolidate the quote-page signals onto one URL;
- give PR and case studies a link target;
- remove thin service and payment 'products' from the product index and the Merchant Center feed.

Consistent, sourced facts on one page also give buyers and AI answers a single version to cite.

Impact 5/10 · Effort Medium · Confidence likely
findings.recommendation: 1. Verify before publishing anything. This is a gate: - the '120 clients B2B/B2G' figure; - named clients and institutions, with written permission to cite them (this includes the SNCF logo on the key-ring product); - the prescription wording and the funding wording; - the RATP numbers (the owned '250 agents' vs RATP's ~50 at VivaTech 2023). Remove or reword anything that cannot be documented. 2. Build /entreprises/ as a parent WordPress page, with spokes only where there is a real offer and proof. Start with the hub and two spokes, then add more: - /entreprises/maintenance-outillage/ (ToolMaster, Light Promax, ExoTool; the RATP case) - /entreprises/sacs-personnalises/ (the 'fabrication professionnelle' offer, CSE gifts and logo key rings, with MOQ, lead times, mock-up and quote) - later: /entreprises/secours-sante/, /entreprises/defense-securite/, /entreprises/collectivites/ (Centurion, the public-procurement process) and a prévention-TMS guide. Suggested titles: 'Sacs à dos à exosquelette pour les entreprises | Gravipack' (58) and 'Sacs à dos personnalisés pour entreprises | Gravipack' (53). H1 example: « Équiper vos équipes terrain de sacs à dos à exosquelette ». Content for the hub and spokes: - use cases; - proof: case studies with numbers and the client's permission; - the process: prêt d'essai, devis, déploiement, formation au réglage; - the pricing model ('tarifs dégressifs à partir de [X] unités'); - a downloadable spec sheet and the quote form. 3. Funding wording: reword it and add sources; do not delete it. Suggested wording: « Selon votre situation, l'équipement peut être éligible à une aide de l'AGEFIPH (secteur privé) ou du FIPHFP (fonction publique) dans le cadre d'un aménagement de poste pour un salarié reconnu travailleur handicapé, après étude du dossier par l'organisme. » Link to each agency's aid page, and use the same wording on the product sheets. 4. Keep one quote URL. - Compare the two forms and keep one (/devis/ or /entreprises/devis/). - 301 the other, with the Redirection plugin or in .htaccess: RewriteRule ^devis-gravipack/?$ https://gravipack.com/devis/ [R=301,L] - Update menus and CTAs. - Track submissions as a GA4 key event (generate_lead). 5. Take the services out of the product catalogue. - Rebuild 'fabrication professionnelle' as the /entreprises/sacs-personnalises/ page, and 301 /produit/fabrication-professionnelle-gravipack/ to it. - Payment-link product: set Catalogue visibility to 'Caché' (Publish box) and set it to noindex. In Yoast: Advanced → 'Allow search engines to show this Product in search results?' = No. In Rank Math: Advanced → Robots Meta → No Index. This also removes it from the plugin sitemap. Exclude it from the Merchant Center feed. - SNCF key ring: if it is client-specific, hide and noindex it, or 301 it to the personalisation page. Keep one generic custom-logo key ring with a single MOQ. 6. Structured data. - BreadcrumbList on the hub and the spokes. - Service on the personalisation spoke. This is entity markup only; it produces no rich result. {"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Service","name":"Sacs à dos à exosquelette personnalisés pour entreprises","serviceType":"Personnalisation de sacs à dos et accessoires (logo, couleurs)","provider":{"@id":"https://gravipack.com/#organization"},"areaServed":{"@type":"Country","name":"France"},"audience":{"@type":"BusinessAudience","audienceType":"Entreprises, CSE, collectivités"},"url":"https://gravipack.com/entreprises/sacs-personnalises/"} - Use the canonical host chosen in the host fix, and make the @id match the Organization node that the SEO plugin outputs. 7. Internal links. - Add 'Entreprises' to the main menu and the footer. - Add a block « Équiper vos équipes ? Demandez un devis » on the outillage, médical, militaire and claie categories. - Link the RATP, VivaTech and SOFINS posts to the matching spoke. 8. Prévention-TMS guide (/entreprises/prevention-tms-port-de-charge/). - Follow the INRS framing: collective prevention comes first and the backpack is a complement; cover risk assessment, field trial, training and limits. - Use the RATP deployment as the real case. - Have an ergonomist or a médecin du travail review the guide, and name the reviewer. - Avoid 'anti-douleur' and other medical claims. Expect little ranking against INRS and OSHA; the value lies in sales enablement, links and AI citations. FAQ content on these pages serves readers only; there is no FAQ rich result. 9. OPPBTP: submit a documented field case, with the client's agreement, to the preventionbtp.fr 'Solutions' database. That database publishes company field cases, so this works better than pitching vendor guides. 10. Fix the conflicting facts: one MOQ per product, and one capacity range per model family once the Techterre and SOFINS context has been checked.

findings.title: #44 Product slugs are very long and keyword-stuffed, and some contain typos or '-copie' leftovers
findings.description:
Confirmed from the URLs themselves, as they were indexed in the search results we sampled.

Length
- 30 of 39 product URLs exceed 100 characters (median 110).
- Longest: City, 205 characters: /produit/anti-mal-de-dos-certainement-le-meilleur-sac-au-monde-pour-le-travail-et-le-velo-sac-a-dos-ordinateur-city-avec-exosquelette-gravipack-anti-mal-de-dos-elegance-et-confort/ ('anti-mal-de-dos' twice, plus a superlative).
- Compostelle 80 L, 196 characters: /produit/sac-a-dos-randonnee-80l-revolutionnaire-anti-mal-de-dos-pas-cher-gravipack-compostelle-80l-ergonomie-eva-haute-performance-bretelles-memoire-de-forme-adaptatives/.
- Hiking Terracotta: 161 characters (…revolutionnaire…).
- Category slugs run 90-151 characters (the randonnée hub is 151).

Repetition
- 37 slugs contain 'anti-mal-de-dos'.
- Sherpa orange repeats a word: '…-sherpa-45l-orange-anti-mal-de-dos-orange-…'.

Typos
- 'sac-randonner-leger' (Easy Travel, Helsinki).
- 'oganizer' (/produit/porte-outils-elastique-amovible-velcro-oganizer-gravipack/).
- 'hikking33' (presta).
- 'assault' (militaire category slug).
- The post /un-sac-a-dos-pas-comme-les-autresvos-enfants-vont-adorer/, whose title is 'Un sac à dos pas comme les autres… les épaules de vos enfants vont adorer'. The title was edited after the slug was generated.

Leftovers from duplicated products
- '-copie' on Compostelle 65 L (…memoire-de-forme-copie/) and on the solar battery (…boussole-infinity-gravipack-copie/).

Claim words in URLs
- 'pas-cher' and 'revolutionnaire' (Compostelle 80 L).
- 'certainement-le-meilleur-sac-au-monde' (City).
- 'la-seule-au-monde' (Tokyo: /produit/sac-a-dos-innovant-utilise-la-technologie-gravipack-la-seule-au-monde-pour-reduire-efficacement-le-poids-sur-le-dos/). This slug also lacks the model name.
- Light Promax ('…outillage-parcours-gravipack/') also lacks the model name.
- A news index sits at /actualites-gravipack-2/.

Needs a live check (seen in snippets only)
- /sac-a-dos-hiking-30l-gris-…/ is used for a bag described as 33 L.
- /fourreau-de-portage-exosquelette-gravitech-…/ is used for a product titled 'Claie de portage…' and named Barracuda.

Why Low: words in the URL are a minor ranking signal, and every slug change needs a 301, so a mass rename would cost more than it brings. Tokyo, for example, already ranks for two of the queries we tested despite its slug.

Why it matters: Short, descriptive slugs are easier to read, share and cite. Very long slugs get cut off in breadcrumb and URL displays and in shared links, and the repeated 'anti-mal-de-dos' adds to the site-wide keyword repetition.

Superlatives in the URL ('le meilleur sac au monde', 'la seule au monde') put unsubstantiated claims in a field that is copied everywhere and cannot be edited later without a redirect.

'-copie' slugs show products that were duplicated in the back office and may still be live as duplicates.

Effect on SEO: The direct effect on relevance and CTR is small. The real risk lies in the fix: renaming indexed URLs without exact 301s causes 404s and loses link equity, and stacking renames on top of the presta redirects creates redirect chains.

If slugs are changed only where a merge or a claim fix is needed anyway, the result is cleaner URLs and fewer claim words in the address bar, with negligible risk.

Impact 2/10 · Effort Low · Confidence confirmed
findings.recommendation: 1. No mass rename. Add slug changes to the single URL migration map shared with the duplicate-product, presta-redirect, host and category fixes, and ship them in one release. The map is a spreadsheet with these columns: old URL → new URL → reason → has backlinks? → date. 2. Change a slug only in one of these cases: a. Two URLs are being merged. This includes the '-copie' products: check whether the '-copie' Compostelle 65 L and battery duplicate an original product, and if so keep one product and 301 the other. b. The slug contains a typo. c. The slug contains a claim that the claims review removes: City 'certainement-le-meilleur-sac-au-monde', Tokyo 'la-seule-au-monde', Compostelle 80 L 'pas-cher' / 'revolutionnaire'. Accept a few weeks of fluctuation on City and Tokyo if the claims review requires the change. 3. Pattern for new and changed slugs: /produit/<modele>-<contenance>[-<couleur>]/, about 5 words at most, no 'anti-mal-de-dos', no superlatives. Examples: /produit/sherpa-45l-orange/, /produit/compostelle-80l/, /produit/compostelle-65l/, /produit/tokyo/, /produit/city/, /produit/porte-outils-elastique-organizer/, /produit/sac-randonnee-easy-travel/, /produit/helsinki-60-10l/. Set the slug by hand when creating a product (product edit screen → Permalien → Modifier). 4. Redirects. WordPress stores the old slug, and wp_old_slug_redirect() normally 301s renamed posts and products. Add explicit rules anyway as a safeguard, because they survive later edits. - Easiest: the Redirection plugin or Rank Math → Redirections (301, exact match). - Or in .htaccess, above the WordPress block: RewriteEngine On RewriteRule ^produit/anti-mal-de-dos-certainement-le-meilleur-sac-au-monde-pour-le-travail-et-le-velo-sac-a-dos-ordinateur-city-avec-exosquelette-gravipack-anti-mal-de-dos-elegance-et-confort/?$ https://gravipack.com/produit/city/ [R=301,L] - Or in Nginx: location = /produit/<ancien-slug>/ { return 301 https://gravipack.com/produit/<nouveau-slug>/; } - Point every target at the canonical host chosen in the host-consolidation fix (apex or www). 5. No chains. Legacy presta URLs must redirect straight to the final URL (presta → new slug), never presta → old slug → new slug. Check with Screaming Frog (Reports → Redirects → Redirect Chains) or curl -sIL. 6. Update everything that links to the old URLs: - internal links in menus, category descriptions and posts (Better Search Replace on wp_posts.post_content, after a full backup); - the XML sitemap (Yoast and Rank Math regenerate it automatically); - the Merchant Center feed; - partner and press links: ask ergo-corner and the press to update links to renamed URLs. 7. Do not touch the slugs of URLs that rank or earn links unless the 301 is live at the same moment. - Leave the parent category slug 'tous-les-sacs-a-dos-exosquelette' unchanged. WooCommerce category URLs are hierarchical, so renaming the parent changes about 12 child URLs. - Leave the outillage category slug unchanged; it ranks. 8. Backlog only: - The 'autresvos' post slug: negligible gain. If it is touched, use /sac-a-dos-enfant-pas-comme-les-autres/ with a 301. - The 'assault' category slug: fix the title now, and change the slug only in the migration release. 9. Confirm the content mismatches on the live pages (Hiking '30l' vs 33 L; Gravitech/fourreau vs Barracuda/claie), and correct the product name and copy first. Change the slug only if the page is being merged or renamed anyway.

findings.title: #45 Some snippets show mini-cart text ('0 items - 0,00 €'), so meta descriptions need checking (verify on-site)
findings.description:
A search summary recorded during the audit noted that snippets for gravipack.com product, legal and CGV results (e.g. Oslo Rouge, /mentions-legales/, /conditions-generales-de-vente/) often showed the empty mini-cart text '0 items - 0,00 €'. Presta pages showed similar cart-widget text. The snippet text itself was not saved, so the observation cannot be re-checked.

These snippets were produced by a non-Google engine. Google writes its own snippet from page content in most cases, even when a meta description exists, so cart text in a snippet does not prove that meta descriptions are missing. It does suggest that the mini-cart markup sits early in the page text, where any search engine or AI crawler may pick it up.

The meta description tags could not be inspected, because the site could not be fetched. Status: verify on-site.

Why it matters: The snippet under the title is the second line of the 'ad' that every organic result shows. A page with a useful meta description gives the engine a better candidate than '0 items - 0,00 €', especially if boilerplate is also kept out of the snippet. The claude-seo gate is 120-160 characters, unique, and written for that page.

Effect on SEO: CTR only, and uncertain; there is no ranking effect. If descriptions are missing and boilerplate is being used, fixing both should improve snippet quality on product and category results. If descriptions already exist, the fix is limited to the mini-cart.

Impact 2/10 · Effort Low · Confidence needs-on-site-check
findings.recommendation:
1. Check first. - View-source on the home page, three product pages and two categories. - Check the plugin templates. Yoast: Settings → Content types → Products / Categories & tags → Meta description. Rank Math: Titles & Meta → Products / Product categories → Description. 2. If descriptions are missing or generic, write unique ones (120-160 characters) for the home page, the hub, the 10 segment categories and the top 20 products by impressions. - Elsewhere, use the product short description as a fallback (Rank Math variable %wc_shortdesc%; Yoast %%excerpt%%). - Keep unverified facts in brackets and avoid health claims. Example (140 characters): « Sherpa 45 L : sac de randonnée Gravipack à exosquelette breveté qui répartit la charge sur le dos. Bretelles [M à XXL], livraison en France. » 3. Keep the mini-cart out of snippets. - Add data-nosnippet to its wrapper in the child-theme header, e.g.
…
. Google honours data-nosnippet on div, span and section elements. - Make sure the cart widget is not the first text inside
. 4. Four weeks later, re-check the snippets on google.fr for 10 URLs. Google may still rewrite them, so judge by CTR rather than by exact wording.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Genuine inventor-founder with a documented invention story (Concours Lépine silver 2018, INPI Trophées 2022 finalist)
An FAQ and blog/press section already exist
Real institutional use case (RATP, ~50 maintenance workers, VivaTech 2023)

findings.title: #1 The '-92 %' claim rests on a 2019 Lyon study with no public primary document and no citable evidence page on the main site, while forum doubts about it rank
findings.recommendation: 1. Go back to the source. - Retrieve the 2019 document. - Ask the biomechanics LBMC (Université Gustave Eiffel / Lyon 1) for written permission to name it and to publish it or a summary. - Establish exactly what was measured (for example, peak pressure under the strap at the trapezius), on how many subjects, with what load and in what conditions. 2. Decide: - If it can be published, create the evidence page on the canonical host, e.g. /etude-biomecanique-gravipack/ (a WordPress Page). - If not, stop using the figure, or limit it to what can be shown, and commission a new test (step 7). 3. Evidence page content: - H1: « Étude biomécanique Gravipack : ce que mesure le chiffre de 92 % ». - Answer-first paragraph, filled in only from the document: « Le sac ne devient pas plus léger : la charge totale reste la même. Le chiffre de 92 % correspond à [la baisse de la pression mesurée sous les bretelles, au niveau des trapèzes], mesurée en [2019] par [unité, laboratoire] sur [n] participants portant [x] kg [à l'arrêt / en marche]. Il s'agit d'une étude [exploratoire], non publiée dans une revue à comité de lecture. » - A methodology table: laboratory and unit, authors and roles, date, sample size, load, protocol, sensors, measured variable, result with spread, limitations, funding and conflicts of interest. Add the PDF if permitted. - A section « Ce que l'étude ne montre pas » (no clinical outcome on back pain). - A 'Statut réglementaire' paragraph, based on the route chosen in health-claims-wording. - A 'Relu par [Nom, titre]' box, disclosing any payment, and 'Mis à jour le'. 4. Migrate and redirect the legacy page. - Review the presta page and move any useful content. - Then 301 it to the new URL as part of the presta migration map, never to the home page. On the presta vhost: ``` RewriteEngine On RewriteCond %{HTTP_HOST} ^presta\.gravipack\.com$ [NC] RewriteRule ^40-etude-scientifique-soulage-le-dos-gravipack/?$ https://[hote-canonique]/etude-biomecanique-gravipack/ [R=301,L] ``` 5. Use one harmonised claim, and only if the study measured strap pressure: - Claim: « Jusqu'à 92 % de pression en moins mesurée sous les bretelles* ». - Footnote: « *Étude [laboratoire], [année], [n] sujets, charge de [x] kg, [conditions] — voir l'étude. La charge totale n'est pas réduite : elle est répartie différemment. » - Titles cannot carry a footnote, so take 92 % out of titles (school category, /inventeur-dun-sac-a-dos-en-apesanteur/) and keep it in body copy with the footnote. - Store the footnote as a WordPress synced pattern so every page uses the same text. - Rewrite the FAQ answer, e.g.: « Non, le sac ne devient pas plus léger. L'exosquelette répartit la charge différemment : lors d'un test en laboratoire, la pression mesurée sous les bretelles a baissé jusqu'à 92 % (voir l'étude). » 6. Align the other surfaces: - Decathlon (Kid'abord's listings and the brand's own seller account), Nature & Découvertes, Fnac, Kiabi, Au Vieux Campeur, Ergo-Corner and the other reseller pages; - INPI's Trophées profile (request an update); - news updates on the 4 KissKissBankBank campaigns; - the YouTube channel description: remove 'scientific and medical study' until the document is public. 7. Commission an independent test from a biomechanics or sports-science (STAPS) lab, with a pre-registered protocol: pressure mapping at the shoulders and lumbar load, n ≥ 20, against a conventional bag with a hip belt. Publish the result whatever it shows. 8. Name a reviewer. A masseur-kinésithérapeute DE or an ergonomist reviews the evidence page and the guides as a disclosed reviewer, not as a product endorser (CSP R.4127-20; the Transparence Santé rules apply if the medical-device route is taken). 9. Respond once on the brand results. When the page is live, post one disclosed reply as the brand in the randonner-leger and bushwalk threads, stating what was measured and linking to the page. Do not argue about the allegations. 10. Add markup as entity context only; it earns no rich result. Add Dataset markup only if real data can be downloaded. ```json {"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"WebPage","@id":"https://[hote-canonique]/etude-biomecanique-gravipack/#webpage","name":"Étude biomécanique Gravipack : ce que mesure le chiffre de 92 %","lastReviewed":"[AAAA-MM-JJ]","reviewedBy":{"@type":"Person","name":"[Nom]","jobTitle":"[Ergonome]"},"citation":{"@type":"Report","name":"[Titre du rapport]","author":{"@type":"Organization","name":"[Unité, laboratoire]"},"datePublished":"2019"}} ``` 11. Link the page from /faq/, the home page, the school category, every product page (« Ce que mesure le chiffre de 92 % ») and the about page. Send it to Journal du Geek, Maddyness, Europe 1 and INPI as the source to cite.

findings.title: #4 Therapeutic, medical-device and reimbursement wording ('anti-douleur', 'anti-TMS', 'dispositif médical', 'remboursé par la Sécurité sociale') and absolute superlatives are used without substantiation
findings.description:
The evidence is page titles and URL slugs as shown in the search results we sampled. Current page text could not be fetched.
- 'Anti-douleur':
  - The Sherpa Kaki title 'Sac léger avec exosquelette anti mal de dos de montagne Sherpa Kaki Gravipack anti douleur' appears on 3 URLs: /produit/sac-a-dos-sherpa-kaki-avec-exosquelette-…, /produit-gravipack/sac-a-dos-sherpa-kaki and /produit-gravipack/sac-a-dos-sherpa.
  - The Light Promax title 'Sac à dos outillage anti-douleur exosquelette Gravipack®' appears on 2 URLs, one with the slug /produit/sac-a-dos-porte-outil-anti-douleur-avec-exosquelette-light-promax-gravipack/.
- 'Anti-TMS': the randonnée category ('Sac à dos exosquelette de randonnée anti-mal de dos et anti-TMS') and 'Claie de portage Gravipack anti-TMS pour charges très lourdes'.
- '92 %' in titles: the school category ('Sac à dos exosquelette scolaire Gravipack allège le poids de 92%'), and Decathlon partner titles ending '… Allège la charge de 92%' on the Hiking 33, Sherpa 45, Pearl and Feather listings. The study behind the figure is covered in study-92-evidence.
- Superlatives:
  - Tokyo slug '…la-technologie-gravipack-la-seule-au-monde-pour-reduire-efficacement-le-poids-sur-le-dos';
  - City slug 'anti-mal-de-dos-certainement-le-meilleur-sac-au-monde-pour-le-travail-et-le-velo-…';
  - G-Pack 'révolutionnaire et unique';
  - presta titles 'Le seul sac à dos au monde qui allège le poids Hiking 33', 'Le meilleur sac à dos de montagne' and '…le meilleur sac a dos au monde';
  - 'révolutionnaire' in 10 recorded titles.
  These fall under the French rules on misleading advertising (Code de la consommation L121-1/L121-2), not under medical-device rules. A search snippet for one product page also showed 'recommandé par kinés, ergonomes et médecins du travail' (verify on-site).
- 'Dispositif médical (préventif)':
  - Used by the press: Journal du Geek 2021 ('qualifié de dispositif médical de prévention contre le mal de dos') and Maddyness 2024 ('reconnu dispositif médical préventif contre les troubles musculosquelettiques et correcteur de posture').
  - Used by company representatives: the founder in a fnh.ma interview, and a co-director of a licensee on France Bleu ('avant tout un dispositif médical').
  - A site: search found no owned page using it.
  - Three searches found no CE marking, EU declaration of conformity, EUDAMED or ANSM record. EUDAMED is not indexed by web search, so this is weak evidence either way.
- Reimbursement:
  - The only source is one undated founder interview on challenge.ma, a Moroccan outlet (about 2022-23): 'le premier sac à dos bénéficiant d'un remboursement par la sécurité sociale en hexagone'.
  - The same article says the occupational doctor (médecin du travail) may prescribe the bag and the cost is 'pris en charge par l'employeur'. That is employer funding, so the article contradicts its own claim.
  - No LPP or ameli listing was found. A lespepitestech review says the bag 'devrait être remboursé' (should be reimbursed). The claim was not found on gravipack.com.
  - challenge.ma is the only Gravipack result for 'sac à dos remboursé sécurité sociale mal de dos', and no Gravipack page answers the question.
- Children's line: health wording reaches parents through the school category title above, the G-Pack collège/lycée product, the Kingston bag promoted as 'Vive la rentrée scolaire', Decathlon's Feather titles ('Allège la charge de 92%') and the presta Feather page ('Sac à dos scolaire Feather Gravipack contre le mal de dos').
- Not a claim issue: 'Sac à dos médical Gravipack allégez vos missions sauvez des vies' describes a bag for first responders and their work. It is not a therapeutic claim.
- Ranking trade-off: in the extended sample, gravipack.com ranks for the 'anti mal de dos' head terms:
  - 'sac à dos anti mal de dos' #4-#6;
  - 'sac à dos ergonomique mal de dos' #2;
  - 'sac à dos scolaire anti mal de dos' #1-#3, with the school category at #2;
  - 'sac à dos randonnée anti mal de dos', with the randonnée category at #5.
  'Anti mal de dos' is the brand's main demand term, so removing it everywhere without testing has a cost.

Why it matters: - Back pain, musculoskeletal disorders and children's backs are close to YMYL ('Your Money or Your Life') topics. Google's rater guidelines put Trust first there and discount unsupported health claims.
- Under the EU Medical Device Regulation (MDR 2017/745, Art. 2(1)), a product's intended purpose is read from its labelling, advertising and promotional material. Wording such as 'anti-douleur', 'anti-TMS' or 'dispositif médical préventif' can bring a backpack into medical-device scope. That means conformity assessment, CE marking and regulated advertising (CSP L5213-1 and following).
- Unqualified superlatives and a reimbursement claim contradicted by its own source risk being treated as misleading commercial practices (L121-1/L121-2 C. conso).
- If Gravipack uses Google Merchant Center (account status unknown), the relevant policy is Misrepresentation. The risk stays hypothetical until the account is checked.

Effect on SEO: - Titles and slugs are the most visible and most quoted text in search results and AI answers.
- Claims in them feed the sceptical 'arnaque / étude / 92 %' results, lower how health-adjacent pages are judged, and make answer engines less willing to repeat brand statements.
- Concrete, checkable wording (use, volume, weight, patent number) usually reads as more credible in a result.
- Rated Medium, not High: the evidence is search-result titles only and the fix is a wording change. The underlying evidence problem is handled in study-92-evidence.

Impact 7/10 · Effort Medium · Confidence likely
findings.recommendation: 1. Build a claims register (Google Sheet) with these columns: Claim | Exact wording | Where (URL; title, H1, slug, meta, alt, body, feed, partner, YouTube, press kit) | Evidence | Decision (keep / qualify / remove) | Owner | Review date. Pull every occurrence from WordPress with WP-CLI (adjust the table prefix): ``` wp db query "SELECT ID, post_type, post_name, post_title FROM wp_posts WHERE post_status='publish' AND CONCAT_WS(' ', post_title, post_name, post_excerpt, post_content) REGEXP 'anti[- ]?douleur|anti[- ]?tms|92 ?%|seule? au monde|meilleur sac|unique|dispositif m|rembours|prescrit|recommand'" wp db query "SELECT post_id, meta_key, meta_value FROM wp_postmeta WHERE meta_key IN ('_yoast_wpseo_title','_yoast_wpseo_metadesc','rank_math_title','rank_math_description','_wp_attachment_image_alt') AND meta_value REGEXP 'anti[- ]?douleur|anti[- ]?tms|92 ?%|seule? au monde|meilleur sac'" wp term list product_cat --fields=term_id,name,slug,description ``` Also include non-health figures seen in snippets, such as '500 000 clients satisfaits'. 2. Choose the regulatory route with a regulatory consultant and counsel, and brief every spokesperson (founder, licensees, agency). a. Medical device: - identify the legal manufacturer (brand owner or licensee); - build the technical documentation and clinical evaluation; - sign the EU declaration of conformity (class I non-sterile, non-measuring devices are self-declared); - register in EUDAMED (SRN, UDI-DI) and affix CE; - then state the intended purpose on product pages. b. Consumer product (faster): - remove 'dispositif médical', 'correcteur de posture', 'anti-TMS' and 'anti-douleur' everywhere; - add to the evidence page and the FAQ: « Gravipack est un sac à dos ergonomique. Ce n'est pas un dispositif médical et il ne remplace pas un avis médical. »; - ask Journal du Geek and Maddyness to update their sentences. 3. In week 1, remove treatment and absolute wording. Examples (check specs before publishing): - Sherpa Kaki: « Sac de montagne Sherpa 45 L kaki à exosquelette | Gravipack » - Light Promax: « Sac à dos porte-outils Light Promax à exosquelette | Gravipack » - Claie: « Claie de portage à exosquelette pour charges lourdes | Gravipack » - Randonnée category: keep the ranking phrase and drop 'anti-TMS'. Use « Sac de randonnée anti mal de dos à exosquelette | Gravipack » if counsel accepts the phrase, otherwise « Sac de randonnée à exosquelette : charge mieux répartie | Gravipack ». - School category: « Sac à dos scolaire à exosquelette, collège et lycée | Gravipack ». The 92 % moves to body copy with a footnote, or is dropped. - City: « Sac à dos ordinateur City à exosquelette | Gravipack » - Professional products: « pensé pour les professionnels qui portent des charges au quotidien » instead of 'anti-TMS'. - Superlatives: replace them with checkable facts, each linked to its source, such as « Médaille d'argent au Concours Lépine 2018 » or « Finaliste des Trophées INPI 2022 ». Use « technologie brevetée (brevet n° …) » once the numbers are confirmed (see patents-trademark). 4. Decide on 'anti mal de dos' separately, with counsel. - If it stays, use it only as a descriptive modifier, with a qualifier in the body: « conçu pour mieux répartir la charge et soulager les épaules ; ne remplace pas un avis médical ». Or use an H2 such as « Sac à dos et mal de dos : ce que fait (et ne fait pas) l'exosquelette ». - Test any title change on about 5 URLs for 4 weeks in Search Console before rolling it out. 5. Change only the misleading slugs (porte-outil-anti-douleur, la-seule-au-monde, certainement-le-meilleur-sac-au-monde). - Do it inside the single URL migration map, together with the presta and /produit-gravipack/ consolidation, so you do not create redirect chains. - Use Rank Math > Redirections, Yoast Premium's automatic redirect, or .htaccess above # BEGIN WordPress: ``` RewriteRule ^produit/sac-a-dos-porte-outil-anti-douleur-avec-exosquelette-light-promax-gravipack/?$ https://[hote-canonique]/produit/sac-a-dos-porte-outils-light-promax-exosquelette/ [R=301,L] ``` - Keep the 301s permanently, and update internal links and the sitemap. 6. Reimbursement: - Never repeat 'remboursé par la Sécurité sociale'. - If employer funding is real and documented, publish /prise-en-charge-employeur/ with: « Sur proposition du médecin du travail (mesures individuelles d'aménagement du poste, art. L4624-3 du Code du travail), l'employeur peut financer un sac Gravipack ; les mesures de santé et de sécurité ne doivent entraîner aucune charge financière pour le salarié (art. L4122-2). Gravipack fournit devis, fiche technique et attestation. Gravipack n'est pas inscrit sur la LPP et n'est pas remboursé par l'Assurance Maladie. » - Have counsel check the reading of Cass. soc. 5 juillet 2017 n° 15-29.424 before citing it. - Ask challenge.ma for a correction. - A FAQ answer « Le sac Gravipack est-il remboursé ? » helps users and answer engines. FAQPage markup brings no rich result. 7. Children's pages: - Have a paediatric physiotherapist review the school category, G-Pack, Kingston and Feather pages, with a dated 'Relu par' box. - Replace absolute promises such as « protège le dos de votre enfant » with « aide à mieux répartir le poids du cartable ». - Health professionals act as reviewers of educational content, not as product endorsers (CSP R.4127-20 for doctors; kiné ethics rules are similar). 8. Push the same wording to every channel: - the product feed (the feed-plugin API migration is covered in the Merchant Center finding); - Decathlon: both the brand's own seller account and Kid'abord, a separate company acting as licensee and marketplace seller; - Nature & Découvertes, Fnac, Kiabi, Au Vieux Campeur, Ergo-Corner and Équilibre France Ergonomie; - gravipack.ma; - the 4 KissKissBankBank campaign pages, as a creator news update; - YouTube descriptions, LinkedIn and the press kit. 9. If a Merchant Center account exists, check Diagnostics for Misrepresentation flags after the feed update. Request re-crawling of the main changed URLs through URL Inspection, and save a before/after title baseline.

findings.title: #8 Few guide pages target informational carrying and back-pain queries, and Gravipack is absent from those results
findings.description:
Gravipack does publish some informational content, so 'the blog is press/PR only' is wrong. Indexed examples: the brand-specific how-to /comment-regler-les-bretelles-exosquelette-de-mon-gravipack/, /evolution-du-portage-de-sac-a-dos-jusqu-a-la-revolution-gravipack/, /le-droit-de-la-propriete-industrielle-explique-avec-lexemple-gravipack/, /et-si-votre-sac-a-dos-ne-pesait-presque-plus-rien/ and /faq/ (which, according to search snippets, covers sizing and custom fitting by height and weight). Most other indexed posts are news and PR: SOFINS, RATP/VivaTech (2 posts), Concours Lépine and Bacary Sagna. What is missing is generic, non-brand guides that answer the carrying, load-weight and fit questions people search before they know the brand.

Evidence from the search results we sampled (a US-located, non-Google index):
- The 12 saved informational result sets (K13-K24) contain 0 gravipack.com URLs:
  - 'comment bien porter son sac à dos': pourquoidocteur, 24matins, consoglobe, a CISSS PDF, allodocteurs, a cssphares PDF, courrierlaval.
  - 'quel sac à dos quand on a mal au dos': allodocteurs x2, protegez-vous, MAIF, randonner-leger.
  - 'poids cartable 10%': dhnet, six Assemblée nationale PDFs, pourquoidocteur.
  - 'mal au dos sac à dos randonnée': globe-trotting, rtbf, Deuter x2, Osprey, Salomon x2.
  - 'régler bretelles sac à dos': Salomon x4, Deuter, Rab, blog.snowleader, tonton-outdoor x2.
  - 'poids max sac rando %': Deuter x2, glisshop, rtbf, cimalp, FFRandonnée x2.
  - In 'sac à dos qui soulage le dos et les épaules', 'sac à dos mal aux épaules solution' and 'bretelles ergonomiques sac à dos', Gravipack appears only through third parties: KissKissBankBank, Journal du Geek, randonner-leger threads and i-trekkings.
- Across 13 informational or health prompts, no Gravipack page appeared. Examples: cartable ergonomique mal de dos enfant, poids max sac rando, sac à dos TMS travail, sac à dos recommandé par les ostéopathes, exosquelette passif TMS. Three groups led these results: health institutions (CISSS/CSS PDFs, Assemblée nationale, INSPQ, INRS, OSHA), health media (allodocteurs, pourquoidocteur, Vidal) and brand guides (Deuter, Osprey, Salomon).
- Gravipack effectively created the term 'sac à dos exosquelette', but a kentfaith.fr blog post ('Sac A Dos Exosquelette ?') leads that query. In the extended sample, gravipack.com's category and home page sit at #6-#7.

Caveats:
- Many results came from Quebec, Belgium or Switzerland (cisss-lanaudiere, cssdgs.gouv.qc.ca, dhnet.be, rtbf, inspq). Treat the pattern as a direction, not a Google.fr ranking.
- Most informational queries ran in standard mode, which also under-represented gravipack.com for its own core terms.
- Some queries have mixed intent. For 'sac à dos randonnée anti mal de dos', the Gravipack randonnée category (#5) and home page (#6) rank alongside a zeoutdoor comparison and a norveya blog post. gravipack.com also ranks for the commercial 'anti mal de dos' head terms.
- The gap is therefore the pure how-to and load-weight layer, not the commercial layer.

Why it matters: These are the early-stage questions of Gravipack's audience: parents worried about the cartable, hikers with sore shoulders, workers who carry tools. Search engines answer them with guides, so product and category pages cannot take those places.

Outdoor brands and shops (Salomon, Deuter, Osprey, Snowleader, tonton-outdoor, glisshop) win these queries with guides. That shows an e-commerce site can rank here if it stays on carrying and fit topics where it has real expertise.

Gravipack has first-hand material no competitor can copy: strap-adjustment know-how, fitting personalised to height and weight, field use by RATP agents, and a 7-month independent hiking test. Question-style queries are also where AI answers draw their sources, although this audit did not measure presence in AI answers.

Effect on SEO: - New top-of-funnel entry points, with internal links into the randonnée, scolaire, business and outillage categories.
- More depth on carrying, adjusting and spreading the load. That supports the commercial 'anti mal de dos' pages that already rank.
- Short, sourced answer passages that answer engines can quote.
- Staying out of medical-condition queries avoids publishing YMYL content the site cannot credibly support.

Impact 6/10 · Effort High · Confidence likely
findings.recommendation: 1. Set the scope before writing. - Target carrying, fit and load-weight questions only. - Do not target hard-YMYL condition queries ('sac à dos scoliose enfant', 'sac à dos hernie discale') as primary keywords. At most, add one reviewed paragraph to the child guide telling readers to see a doctor. - Make no therapeutic claims (soigne, guérit, anti-douleur, anti-TMS). - Link every mention of the 92 % figure to the evidence page (see study-92-evidence). 2. Build the structure in WordPress without touching existing URLs. - Create a Page 'Conseils' at /conseils/ as the hub. - Publish each guide as a child Page (Page attributes > Parent: Conseils), e.g. /conseils/regler-son-sac-a-dos/. - Do not change Settings > Permalinks; that would move every existing post. - Keep news and PR in the existing /articles/ blog. 3. Publish in this order, 1-2 guides per month. Size each guide to its intent: ranking guides run roughly 1,200-1,800 words, but treat that as a guideline, not a target. - Hub: « Comment bien porter son sac à dos sans avoir mal au dos » (query: comment bien porter son sac à dos). - « Comment régler les bretelles de son sac à dos : la méthode en 5 étapes » (query: comment régler les bretelles d'un sac à dos). Use a generic method, and link Gravipack owners to the existing brand guide /comment-regler-les-bretelles-exosquelette-de-mon-gravipack/. Keep both pages; do not merge or redirect the brand guide. - « Poids du cartable : quel poids maximum selon l'âge ? » with a calculator (queries: poids du cartable, poids cartable 10 %). Go live by May-June 2027, before the rentrée. - « Poids maximum d'un sac de randonnée : combien porter selon son poids ? » with a calculator (query: poids maximum sac à dos randonnée). - « Mal aux épaules avec un sac à dos : causes fréquentes et bons réglages » (query: sac à dos mal aux épaules solution). - « Sac à dos exosquelette : définition et fonctionnement » (query: sac à dos exosquelette), to win back the definition query from the kentfaith post. If /et-si-votre-sac-a-dos-ne-pesait-presque-plus-rien/ overlaps, fold it in with a 301. - Later: « Porter des charges au travail : bien choisir et régler son sac » for tradespeople, citing INRS, with no 'anti-TMS' promise. 4. Use this template for every guide: - an answer-first paragraph of 40-60 words under the H1; - H2s phrased as questions; - numbered steps; - original photos or diagrams of strap settings; - the existing YouTube adjustment videos, embedded; - a 'Sources' list (INRS, FFRandonnée, ameli.fr, Éducation nationale); - 'Mis à jour le [date]'; - a box 'Relu par [Nom], masseur-kinésithérapeute DE / ergonome, le [date]'; - a short, factual closing section « Ce que fait l'exosquelette Gravipack, et ce qu'il ne fait pas », linking to one category and to the evidence page. Example answer box for the cartable guide (check every reference before publishing): « Le repère couramment cité en France est un cartable ne dépassant pas 10 % du poids de l'enfant, soit 3 kg pour 30 kg. Les études ne montrent pas de lien clair entre le poids du cartable et le mal de dos (revue systématique BJSM 2018), mais un cartable allégé et bien réglé reste plus confortable. » Quote the BJSM 2018 review (Yamato et al.) honestly. Check any FCPE or FFRandonnée percentage against its source before quoting it. 5. Recruit a named kinésithérapeute or ergonomist to review the educational content, and disclose any payment. Do not use doctors or physiotherapists as product endorsers on commercial pages: CSP R.4127-20 forbids it for doctors, and kinés have similar rules. 6. Add markup for entity context only; it earns no rich result. - Use Article with a named author, plus reviewedBy and lastReviewed on the WebPage. - Do not add HowTo (that rich result was removed), and do not add FAQPage expecting a rich result. - In Rank Math or Yoast, set the schema type to Article, then add the reviewer with a snippet like this: ```json {"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"WebPage","@id":"https://[hote-canonique]/conseils/regler-son-sac-a-dos/#webpage","lastReviewed":"2027-01-10","reviewedBy":{"@type":"Person","name":"[Nom]","jobTitle":"Masseur-kinésithérapeute DE"},"mainEntity":{"@type":"Article","headline":"Comment régler les bretelles de son sac à dos","author":{"@type":"Person","name":"[Auteur]"},"publisher":{"@id":"https://[hote-canonique]/#organization"},"datePublished":"2027-01-15"}} ``` 7. Build each calculator as a small HTML/JS block, or with the Calculated Fields Form plugin. Also print the rule as plain text, so the page reads correctly without JavaScript. 8. Internal links: - each guide links to one matching category and back to the hub; - each category links to 2-3 guides; - the brand adjustment guide links to the generic one; - product pages link to the adjustment and fit guides. 9. Publish on the canonical host only (see host-canonical-split). Add the hub to the XML sitemap and request indexing through URL Inspection.

findings.title: #14 No comparison or alternatives content answers 'Gravipack vs …' and comparison intent
findings.description:
No comparison, 'vs' or alternatives page from Gravipack was found, yet comparison intent is clear in the search results we sampled (a US-located, non-Google index).
- On three commercial head-term result pages, listicles or comparisons took about 20-35 % of results:
  - 'sac à dos ergonomique': 2/9 (accergo, le-repaire);
  - 'meilleur sac à dos anti mal de dos': 3/9 (norveya, accergo, techradar);
  - 'sac à dos randonnée anti mal de dos': 3/9 (zeoutdoor comparatif, norveya, accergo).
- On explicit best-of queries, they dominate:
  - 'sac à dos randonnée ergonomique': 4/9 (Glisshop, Ridepark, Toporando, Hardloop), naming Osprey Talon/Exos/Aether, Deuter Aircontact Core 40+10, Gregory, Millet and Mammut;
  - 'meilleur cartable ergonomique 2026': 8/9 (Futura-Sciences, Avis-Parents, meilleurs.fr), naming ergobag Prime, Satch, Baagl and Tann's;
  - 'meilleur sac à dos ergonomique comparatif 2026': Snowleader, Toporando, Clubic, TechRadar;
  - 'sac à dos scolaire anti mal de dos' also carries comparison posts from bodypack, sac-a-dos-france and laboutiquedestoons.
- Gravipack is not named in any comparison or best-of article we saw.
- Two searches found no 'Gravipack vs X' or 'alternatives à Gravipack' page. 'gravipack vs osprey OR deuter OR alternative sac exosquelette' returned only Deuter-vs-Osprey content (outforia, mountainsforeverybody, bushwalk, expertworldtravel).
- None of the gravipack.com URLs recorded in this audit is a comparison page. That record is a sample of search results, so absence on the site is likely rather than certain.
- People do evaluate the brand: the i-trekkings test of the Oslo 70 L ('Idée de génie ou arnaque ?') and a Gomet article rank. Outzer's critical Sherpa 45 review ('Un sac à dos terrifiant', which measured about 30 L of usable volume) ranks for 'gravipack avis'.
- Competing carrying technologies appear in the results:
  - Osprey's AG 'Anti-Gravity' back system (Aura AG on mec.ca and i-run) for 'sac à dos anti gravité', where gravipack.com is absent;
  - Deuter Aircontact;
  - Tucano Marte Gravity 'AGS' (3 pearl.fr results for 'sac à dos ordinateur anti mal de dos');
  - Kensington Contour, ergobag, Bon Chic Bon Dos and the LEX exoskeleton.
- Osprey also has an official French sizing guide, and Deuter publishes advice pages on back pain and maximum load.
- gravipack.com's home page already ranks #5 for 'meilleur sac à dos anti mal de dos' in the extended sample. A separate brand 'meilleur…' page would compete with it.

Why it matters: Gravipack bags cost roughly €90-€289. Buyers compare them with hip-belt and ventilated-back designs from brands they already know, and the exoskeleton only makes sense next to those alternatives. When the brand publishes no fair comparison, sceptical third-party reviews frame the choice instead.

A brand-written 'meilleur…' listicle that puts its own product first rarely ranks, because review-type results favour independent hands-on testing. The realistic routes are honest mechanism explainers and 'X vs Y' pages from the brand, plus getting into the independent listicles that already rank.

Effect on SEO: - Pages that can rank for 'X vs Y', 'quel modèle choisir', 'sac à dos anti gravité' and 'exosquelette ou sac classique' queries.
- Internal links to model pages.
- A sourced comparison that answer engines can quote instead of forum threads.
- Outreach can get Gravipack into existing 'meilleur…' listicles that the brand cannot rank for itself.

Impact 5/10 · Effort Medium · Confidence likely
findings.recommendation: 1. Prepare the data first. Keep one master spec sheet per model: volume as measured, empty weight as weighed, strap fitting range, warranty and current price. Use it on the site and send it to every reseller. Resolve the conflicts this audit found: Hiking listed as 30 L and 33 L; Sherpa weight listed as 1,200 g and 1,250 g; Sherpa volume, which Outzer measured at about 30 L. 2. Build the pages in this order. Size each one to its intent, with no fixed word count. a. « Quel Gravipack choisir ? Sherpa, Hiking, Oslo, Tokyo, Business Talk, Kingston… » at /quel-gravipack-choisir/. One comparison table (use, volume, weight, fitting, warranty, 'prix au [date]'), built with a WooCommerce product table or TablePress, linking every product. b. « Sac à dos à exosquelette ou sac à dos classique : quelles différences ? » at /comparatif/sac-a-dos-exosquelette-vs-sac-classique/. c. « Exosquelette Gravipack ou dos Anti-Gravity d'Osprey : deux façons de porter » at /comparatif/exosquelette-vs-anti-gravity/, targeting 'sac à dos anti gravité'. Describe Osprey AG from Osprey's own pages, with links. d. « Exosquelette ou ceinture ventrale : que fait chaque système de la charge ? ». Say honestly that a hip belt moves load to the pelvis and may suit heavy treks better. e. « Gravipack Sherpa 45 vs Osprey Talon 44 vs Deuter Aircontact Core 40+10 », only after weighing and measuring all three bags. f. « Cartable ergonomique collège : Feather vs ergobag vs Satch », only once Feather is sold on gravipack.com and its height threshold is the same everywhere (today 1m50 in some places, 1m55 in others). Have a paediatric physiotherapist review it. g. A laptop-bag comparison table inside the business category (Business Talk V4 and Kingston vs Tucano Marte Gravity and Kensington Contour), not a separate page. Do not create a standalone 'meilleur sac à dos anti mal de dos' page. Put a comparison table in the hub or category that already ranks. 3. Apply these fairness rules on every page. - Show a visible disclosure such as: « Gravipack est notre marque. Ce comparatif est rédigé par l'équipe Gravipack. Les caractéristiques des autres sacs proviennent des sites de leurs fabricants (liens ci-dessous), relevées le [date]. Nous indiquons aussi les points sur lesquels ils font mieux que nous. » - Link every competitor fact to the maker's page. - Write 'Non communiqué' for missing data. - Name competitor strengths: hip-belt load transfer, ventilated backs, lower weight or price. - Make no medical claims. - Present the 92 % only as « chiffre annoncé par le fabricant », linked to the evidence page. - Add a 'Méthodologie' section and 'Mis à jour le', and review each page every quarter. 4. Titles follow the pattern « Gravipack Sherpa 45 vs Osprey Talon 44 : poids, volume et portage comparés (2026) ». Breadcrumb: Accueil > Comparatifs > page. 5. Markup: ItemList for the chooser and roundups, Article for explainers, and Product only for Gravipack's own products. Never add Product, Review or AggregateRating markup for competitors. Example: ```json {"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"ItemList","name":"Quel Gravipack choisir ?","itemListElement":[{"@type":"ListItem","position":1,"url":"https://[hote-canonique]/produit/[sherpa-45]/"},{"@type":"ListItem","position":2,"url":"https://[hote-canonique]/produit/[hiking-30]/"}]} ``` 6. Win the listicle places through outreach. Offer loan samples, with disclosure, to authors who already rank: zeoutdoor, Toporando, guide-velo, tonton-outdoor, meilleurtest, accergo, norveya, Avis-Parents. Affiliate links must carry rel="sponsored". Never trade samples for links.

findings.title: #35 The inventor-founder's expertise is spread across several posts rather than one authoritative bio
findings.recommendation: 1. Create one authoritative bio. - Preferably make it a section of the existing about page, with its own anchor, to avoid a second about page. Otherwise publish it at /mohammed-errafi-inventeur-gravipack/. - Role: président d'EXOSQUELETTE LIGHT SAS, inventeur de l'exosquelette Gravipack. - The invention story with dated milestones, each linked to a source: first patent filing 2016, company created 2018, Concours Lépine silver medal 2018, Trophées INPI 2022 finalist, Europe 1 Trophées de l'Avenir 2023 nominee, RATP deployment shown at VivaTech 2023. - Patents, linked to the IP page (patents-trademark). - A list of press interviews with links, a photo and a press contact. - Only press sources were found for the Lépine year, so confirm it from the official prize list before publishing. - Include no personal data beyond name and role. 2. Retitle the about page to describe the company, e.g. « À propos de Gravipack : l'inventeur, l'entreprise et l'exosquelette ». - Retitle /inventeur-dun-sac-a-dos-en-apesanteur/ without the 92 % claim, e.g. « Mohammed Errafi, inventeur du sac à dos à exosquelette Gravipack ». - Keep the slugs, and link both posts to the bio. 3. In WordPress, create or complete his user profile (biographical info, photo) and set him as author of the posts he wrote. Keep his author archive indexable only if it has real content. 4. Add Person and Organization JSON-LD with linked @ids, using the registry facts: legal name EXOSQUELETTE LIGHT SAS, current registered seat 10 rue de la Paix, 75002 Paris. - With Yoast, extend the Organization piece with a filter: ```php add_filter('wpseo_schema_organization', function ($data) { $data['legalName'] = 'EXOSQUELETTE LIGHT SAS'; $data['founder'] = ['@id' => home_url('/a-propos-de-nous-gravipack-au-service-de-votre-dos/#mohammed-errafi')]; return $data; }); ``` - Output the Person node (in Rank Math: Schema Generator > custom JSON-LD): ```json {"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Person","@id":"https://[hote-canonique]/a-propos-de-nous-gravipack-au-service-de-votre-dos/#mohammed-errafi","name":"Mohammed Errafi","jobTitle":"Fondateur, président et inventeur de l'exosquelette Gravipack","worksFor":{"@id":"https://[hote-canonique]/#organization"},"sameAs":["https://www.linkedin.com/in/errafi/"]} ``` 5. Use the bio in the press kit and as the author box on posts he writes. He is the inventor, not a health professional, so the guides and the evidence page still need an independent health reviewer.

findings.title: #38 Patent and trademark claims are not backed by publication or registration numbers
findings.description:
Patents:
- Patent counts in public sources rise over time, which fits a growing portfolio rather than a contradiction:
  - about 3 international patents around 2018-19 (Neozone; forumeco, which also says the first filing was in 2016);
  - 4 in 2020 (lematin.ma);
  - 'Brevets : 1 France, 9 internationaux et 3 en cours de dépôts' on INPI's 2022 Trophées profile;
  - then 9 (fnh.ma).
- A search snippet for a product page showed 'protégé par 13 brevets' (verify on-site). 13 equals 1 + 9 + 3, so it would count pending applications as patents.
- No publication number surfaced in 6 searches across Google Patents, Espacenet, Patentscope, EPO, INPI and Justia (by inventor Mohammed Errafi, by Gravibag/Gravipack and by technical terms). Only unrelated backpack patents came back. The search tool indexes patent databases poorly, so this is not evidence that the patents do not exist.
- The first filing (2016) predates the company (2018), so the holder may be the inventor personally, licensing the patents to the company. Confirm this.
- The post /le-droit-de-la-propriete-industrielle-explique-avec-lexemple-gravipack/ may already list the numbers (verify on-site).
- 'Breveté' is used without a number: in gravipack.ma's tagline 'premier sac à dos exosquelette anti mal de dos breveté' and in the YouTube video 'Exosquelette breveté Gravipack sac a dos - Vidéo 3D'.

Trademark:
- A GRAVIPACK filing dated 27/05/2019 (in force to 27/05/2029) rests on a societe.com summary. INPI's profile mentions 2 marks and an international filing.
- No INPI, EUIPO or WIPO register entry was seen in 2 searches. The INPI index instead surfaces FR3275099 'GRAVIPACK', an unrelated mark filed in 2004 and expired in 2014, covering classes 1, 17 and 19.
- '®' appears in titles such as 'Gravipack®' (Light Promax) and 'GraviPack®' (/nos-engagements/).

Why it matters: For an inventor-led brand, verifiable patents are among the few expertise signals anyone can check. Without numbers, 'breveté' reads as marketing. Calling pending applications patents, or using ® where a mark is not registered, is itself a misleading-practice risk.

Register numbers also separate the brand from homonyms: the expired 2004 GRAVIPACK mark, and the 'Gravis' packaging company that appears in searches for the founder.

Effect on SEO: Minor but cheap:
- a checkable fact that press, Wikidata and answer engines can state without hedging;
- links to authoritative register pages;
- the basis for replacing superlatives with 'technologie brevetée (brevet n° …)' in health-claims-wording.

Impact 3/10 · Effort Low · Confidence needs-on-site-check
findings.recommendation: 1. Get from the IP counsel, for each patent family: publication numbers (FR, EP, WO, national), title, applicant or holder (the inventor or EXOSQUELETTE LIGHT SAS, and any licence), inventor, filing and grant dates, status and territories. Cross-check on data.inpi.fr and Espacenet (inventor 'Errafi'). 2. Publish one reference page, either by updating /le-droit-de-la-propriete-industrielle-explique-avec-lexemple-gravipack/ or as /brevets-et-marques/. Link it from the footer and from product pages. Example table: ``` | Titre | N° de publication | Titulaire | Inventeur | Dépôt | Statut | Territoires | Registre | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---| | [Bretelle à exosquelette …] | FR [n°] | [titulaire] | Mohammed Errafi | [date] | Délivré | FR | Espacenet | | [..] | WO [n°] | [..] | Mohammed Errafi | [date] | Demande en cours | [pays] | Patentscope | ``` Add 'Dernière vérification le [date]'. 3. Wording rules: - 'technologie brevetée (brevet FR n° …)' only for granted patents; - 'demande de brevet déposée (n° …)' for pending ones; - one dated count, e.g. « Au [date] : 1 brevet français délivré, 9 titres internationaux, 3 demandes en cours », and only if counsel confirms it; - replace 'protégé par 13 brevets' if it includes pending applications. 4. Trademark: - Get the registration numbers, owner and classes (backpacks fall in class 18). - Add to the mentions légales: « Gravipack® est une marque déposée de [titulaire] (INPI n° [..] ; [UE/OMPI n° ..]). » - Use ® only where the mark is registered. This matters for gravipack.ma unless the registration covers Morocco. 5. Use the same count and wording on the INPI profile, LinkedIn, the KissKissBankBank pages, gravipack.ma, YouTube and the press kit. 6. Markup: declare the brand on Product (brand: {"@type":"Brand","name":"Gravipack"}) and keep patent numbers as visible text. There is no rich result for patents.

findings.title: #40 No public size/fit table maps height and weight to strap settings, although bags are adjusted to each buyer
findings.description:
Fit content exists, but no public rule tells a buyer which setting or size they will get.

What exists (from search snippets; verify on-site):
- The Business Talk V4, Hiking and Tokyo product pages say each bag is personalised free of charge to the buyer's height and weight, within ±10 cm and ±8 kg.
- The Austerlitz page asks for height and weight at order and adjusts the bag in the workshop.
- The Tokyo page mentions an exchange if the wearer's build changes.
- /faq/ covers sizing and custom fitting.
- An official adjustment guide exists at /comment-regler-les-bretelles-exosquelette-de-mon-gravipack/.

What is missing: a public table mapping height and weight to a strap setting or size, and 'comment se mesurer' (how to measure yourself) content. Neither surfaced.

Sales channels describe fit differently:
- Ergo-Corner titles every Gravipack product 'Personnalisation de l'exosquelette M/L/XL/XXL' or '3 tailles', with 'sur-mesure' for very small or tall people.
- The Feather vs Feather Plus threshold is '<1m55' on most channels but '<1m50 et 30 kg' on Kiabi.

Competitors own the size-guide results:
- Osprey's official French sizing guide measures torso length from C7 to the iliac crest (S/M 43-52 cm, WXS/S 34-43 cm). Snowleader and Alpinstore republish it.
- Arsayo sizes its bags by shoulder width (S/M/L).

Fit comes up in some reviews, alongside other complaints such as refunds:
- Decathlon reviewers of the Hiking 33 mention hard adjustment and straps rubbing the neck when the bag is lightly loaded.
- One Decathlon reviewer obtained custom straps only after contacting the brand.
- Trustpilot reviews mention straps coming loose.

Why it matters: Personalised fitting is a selling point, but before ordering a buyer cannot tell what 'adjusted to your height and weight' means or what to enter. A public table answers that. It also reduces fit-related returns and reviews, and gives resellers one consistent wording instead of their own M/L/XL labels.

Effect on SEO: Modest:
- a page that can rank for long-tail queries such as 'taille sac à dos' and 'comment choisir la taille de son sac à dos', alongside Osprey's guide;
- consistent fit data for product pages, feeds and resellers, which can link back to the guide.

Impact 3/10 · Effort Low · Confidence likely
findings.recommendation:
1. Publish « Guide des tailles et du réglage Gravipack » at /guide-des-tailles-gravipack/. It should include: - How personalisation works: « Indiquez votre taille et votre poids à la commande : nous préréglons l'exosquelette en atelier (tolérance ±10 cm et ±8 kg). Si votre morphologie change, contactez-nous pour un échange. » Match the exact terms of the CGV. - One table per model family, mapping height range and weight range to the workshop setting or strap size actually used (for example: Taille 150-165 cm / Poids 45-60 kg → réglage [A]). Use the internal settings. Do not invent an M/L/XL/XXL scale if the workshop does not use one. - « Comment se mesurer »: height without shoes and current weight; for models with a hip belt, torso length from C7 to the iliac crest. - One Feather vs Feather Plus threshold, stated the same way everywhere. - Links to the existing adjustment guide and the YouTube adjustment video. 2. In WooCommerce, make height and weight required fields on products that are pre-adjusted (WooCommerce Product Add-Ons or a similar plugin), and show the guide link next to them: ```php add_action('woocommerce_before_add_to_cart_button', function () { echo '

Guide des tailles : quelle taille et quel poids indiquer ?

'; }); ``` 3. Link the guide from every product page, from /faq/ and from the adjustment guide. 4. Send the table to resellers (Ergo-Corner, the Decathlon sellers, Nature & Découvertes, Au Vieux Campeur, Kiabi) with a link back, and ask them to replace their own size labels with it. 5. Only if sizes are sold as separate WooCommerce variations, expose them as the size attribute in Product/Offer markup and in the product feed. Otherwise leave size out of the markup.

findings.title: #41 Pre-order dates that have already passed may still be live on product pages, and news posts show no dates in search snippets (verify on-site)
findings.description:
This evidence comes from search snippets only. The live site could not be fetched, and a snippet can be cached from before a date passed. Audit date: 12 Oct 2026.

**Pre-order dates in snippets that have now passed**
- **Tokyo PDP** (apex, /produit/sac-a-dos-innovant-utilise-la-technologie-gravipack-la-seule-au-monde-pour-reduire-efficacement-le-poids-sur-le-dos/): 'premières expéditions à partir de mi-septembre 2026'.
  - This is one of the strongest owned product pages in the search results we sampled (a US-located, non-Google index). It appears for 'sac à dos anti mal de dos' and 'sac à dos vélo travail anti mal de dos', and it was the first owned URL for 'gravipack avis'. A stale date here is seen by the most searchers.
- **Business Talk V4 20L** (www): 'précommande … disponibilité prévue en juin 2026', described as a limited series.
- **Business Talk V4 25L 'deux ordinateurs'** (www): 'Prévente – Offre Early Bird : livraison garantie en août', with 129,90 € struck through to 59,90 €. The snippet gives no year, but any August before today has passed. If the Early Bird price is still active, it is a −54 % promotion with no end date.

**Pre-order date that will pass in about 5 weeks**
- **Claie Barracuda / fourreau Gravitech** (apex, /produit/fourreau-de-portage-exosquelette-gravitech-anti-mal-de-dos-gravipack/; SERP title 'Claie de portage révolutionnaire exosquelette anti-mal de dos'): 'livraison à partir de mi-novembre 2026'.

**Signals that make the problem worse**
- The product-tag archive www /etiquette-produit/precommande/ is indexed. Its title is 'Précommande - Sac a dos exosquelette anti-mal de dos Gravipack qui allège le poids sur les épaules et le dos.' (109 characters). Products that have shipped may still be listed there as pre-orders.
- A legacy presta.gravipack.com CMS page still describes 'commandes de réservation' with 2-3 months' delivery. The main store's product pages and CGV promise 1-2 days in France, so the index carries conflicting delivery promises.
- The gravipack.com Trustpilot profile (3.1/5 from 9 reviews in our sample) includes a review of an order delivered about three months late. Some positive reviews also mention a late but tracked delivery. That profile led the 'gravipack avis' results we sampled, so missed dates already reach the review results.
- The only 2026-dated owned content we found is this pre-order copy. Dated blog posts in the sample run from 2022 to 2025.

**News and event posts with no date in snippets**
- A site-restricted 2025/2026 query surfaced these pages with no publication date or event date in the result summaries:
  - /actualites-gravipack-2/
  - the SOFINS post /gravipack-soulage-les-forces-speciales-au-sofins/ (plus a /test/ duplicate)
  - /gravipack-presentees-au-salon-militaire-techterre-combat-futur/
  - /gravipack-bientot-en-magasin-linnovation-en-apesanteur-prend-son-envol/ (names no store)
- Correction to the original claim: the /articles/ blog is dated (posts from 2022 to 2025 in the phase-1 sample). The gap is that snippets and these event or news posts show no date, not that the site has no dates at all. Whether each post shows a date on the page needs an on-site check.

**Moved to other findings**
- Price spreads across snippets (for example Business Talk V4 at 149 € vs 129 €, Pearl, Oslo, Sherpa) are mostly crawl timing and promotions, such as the Decathlon promotion from 18/06 to 30/08/2026. They are covered in the price-parity finding.
- Spec conflicts (Hiking Gris URL says '30l' but the page says 33 L; Rome 1,6 kg vs 1,9 kg; Oslo '60+10L' vs '70L') are covered in the product-data consistency finding.
- Utility pages indexed as products are covered in the B2B finding.
- A mismatch between the schema price and the visible price only matters on the live page. It is listed under onsite_check.

Why it matters: A visible delivery date is a promise. When 'juin 2026' or 'mi-septembre 2026' is still shown in October 2026, the shopper reads it as a late product or an unmaintained shop. That hurts most on the Tokyo page, one of the brand's best-ranking product pages, and for a brand whose review results already include delivery-delay and refund complaints. A pre-order that is past its date or never expires also invites disputes under French consumer law: the seller must state a delivery date or deadline before the order is placed. Undated event posts stop readers, journalists and AI answer engines from judging how recent the SOFINS or Techterre activity is, which weakens the only fresh owned news the brand has.

Effect on SEO: The effect is indirect and works through click-through rate, conversion and trust, not through a ranking penalty. Past-due dates in snippets lower CTR on product pages that already rank. If the stock status, Product JSON-LD availability (PreOrder, BackOrder or InStock) and the Merchant Center feed disagree, Google can drop availability and price from product snippets and flag free merchant listings. The indexed 'Précommande' tag archive can keep showing shipped products as pre-orders. Visible dates and datePublished/dateModified on posts help Google and AI answer engines judge recency and cite the right event. The freshness gain is small but real.

Impact 3/10 · Effort Low · Confidence needs-on-site-check
findings.recommendation: 1. **List every dated promise (about 1 hour).** In WP-CLI, run one search per term: ```bash for t in "précommande" "prévente" "Early Bird" "disponibilité prévue" "premières expéditions" "livraison garantie" "livraison à partir" "bientôt"; do wp post list --post_type=product,post,page --post_status=publish --s="$t" --fields=ID,post_title,post_type; done # If pages are built with Elementor, the text is also stored in post meta: wp db query "SELECT post_id FROM $(wp db prefix)postmeta WHERE meta_key='_elementor_data' AND meta_value LIKE '%précommande%'" ``` Also open Produits → Étiquettes → 'Précommande' and list its products. Check the short description, the long description and any custom 'disponibilité' field. 2. **Fix each product's stock status today, starting with Tokyo, both Business Talk V4 pages and Barracuda/Gravitech.** For Business Talk V4, edit only the URL that will remain after the duplicate-product consolidation. - **Shipped and available:** Produit → Inventaire → État du stock = 'En stock' and tick 'Gérer le stock ?'. Remove the 'Précommande' tag. Replace the copy with « En stock – expédié sous 1 à 2 jours ouvrés » so it matches the CGV. - **Still not shipped:** État du stock = 'En réapprovisionnement' and Autoriser les commandes en réapprovisionnement = 'Autoriser, mais avec notification client'. Write a new honest, dated message such as « Précommande – premières expéditions prévues à partir du [jj mois 2026]. Nous vous prévenons par e-mail en cas de changement. » - **Limited series sold out (Business Talk V4 20L 'série limitée'):** set 'En rupture de stock'. Keep the page live (status 200) with a link to the nearest current model, and do not hide out-of-stock items from the catalogue if the page ranks. Use a 301 to the successor only when the product is permanently discontinued. - **Expired Early Bird:** end the sale. For any future promotion, use Prix promo → 'Planifier' with Du/Au dates so it ends automatically. Price markup (StrikethroughPrice priceSpecification plus validFrom/validThrough, not priceValidUntil) is covered in the price finding. 3. **Make pre-order messages expire on their own** so this cannot recur. Option A is the official WooCommerce Pre-Orders extension, which takes a release date and switches the product to purchasable when that date arrives. Option B is a custom field `_gp_date_expedition` (format AAAA-MM-JJ) plus this snippet in the Code Snippets plugin: ```php // Visible text: shows the date only while it is still in the future add_filter( 'woocommerce_get_availability_text', function ( $text, $product ) { $d = get_post_meta( $product->get_id(), '_gp_date_expedition', true ); if ( $product->is_on_backorder() && $d ) { $ts = strtotime( $d ); return $ts > time() ? sprintf( 'Précommande – premières expéditions à partir du %s', date_i18n( 'j F Y', $ts ) ) : 'Réassort en cours – contactez-nous pour connaître le délai exact'; } return $text; }, 10, 2 ); // Structured data: PreOrder + availabilityStarts only while the date is in the future add_filter( 'woocommerce_structured_data_product_offer', function ( $offer, $product ) { $d = get_post_meta( $product->get_id(), '_gp_date_expedition', true ); if ( $product->is_on_backorder() && $d && strtotime( $d ) > time() ) { $offer['availability'] = 'https://schema.org/PreOrder'; $offer['availabilityStarts'] = date( 'c', strtotime( $d ) ); } return $offer; }, 10, 2 ); ``` If Rank Math generates the Product schema instead of WooCommerce, make the same change through the `rank_math/snippet/rich_snippet_product_entity` filter. Yoast WooCommerce SEO builds on the WooCommerce data, so the filter above applies. 4. **Keep the feed in line with the page.** In Google for WooCommerce or your feed plugin, map 'En réapprovisionnement' to `preorder` or `backorder` with an `availability_date`, which Merchant Center requires for pre-orders. Turn on automatic item updates for availability and price. Then check every edited product page in the Rich Results Test: visible text, Offer.availability and price must agree. 5. **Handle the 'Précommande' tag archive.** - Remove the tag from products that have shipped. - Set product tags to noindex. In Yoast: Réglages → Taxonomies → Étiquettes produits → 'Afficher dans les résultats de recherche' = Non. In Rank Math: Titres & Méta → Étiquettes produits → Robots Meta = No Index. - If the tag is retired, 301 /etiquette-produit/precommande/ to the 'Nouveaux sacs à dos Gravipack' category with the Redirection plugin or Rank Math → Redirections. 6. **Dates on news and event posts.** Check first: posts under /articles/ already show dates. - Where a template hides the date (single posts, /actualites-gravipack-2/ listing), turn it on. In Astra: Personnaliser → Blog → Article unique → Méta 'Date'. In Elementor Theme Builder: 'Infos de la publication' widget, Date + 'Dernière mise à jour'. The rendered line should read « Publié le 12 mars 2025 · Mis à jour le 10 octobre 2026 ». - Make sure the SEO plugin outputs BlogPosting or Article (not NewsArticle) with datePublished and dateModified. In Yoast: Réglages → Types de contenu → Articles → Type d'article = 'Article de blog'. In Rank Math: Schema → Articles → 'Blog Post'. - Change dateModified only when the content changes materially. - Keep the /actualites-gravipack-2/ URL. Renaming it is low-value URL churn. 7. **Date the events in the copy.** - In the first sentence of the SOFINS and Techterre posts, give the event date and place, e.g. « Les [jj–jj mois aaaa], Gravipack a présenté la claie Barracuda au salon SOFINS… », using the real dates. - Update 'Gravipack bientôt en magasin' with the store names and a dated « Mise à jour du [date] » box. Otherwise link it to the where-to-buy page. 8. **Remove the conflicting legacy promise.** Change the presta.gravipack.com 'commandes de réservation / 2-3 mois' page, or 301 it, as part of retiring the presta subdomain. 9. **Recrawl and make it routine.** - Request indexing for the edited product pages and posts in Search Console with URL Inspection → 'Demander une indexation'. The Indexing API does not apply to products. - For Bing, ping the URLs through IndexNow (Rank Math Instant Indexing or Microsoft's IndexNow plugin). - On the 1st of each month, list overdue pre-orders with `wp post list --post_type=product --meta_key=_gp_date_expedition --meta_compare='<' --meta_value=$(date +%F) --fields=ID,post_title`. The target is an empty list.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Distinctive, ownable category term ("sac à dos exosquelette")
Official YouTube channel and LinkedIn page exist and rank for the brand

findings.title: #15 There is no single, consistent explainer for 'sac à dos exosquelette', and the brand describes its product several different ways
findings.description:
**1. The term is mostly about Gravipack already, but no Gravipack page defines it.**

We ran 'sac à dos exosquelette' twice in our search tool, which uses a US-located, non-Google index, so these are not Google.fr positions.

In the extended run, Gravipack holds 2 of the 9 results:
- #6, the catalogue category /categorie-produit/tous-les-sacs-a-dos-exosquelette/
- #7, the home page

Five more results are about Gravipack:
- #2, an i-trekkings test of the Oslo 70 L
- #4, an ergo-corner reseller brand page
- #5, compostelle-autrement ('Gravipack, le sac à dos en apesanteur')
- #8, the Decathlon marketplace Hiking 33 listing, titled '… Allège la charge de 92%'
- #9, a Google Patents result

Only two results are generic third parties:
- #1, kentfaith.fr 'Sac A Dos Exosquelette ?'. The search summary attributes sensors, automatic adjustment and army use to it.
- #3, alloprod.com

The standard run returned no gravipack.com URL. It showed the ffrandonnee.fr news item 'Une innovation : un exosquelette pour alléger le poids du sac à dos', Journal du Geek (2021), i-trekkings, Neozone (LEX) and three EPO patents.

The gap is narrower than 'third parties define the category'. Gravipack has no page that gives a quotable 'Un sac à dos exosquelette est…' definition. Search summaries also describe the mechanism in conflicting ways:
- 'inserts en carbone relevant les bretelles comme des pouces'
- 'armature métallique'
- transfer 'vers le centre de gravité'
- critics saying the load just moves to the lower back

The query 'sac à dos exosquelette c'est quoi' was never run.

Gravipack is the brand most associated with this category term. It did not invent the concept, because load-transferring pack exoskeletons predate it.

**2. Explainer-like content already exists, split across three posts:**
- www /evolution-du-portage-de-sac-a-dos-jusqu-a-la-revolution-gravipack/ ('L'évolution du portage de sac à dos jusqu'à la révolution Gravipack')
- www /et-si-votre-sac-a-dos-ne-pesait-presque-plus-rien/ ('Et si votre sac à dos ne pesait presque plus rien ?')
- apex /inventeur-dun-sac-a-dos-en-apesanteur/ ('Le sac à dos en apesanteur anti-mal de dos allège le poids de 92%')

The last title says the bag's weight is reduced. That contradicts how the product works: the weight is unchanged and the load is transferred to the hips. Sceptics use exactly this point; forum.bushwalk.com (2024) notes that the 'weightless' bag weighs 890 g.

**3. The descriptors vary.**
- 'exosquelette': in 66 of the 98 sampled main-site titles.
- 'sac à dos en apesanteur': in 5 of the 16 legacy presta.gravipack.com titles (e.g. /73-gravipack 'Gravipack, le sac à dos en apesanteur qui ne fait pas mal au dos et aux épaules', /59-concours-lepine…, /plan-du-site-gravipack, the Road Adventure product). Also in the apex post above, the Facebook bio ('Sac a Dos en Apesanteur - Innovation Française') and the 2022 KissKissBankBank campaign slug.
- 'EVA ergonomique mémoire de forme': in the Compostelle survie 25 / 35 / 65 L titles and the 80 L slug.
- 'zero gravity backpack': on the YouTube channel.
- Efficacy wording also varies: 'allège le poids', 'allège la charge', 'réduire efficacement le poids'.

Correction to the phase-1 claim: the Compostelle 25 / 35 / 65 L titles do contain 'exosquelette', but only through the site-wide title suffix ' - Gravipack, le sac à dos exosquelette anti-mal de dos homme femme enfant'. That suffix appears on 13 of the 98 sampled titles. On 12 of them it is the only occurrence of 'exosquelette', including the three EVA bags. So the suffix suggests an exoskeleton on EVA products that may not have one (verify on-site).

No sampled Gravipack title uses 'anti-gravité'. 'Apesanteur' is a generic French word, not a competitor trademark. It only points towards a results page that others own: 'sac à dos anti gravité' is held by Osprey AG, Pearl Luna Gravity and similar products.

**4. Unrelated products are indexed.** They blur the entity only mildly:
- external solar battery (slug ends '-copie')
- paracord bracelet
- dragonne
- porte-clé flamme
- /produit/fabrication-professionnelle-gravipack/ ('fabrication professionnelle, cadeaux d'entreprise et objets publicitaires haut de gamme')

Selling accessories is normal. They just should not sit in the core exoskeleton categories.

Why it matters: When someone asks 'c'est quoi un sac à dos exosquelette ?' or 'comment ça marche ?', answer engines and featured snippets lift the clearest self-contained 'X est…' passage from a page that ranks. The source today is kentfaith, whose summarised claims about sensors and automatic adjustment do not describe Gravipack, or scattered press wording.

Using one stable descriptor everywhere ('Gravipack = sacs à dos à exosquelette') is what lets engines tie the brand to the term and say correctly which models have the exoskeleton. A clear statement that the bag's weight does not change also defuses the most common sceptical argument ('it weighs 890 g, it isn't weightless').

Effect on SEO: The page would capture the informational variants ('c'est quoi', 'comment ça marche', 'fonctionnement'), which currently return no Gravipack URL. It would also give AI Overviews, ChatGPT and Perplexity a quotable Gravipack definition and give product pages a strong supporting page to link to.
