Consolidating three overlapping posts with 301 redirects merges their signals instead of splitting them. Aligning the descriptor and the title suffix removes mixed signals about which products have the exoskeleton.

Keep the catalogue category as the commercial target for the head term, and point the explainer at definitional intent, so the two pages do not compete.

Impact 5/10 · Effort Medium · Confidence likely
findings.recommendation: 1. **Assign roles to the URLs.** - Keep /categorie-produit/tous-les-sacs-a-dos-exosquelette/ as the commercial target for 'sac à dos exosquelette'. It already ranks. - Create one explainer page for definitional and how-it-works intent. - Each page links to the other: the category intro says « Comment fonctionne l'exosquelette ? », and the explainer says « Voir tous les sacs à dos exosquelette ». 2. **Consolidate the existing posts. Do not add a fourth.** - In Search Console (Performance and Links), note clicks, queries and backlinks for /evolution-du-portage…/, /et-si-votre-sac-a-dos-ne-pesait-presque-plus-rien/ and /inventeur-dun-sac-a-dos-en-apesanteur/. - Build a WordPress Page, e.g. /sac-a-dos-exosquelette-fonctionnement/, on the host the host-consolidation fix keeps as canonical. Merge any unique sections into it, for example the carrying-history part. - 301 the posts whose main topic is 'how it works' to it, using Rank Math → Redirections, Yoast Premium → Redirects or the Redirection plugin (exact match, 301). Server-level alternatives: ```apache # .htaccess, avant le bloc WordPress RewriteEngine On RewriteRule ^inventeur-dun-sac-a-dos-en-apesanteur/?$ https://gravipack.com/sac-a-dos-exosquelette-fonctionnement/ [R=301,L] RewriteRule ^et-si-votre-sac-a-dos-ne-pesait-presque-plus-rien/?$ https://gravipack.com/sac-a-dos-exosquelette-fonctionnement/ [R=301,L] ``` ```nginx location = /inventeur-dun-sac-a-dos-en-apesanteur/ { return 301 https://gravipack.com/sac-a-dos-exosquelette-fonctionnement/; } ``` - If the 'évolution du portage' post earns links on its own, keep it as a history article that links to the explainer. - Update internal links with Better Search Replace so that none goes through a redirect. 3. **Write the page answer-first.** - Title tag: « Sac à dos exosquelette : comment ça marche ? | Gravipack » (about 55 characters). - H1: « Sac à dos exosquelette : définition et fonctionnement ». - Definition box in the first 60 words: > « Un sac à dos exosquelette est un sac dont les bretelles intègrent une structure rigide passive, sans moteur ni capteur. Chez Gravipack, des inserts rigides intégrés aux bretelles reportent une partie de la charge des épaules vers les hanches, par l'intermédiaire de la ceinture. Le poids du sac ne change pas : c'est la répartition de la pression qui change. » - Add « brevetés » and the publication number once the patents fix confirms them. - Then add these H2 sections, written as questions: - « Comment fonctionne l'exosquelette ? », with a force-path diagram: shoulders → inserts → hip belt. - « Le sac est-il plus léger ? ». Answer no, and give the empty weight of each model in grams, plus the weight the inserts add. - « Ce que l'exosquelette ne fait pas »: no motor, no sensors, no automatic adjustment, no weight removed. Say where the load goes; this answers the lower-back critique. - « Quels modèles Gravipack sont équipés ? » - « Sac classique, dos tendu en filet (type Osprey Anti-Gravity) ou exosquelette : quelles différences ? ». Use a factual table: where the load passes, empty weight, adjustment, ventilation. Naming Osprey here is acceptable nominative use. - « Brevets et distinctions ». Use only facts the patents and awards fixes have sourced. Verify the Concours Lépine silver medal year; the legacy page gives none and the press says 2018. - Quote measured results only by linking to the evidence page (study fix). Do not repeat '-92 %' here. - Embed the existing 'Exosquelette breveté Gravipack sac a dos - Vidéo 3D' (homKGDpmhOA) and link the bretelles adjustment guide. - Meta description: « Qu'est-ce qu'un sac à dos exosquelette ? Définition, fonctionnement des inserts dans les bretelles, ce que l'exosquelette fait (et ne fait pas) et modèles équipés. » - Schema: the Article (or WebPage) and BreadcrumbList that Yoast or Rank Math generates, with author, datePublished and a visible dateModified. 4. **Link it from every product page that has the exoskeleton.** - Use a global product tab (`woocommerce_product_tabs` filter or a custom-tabs plugin) or a line in the short description: « Comment fonctionne l'exosquelette Gravipack → ». - Also link it from the use-case category intros and /faq/. 5. **Adopt one canonical descriptor** and use it verbatim in the About page, Organization `description`, category intros, marketplace brand text, the press kit and the YouTube, Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn bios: > « Gravipack est une marque française de sacs à dos dont les bretelles intègrent un exosquelette qui reporte une partie de la charge des épaules vers les hanches. » - Stop using « apesanteur » as a product descriptor on owned pages. The presta pages are handled by the legacy-subdomain 301s. Update the Facebook bio. - Ask the Decathlon seller to drop « Allège la charge de 92% » from listing titles; that goes through the licensee and health-claims fixes. 6. **Fix the misleading title suffix** in the titles fix. It looks like the WordPress or Yoast 'Site name' is set to « Gravipack, le sac à dos exosquelette anti-mal de dos homme femme enfant ». Set it to « Gravipack » (Yoast → Réglages → Paramètres du site, or Rank Math → Titres & méta) and use `%%title%% %%sep%% %%sitename%%` (Rank Math: `%title% %sep% %sitename%`). 7. **Make exoskeleton status explicit per product.** - Add a WooCommerce attribute (Produits → Attributs) « Technologie de portage » with the terms « Exosquelette » and « Sans exosquelette (bretelles EVA à mémoire de forme) ». - Tick 'Visible on product page' and leave 'Enable archives' off, to avoid creating another thin attribute archive. - Products without inserts come out of the 'tous-les-sacs-a-dos-exosquelette' tree. 8. **Move off-entity items into the existing accessories category.** - Battery, paracord bracelet, dragonne and porte-clé go to /categorie-produit/accessoires-sac-a-dos/ or a sub-category « Équipement outdoor ». Fix their '-copie' slugs in the duplicate-products fix. - Turn 'fabrication professionnelle / cadeaux d'entreprise' into a B2B page (B2B fix) and 301 the product URL to it.

findings.title: #25 No Wikidata or Wikipedia entity exists for Gravipack; searches return only lookalike brands
findings.description:
**No entry on Wikidata, Wikipedia or Crunchbase.** A search for 'Gravipack' restricted to wikipedia.org, wikidata.org and crunchbase.com returned only lookalikes:
- Crunchbase: gravitas-packaging, grinpack, gravic, gpack
- Wikipedia: Greif, Gravity Payments, Gravit, Graphic Packaging, Grav (software), Gravitar

None of the 33 phase-2 result sets, and none of about 60 phase-1 sets, contained a Gravipack page on those domains. This is absence evidence from a non-Google search tool, so confidence is 'likely'. Whether a Google knowledge panel exists could not be observed.

**Name collisions make disambiguation harder:**
- 'Mohammed Errafi Gravipack LinkedIn' returned the packaging firm Gravis (cbinsights, dealroom, preqin) and gracepack.
- A phase-1 query returned unrelated Wikipedia namesakes (Mohammed Al-Rufrafi, Mohammed Errafai).
- A YouTube search showed an unrelated 'Zero Gravity™' channel (UC-yPO91aYTm4g886iApv-vw) next to the official channel, whose display name is 'Gravipack zero gravity backpack'.
- An unrelated Instagram account, @granipack (26K), sits next to @gravipack.

**Entity sources that do exist:**
- the LinkedIn company page fr.linkedin.com/company/gravipack. It ranked #2 for 'gravipack' in one sampled run and dropped out in a re-run, because brand results were volatile across runs.
- the founder's profile linkedin.com/in/errafi/
- the YouTube channel @Gravipack, plus Instagram and Facebook
- registry pages: annuaire-entreprises.data.gouv.fr, societe.com, Pappers, rubypayeur
- Les Pépites Tech, and the directory motherbase.ai (my.motherbase.ai/startup/107826-gravipack, which shows Vincennes and 'created 2018')

Phase 1 described motherbase.ai as 'AI-generated'; that is unverified and is dropped here. Phase 1 also said 'no LinkedIn'; that is wrong and dropped.

These profiles disagree with each other:
- LinkedIn shows a '201-500 employees' band, while its structured data says 5 employees.
- LinkedIn gives the HQ as Vincennes, Facebook says Sens, and the mentions légales say Paris.

So there is no neutral, referenced record for engines to settle on.

**Registry facts available for a referenced record:**
- Legal entity: EXOSQUELETTE LIGHT SAS, SIREN 840 543 383, NAF 77.40Z.
- Created 12/06/2018 in Sens (89) as GRAVIBAG.
- Renamed GRAVIPACK on 01/07/2022, and EXOSQUELETTE LIGHT by an AGE of 02/01/2025 (BODACC of 28/02/2025).
- Seats: Sens 2018–2022; 46 rue de la Bienfaisance, 94300 Vincennes, 2022–2026; 10 rue de la Paix, 75002 Paris, since 19/05/2026.
- President and founder: Mohammed Errafi.
- Independent coverage: franceinfo, France Bleu (ici), Europe 1, Journal du Geek (2021), Maddyness (Feb 2024), and the INPI Trophées 2022 finalist page.

The patent part of the phase-1 finding moves to the patents finding.

A missing Wikipedia article is normal for a company of this size and is not a ranking factor in itself.

Why it matters: Wikidata is a structured, referenced source that knowledge graphs and LLM retrieval use to resolve a name to one entity. claude-seo's seo-geo lists Wikipedia and Wikidata presence among the strongest AI-citation signals; Profound (2025) reports that Wikipedia is 47.9 % of ChatGPT's top-10 cited sources.

Without such a record, engines describe Gravipack from directories and its own profiles, which conflict on HQ, company name and headcount. The 'Grav*' lookalikes and the 'Zero Gravity' channel also add noise.

It is an AI-visibility and brand-SERP opportunity, not a ranking fix, hence Medium.

Effect on SEO: A referenced Wikidata item with consistent identifiers gives Organization `sameAs` an authoritative anchor. It improves the odds of a knowledge panel for 'gravipack' and of correct facts in AI answers: legal name, HQ, founding year, official site.

It also helps AI answers separate Gravipack from Gravis, Gravitas Packaging and the 'Zero Gravity' channel.

Impact 4/10 · Effort Low · Confidence likely
findings.recommendation: 1. **Settle the facts first.** Use the master fact sheet from the entity-facts fix: legal name, current seat and canonical domain. Never present Vincennes as the current seat. 2. **Check for existing items.** Search Wikidata for « Gravipack », « Gravibag » and « Exosquelette Light » to avoid creating a duplicate. 3. **Edit transparently.** Use a named account. On its user page, disclose the conflict of interest (« Je représente Gravipack / EXOSQUELETTE LIGHT SAS »), following Wikidata's COI guidance. Keep wording neutral, and add no claims such as 'anti mal de dos', '92 %' or a patent count. 4. **Create the item.** - Label fr/en « Gravipack ». - Description fr « marque française de sacs à dos à exosquelette », en « French backpack brand with a load-transferring exoskeleton in the shoulder straps ». - Aliases « EXOSQUELETTE LIGHT », « GRAVIBAG ». - Statements. Check every property and Q-id in the Wikidata interface before saving. - P31 instance of = business (Q4830453). A separate brand item (Q431289) linked to the company is optional later. - P17 country = France (Q142). - P571 inception = 12 June 2018. - P1448 official name, with P580 start / P582 end qualifiers: « GRAVIBAG » (2018-06-12 → 2022-07-01), « GRAVIPACK » (2022-07-01 → 2025-01-02), « EXOSQUELETTE LIGHT » (from 2025-01-02). - P159 headquarters location: - Sens: start 2018, end 2022. - Vincennes: start 2022, end 2026-05-19. - Paris (Q90): start 2026-05-19, preferred rank, with P6375 street address « 10 rue de la Paix, 75002 Paris ». - P112 founded by = Mohammed Errafi. Link a person item only if one exists or can be created with independent references (inventor coverage). Otherwise leave it out rather than create a thin item. - P856 official website = the canonical URL. - P1616 SIREN = 840543383. - P2003 Instagram username = gravipack. - P2013 Facebook username = gravipack. - P4264 LinkedIn company ID = gravipack. - P2397 YouTube channel ID = the official channel's UC… ID, taken from YouTube Studio → Paramètres → Chaîne → Paramètres avancés. Not UC-yPO91aYTm4g886iApv-vw, which is the unrelated 'Zero Gravity™' channel. - P166 award received: only for awards the awards fix confirms with an independent source. - References: add a P854 reference URL and P813 retrieval date to every statement, citing independent sources. Use annuaire-entreprises.data.gouv.fr or BODACC for registry facts, and INPI, Journal du Geek, Maddyness, France Bleu and Europe 1 for the rest. Never cite gravipack.com alone. 5. **Align the other profiles.** - Create or claim a Crunchbase organisation profile with the same facts: legal name, founded 2018, HQ Paris, canonical website, LinkedIn. - Correct the LinkedIn page: HQ Paris 75002, a real employee band instead of 201-500, the canonical website. 6. **Add the Wikidata URL to Organization `sameAs`.** The Organization finding owns the full markup. In Yoast: Réglages → Représentation du site → Autres profils. Or use a filter: ```php add_filter( 'wpseo_schema_organization', function ( $data ) { $data['sameAs'][] = 'https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q_____'; // ID de l'élément créé return $data; } ); ``` Rank Math: Titres & méta → Référencement local → profils sociaux, or the `rank_math/json_ld` filter. Use only profiles that represent the entity: Wikidata, LinkedIn, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook. Do not list Trustpilot, the Decathlon brand page or KKBB. 7. **Leave Wikipedia for later.** Do not write a French Wikipedia article now. Notability for companies requires at least two independent, centred, national secondary sources published at least two years apart. The 2021 and 2024 coverage may get there, but an article should come from independent editors, or carry the mandatory COI disclosure. 8. **Claim the knowledge panel** if one appears for 'Gravipack', using Google's verification flow with an account tied to the official site or YouTube channel. Create a Google Business Profile only for a staffed, customer-facing address (local fix).

findings.title: #31 AI and search crawler access, server rendering, Bing coverage and llms.txt need an on-site check
findings.description:
Nothing in this finding could be checked. The sandbox network policy blocked:
- robots.txt on every host (gravipack.com, www.gravipack.com, presta.gravipack.com, gravipack.fr)
- response headers and WAF / CDN behaviour
- the rendered versus raw HTML
- /llms.txt

The PageSpeed Insights / Lighthouse run also failed, with HTTP 429 (quota), recorded in scratchpad data/psi_fr_mobile.json. No Bing Webmaster Tools data was available.

What is known:
- The site is WordPress + WooCommerce: /produit/, /categorie-produit/ and ?add-to-cart= URLs are indexed. WooCommerce is usually server-rendered, but page builders, AJAX-loaded tabs and JS sliders can keep product text out of the initial HTML.
- The mentions légales name Gandi as the host. Whether a CDN or WAF sits in front is unknown.
- Search results show no sign either way about llms.txt.

The severity is a placeholder. Escalate it to **Critical** if robots.txt or the WAF blocks Googlebot, Bingbot, OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot or PerplexityBot on the canonical host. Escalate it to **High** if product descriptions, prices or FAQ answers appear only after JavaScript runs.

Why it matters: An engine can only cite pages its search crawler is allowed to fetch and can read in the HTML. Each crawler controls a different engine:
- **Search and answer crawlers (must be allowed):** OAI-SearchBot (ChatGPT search), Claude-SearchBot (Claude search), PerplexityBot (Perplexity), Googlebot (Search, AI Overviews and AI Mode) and Bingbot (Bing and Copilot).
- **Training-only tokens (a business choice; they do not affect citation):** GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, CCBot and Applebot-Extended.

llms.txt is optional:
- It carries zero weight in claude-seo's GEO score.
- Google's AI optimisation guide says Google Search ignores it, and no major AI search provider has confirmed using it.
- Lighthouse has an llms-txt audit, but a missing file is reported as informational only.

Effect on SEO: If a search crawler is blocked, or the content is injected by JavaScript, that engine cannot cite the site at all. If access is open and the HTML is server-rendered, nothing here limits visibility.

Bing coverage matters because Copilot draws on the Bing index. llms.txt has no expected effect on Google; at most it might help a little with non-Google agents.

Impact 3/10 · Effort Low · Confidence needs-on-site-check
findings.recommendation: 1. **Read robots.txt on every host.** ```bash for h in gravipack.com www.gravipack.com presta.gravipack.com gravipack.fr; do echo "== $h"; curl -s https://$h/robots.txt; done ``` - List each user-agent group separately. - Remember that a named group replaces `User-agent: *` entirely for that bot (RFC 9309), so rules in `*` do not reach a bot that has its own group. - A 5xx on robots.txt makes compliant crawlers treat the whole site as disallowed. 2. **Edit robots.txt** in Yoast (Outils → Éditeur de fichiers), in Rank Math (Réglages généraux → Modifier robots.txt) or as a physical file. - Do not disallow the search crawlers. - Blocking training crawlers is optional and is the owner's decision. Example: ``` User-agent: * Disallow: /wp-admin/ Allow: /wp-admin/admin-ajax.php # Facultatif : refuser l'entraînement des modèles (choix commercial) User-agent: GPTBot User-agent: ClaudeBot User-agent: Google-Extended User-agent: CCBot User-agent: Applebot-Extended Disallow: / Sitemap: https://gravipack.com/sitemap_index.xml ``` - Parameter rules for ?add-to-cart= and ?order= follow the parameter-URL fix's order: noindex first, Disallow only later. - Optionally add a `Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=<choix>` line inside each group. This is a Cloudflare policy with no confirmed effect on Google. 3. **Test the WAF by user agent.** ```bash for ua in Googlebot bingbot OAI-SearchBot Claude-SearchBot PerplexityBot; do printf '%-18s' $ua; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' -A "Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; $ua)" https://gravipack.com/produit/<slug>/; done ``` - Each should return 200, with no challenge page. - Spoofing the user agent only tests rules based on user agents. Also check the server or WAF logs for real, verified crawler IPs (openai.com/searchbot.json, claude.com/crawling/bots.json, perplexity.com/perplexitybot.json, Google and Bing reverse DNS). Do not IP-block Anthropic's or OpenAI's crawlers, and keep CAPTCHAs off content pages. - The response headers (`server`, `cf-ray`, etc.) show whether a CDN or WAF is in front of the site. 4. **Confirm that content is in the server HTML.** - Run `curl -s https://gravipack.com/produit/<slug>/ | grep -c 'exosquelette'` and check that the product description, price and FAQ answers are present without JavaScript. - In Search Console, use URL Inspection → Tester l'URL en direct → Afficher la page explorée. - Or run claude-seo `render_page.py --mode auto` and `agentic_check.py`. 5. **Search Console:** check that the 'Search generative AI' property setting, available to all sites since 31/08/2026, is left on 'include', the default. Do not use the Indexing API; it only covers JobPosting and BroadcastEvent pages. 6. **Bing Webmaster Tools.** - Import the property from Search Console, or verify by DNS (there is no 'Domain property' type). - Submit the canonical sitemap and check coverage of the canonical host. - Enable IndexNow through Rank Math → Instant Indexing or Microsoft's IndexNow plugin. 7. **Optionally, and last**, publish /llms.txt at the root of the canonical host. Present it as a convenience for non-Google agents, never as a ranking lever. ``` # Gravipack > Marque française de sacs à dos dont les bretelles intègrent un exosquelette qui reporte une partie de la charge des épaules vers les hanches. Société : EXOSQUELETTE LIGHT SAS, Paris. ## Comprendre - [Sac à dos exosquelette : comment ça marche ?](https://gravipack.com/sac-a-dos-exosquelette-fonctionnement/) - [FAQ](https://gravipack.com/faq/) - [Régler les bretelles exosquelette](https://gravipack.com/comment-regler-les-bretelles-exosquelette-de-mon-gravipack/) ## Produits - [Tous les sacs à dos exosquelette](https://gravipack.com/categorie-produit/tous-les-sacs-a-dos-exosquelette/) ## Entreprise - [À propos](https://gravipack.com/a-propos-de-nous-gravipack-au-service-de-votre-dos/) ``` - Make sure unknown URLs return a real 404, not a soft-404 200. A catch-all 200 also fails Lighthouse's llms-txt audit. 8. **Once quota allows,** run Lighthouse's Agentic Browsing category and report the result as X/N passed audits.

findings.title: #34 FAQ and category intros may not be written as self-contained answers (verify on-site)
findings.description:
This is a hypothesis to verify, not a confirmed defect.

**What is indexed:**
- /faq/ on the www host, titled 'Foire Aux Questions des sacs à dos exosquelettes Gravipack' (58 characters). Search summaries say it covers sizing and custom fitting by height and weight, and cabin baggage. One summary quotes it as saying the bag « évacue jusqu'à 92 % de la charge ». That figure comes from an unpublished study and is stated inconsistently as weight, load or pressure; the study and health-claims findings deal with it.
- The how-to /comment-regler-les-bretelles-exosquelette-de-mon-gravipack/, which ranked #1 for a site-restricted sizing and adjustment query.
- Product pages, which say each bag is personalised free of charge to the buyer's height and weight (±10 cm / ±8 kg). That is citable fit information that could be stated once, clearly.

**What we could not see:**
- the heading levels, answer lengths and order of the FAQ
- whether answers load in the HTML or through JavaScript accordions
- whether the use-case category pages have intro text

In the sampled results, 0 of 25+ informational queries returned a gravipack.com URL, so these pages are not yet being picked up for question-type searches.

Why it matters: In claude-seo's seo-geo scoring, citability counts for 25 % and structural readability for 20 %, so 45 % of the GEO score. Both reward:
- question-style H2/H3 headings
- a direct answer in the first 40–60 words
- passages that make sense on their own
- key answers near the top (SE Ranking finds about 44 % of AI citations come from the first 30 % of a page)

Google says content does not need to be chunked for AI. Clear Q&A simply serves readers and answer engines alike.

FAQ rich results are not available to Gravipack. Google restricted them to authoritative government and health sites in August 2023, and claude-seo's schema reference records them as retired for all sites from 7 May 2026. So the value of this work is users and AI citability, not a SERP feature.

Effect on SEO: Well-structured answers raise the chance that Gravipack's own wording is quoted in AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity and Copilot for 'gravipack' + question searches (weight, adjustment, sizing, where to buy) and for category questions. Without them, these answers come from forums and marketplace reviews.

It also stops the FAQ from being the quoted source of a figure that is not yet substantiated.

Impact 3/10 · Effort Low · Confidence needs-on-site-check
findings.recommendation: 1. **Restructure /faq/ into themed sections:** Fonctionnement, Choisir et régler, Commande et garantie. - One H2 per theme and one H3 per question, written the way users ask. - Answer in 40–60 words that make sense on their own, then add detail. - Put the most-asked questions in the top third of the page, and add a jump-link table of contents. 2. **Keep answers in the initial HTML.** - Native `<details><summary>` or Gutenberg heading + paragraph blocks are fine. - Avoid accordions that load answers by AJAX on click (check with curl or Search Console URL Inspection). 3. **Example answers** (fill in the bracketed facts): - **« Le sac Gravipack est-il plus léger qu'un sac classique ? »** > « Non. L'exosquelette ne réduit pas le poids du sac : un Gravipack pèse [X g] à vide. Les inserts rigides intégrés aux bretelles reportent une partie de la charge des épaules vers les hanches, par la ceinture. Le poids total reste le même ; c'est la répartition de la pression qui change. » - **« Comment choisir et régler mon Gravipack ? »** > « Chaque sac est personnalisé gratuitement selon votre taille et votre poids (tolérance ±10 cm / ±8 kg) [vérifier]. À réception, réglez la ceinture sur les hanches, puis les bretelles et le rappel de charge : suivez notre guide pas à pas et sa vidéo. » Link the bretelles guide here. - **« Comment fonctionne l'exosquelette ? »**: a two-sentence summary linking to the 'sac à dos exosquelette' explainer. - **« Où acheter Gravipack ? »**: list the official channels, as in the where-to-buy finding. - **« Quelle garantie ? »**: state the current CGV terms. Do not reuse the crowdfunding-era '10 ans' unless it still applies. 4. **Claim-sensitive questions.** - « Que signifie le chiffre de 92 % ? »: publish only after the evidence page exists. Say what was measured (pressure or load), by whom, when and on how many people, and link the source. Until then, remove « évacue jusqu'à 92 % de la charge » (study and health-claims findings). - « Le sac Gravipack est-il remboursé ? »: include only if reimbursement is real and documented. Phase 2 found no LPP listing, and the source behind the claim describes employer funding. If there is no documentation, leave the question out. 5. **Category intros.** Open each use-case category with a 40–60-word answer-first paragraph above the product grid. For the hiking category: > « Les sacs à dos de randonnée Gravipack intègrent un exosquelette dans les bretelles qui reporte une partie de la charge vers les hanches. Ils existent en [volumes] et se règlent selon votre taille. » Add 3–5 short Q&As below the grid. Edit the category description in WooCommerce → Produits → Catégories; if the theme shows descriptions only below the grid, use the theme's category-header option or a hook. 6. **Markup.** - The Yoast or Rank Math FAQ blocks output FAQPage markup automatically. Existing FAQPage markup can stay; it is harmless and worth only an Info note. Do not add it expecting a rich result. - Keep the BreadcrumbList and WebPage markup the plugins generate. - Show a visible 'Mis à jour le' date.

findings.title: #42 The YouTube channel is named 'zero gravity backpack' and uses medical wording; the social and community footprint is small or stale
findings.description:
**YouTube: the channel exists and ranks. Its name and description are the problem, not its size.**

In the 'gravipack' results we sampled, youtube.com/@Gravipack and /c/Gravipack ranked #3–#4 in one run and #2–#3 in a re-run; positions were volatile. Phase-1 claims of 'no YouTube presence' and a 'missing video list' are withdrawn.

The channel already has playlists: 'Contenants des sacs à dos Gravipack', 'Gravipackers : militaires, randonneurs, jacquets, enfants' and 'Les Exosquelettes Gravipack'.

It also has per-model and B2B videos:
- Tokyo (stVloflCKp8)
- Rome (XWKZ-PsU-VE)
- Light Promax (5rGu1ntLvRw)
- MedMax for pompiers and urgentistes (5RNn93sinxo)
- RATPLovesStartUp (1Xq8EKyINTw)
- a 3D exoskeleton video (homKGDpmhOA)
- a founder interview (V0CuNW4N9Q8)
- a school-bag video (aqvti5NwaE0)
- a user testimonial (O_9o6-6tw4s)

TV and third-party videos also rank:
- C8 'William à midi', June 2024 (rhduWNbpPko)
- Samuel Etienne (5DELA6ARIIc)
- 'JE TESTE UN SAC À DOS AVEC DES EXOSQUELETTES - GRAVIPACK' (7AsOwX_9R2w, owner unknown)
- 'Ce Sac est à Avoir !' (Z0eU4T6bNHE)

The newest indexed upload dates from about mid-June 2025, so nothing has been indexed for roughly 16 months. The channel's structured data shows an unlabelled count of 766; it is unclear what it measures, so we do not call the channel small.

What still needs fixing:
- The display name 'Gravipack zero gravity backpack' clashes with the 'exosquelette' descriptor. It also sits next to an unrelated 'Zero Gravity™' channel in results.
- The channel description cites a 2019 'étude scientifique et médicale' and frames the bag as a preventive health device. How to substantiate that belongs to the study and health-claims findings.

Decathlon Hiking 33 reviewers say adjustment is difficult. The site has /comment-regler-les-bretelles-exosquelette-de-mon-gravipack/, which ranked #1 for a site-restricted sizing and adjustment query. Search summaries mention a settings PDF and an adjustment video linked from product pages, but whether that video exists and is embedded is unconfirmed.

**Other social profiles:**
- **Facebook:** about 2,440 followers and 2,161 likes (two captures). The bio reads 'Sac a Dos en Apesanteur - Innovation Française' and the page places the brand in Sens. Older posts use the 'Atlas 33' model name. It hosts BFM TV and 'testé et approuvé par la FNAC' videos and has a /reviews/ tab.
- **Instagram @gravipack:** about 23K followers and 196 posts, but that is a snapshot from around March 2023, not a current figure. An unrelated lookalike, @granipack (26K), exists.
- **LinkedIn company page:** 1,850–1,884 followers. The latest indexed company post is from 27/09/2023 and the founder's from 14/10/2023. Social posts are only partly indexed, so this does not prove inactivity.
- **TikTok and Pinterest:** no account found in generic or domain-filtered searches. Both are poorly indexed, so absence does not prove the brand has no account.

**Community:**
- Two open-web queries returned no reddit.com URL: 'gravipack reddit' and 'Gravipack backpack exoskeleton straps review reddit'. The tool cannot search reddit.com directly, so this is absence evidence only.
- The community discussion that does surface is randonner-leger.org (e.g. pid 626046 and 626048, thread id=37663) and forum.bushwalk.com (2024, sceptical: the 'weightless' bag weighs 890 g, the waist belt does the work, 'just another con').
- For a French niche brand, a Reddit gap is normal.

Why it matters: The YouTube channel and social profiles are among the first things people see when they search the brand, and engines use their names and bios to describe the entity. A channel called 'zero gravity backpack', with a medical-sounding description, spreads the wrong descriptor and an unsupported claim.

claude-seo's seo-geo cites an Ahrefs 75k-brand study in which YouTube mentions had the strongest correlation with AI visibility (~0.737). That is a correlation and depends on methodology, so treat it as directional.

With uploads paused since mid-2025, recent practical questions about adjustment and sizing are answered by forums and marketplace reviews.

Follower counts are not a ranking factor. Hence Low.

Effect on SEO: The effect is indirect:
- The brand-SERP profiles would match the site's descriptor.
- Video results become possible for how-to queries, mainly where the video is the page's main content.
- AI engines get more corroborating sources, consistent `sameAs` targets and fresher, dated mentions.
- Disclosed answers on forums give engines a brand-side view to set against the sceptical threads they surface by default.

Impact 3/10 · Effort Medium · Confidence likely
findings.recommendation: 1. **Rename the channel and clean the description.** - Name: « Gravipack » (YouTube Studio → Personnalisation → Informations de base). Keep the @Gravipack handle. - New description: > « Gravipack conçoit des sacs à dos dont les bretelles intègrent un exosquelette qui reporte une partie de la charge des épaules vers les hanches. Tutoriels de réglage, présentation des modèles, tests terrain. Site officiel : https://gravipack.com » - Remove the 'étude scientifique et médicale' wording. Once the evidence page exists (study finding), link it neutrally instead. - Add links to the site, LinkedIn and Instagram. 2. **Make the next videos answer the questions people actually ask.** The per-model series already exists. - (a) « Comment régler les bretelles exosquelette de votre Gravipack », 3–5 min with chapters. Embed it as the main content of /comment-regler-les-bretelles-exosquelette-de-mon-gravipack/. This answers the Decathlon complaints about adjustment. - (b) Measured empty weight and volume per model, shown on a scale and with a measuring method. - (c) The 3D video, re-cut as the explainer for the 'sac à dos exosquelette' page. - (d) Shorts cut from the C8 and BFM segments, if you hold the rights. - Then keep a dated cadence, for example one upload a month. 3. **Make every video description useful.** - First line: a link to the matching product or guide URL on the canonical host (optionally `?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video`). - French chapters. - Uploaded, checked French captions (.srt) rather than auto-captions only. LLMs read the transcript. 4. **Embed videos on the site.** - Use the WordPress YouTube embed block. - Add VideoObject markup with Yoast Video SEO or Rank Math (Schema → Vidéo): name, description, thumbnailUrl, uploadDate, duration, embedUrl. - Video rich results appear mainly when the video is the page's main content, so expect them on the guide page, not on product pages. On product pages, the embed still helps users and gives AI engines context. 5. **Ask third-party creators** (e.g. the owner of 7AsOwX_9R2w) and the TV channels, where possible, to add a gravipack.com link to their video descriptions. 6. **Align every bio** with the canonical descriptor and the current facts. - Facebook: replace « Sac a Dos en Apesanteur » and update the location from Sens. - Instagram: bio and link. - LinkedIn: HQ Paris 75002, a real employee band. - Post dated updates regularly. LinkedIn suits B2B proof points, such as RATP's VivaTech 2023 deployment (about 50 roaming maintenance workers equipped, per RATP's own pages). 7. **Treat TikTok and Pinterest as optional.** Open them only if the team can sustain them, e.g. Pinterest boards for back-to-school and hiking that link product pages. Do not expect ranking gains from follower counts. 8. **Join community discussions openly. Never astroturf.** - Answer substantive randonner-leger.org and bushwalk.com threads from a disclosed brand or founder account, with data: empty weight, how the load is transferred, a link to the explainer and evidence pages. - Lend bags to independent long-distance hikers for honest, disclosed trip reports. - On Reddit, take part only where the topic comes up, with disclosure. Never buy upvotes or post as a 'customer'. 9. **List the renamed YouTube channel, Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn** in Organization `sameAs` and in Wikidata (P2397, P2003, P2013, P4264).

findings.title: #30 Product, Offer and review markup and the Merchant Center setup cannot be verified, and the Content API for Shopping has been sunset (verify on-site)
findings.description:
**We could not check the markup or Merchant Center.** The sandbox network policy blocked gravipack.com, and the search tool shows no Shopping units. So the current Product and Offer markup and any Merchant Center account status are unknown. WooCommerce outputs Product and Offer JSON-LD by default (an AggregateOffer for variable products). The task is to check completeness and accuracy, not to assume the markup is absent.

**Evidence that would block or weaken merchant listings if markup or a feed repeats it:**

1. **Several prices for one model on gravipack.com itself.** Search snippets, 12/10/2026, capture dates unknown:
   - Sherpa: bleu 119 € (struck price 249 €), orange and kaki 149,90 €, orange 99 € in a promo list.
   - Tokyo: 189 € on one page, 129 € (was 249 €) on another.
   - Pearl: 89 € (was 99,90 €) on one page, 119 € in a list.

   Google disapproves offers when the feed price, the structured-data price and the visible price differ.
2. **Variant structure.**
   - Each colour has its own URL: Sherpa bleu, 45L orange and kaki; Hiking 30L gris and terracotta; Oslo rouge; Pearl 29L gris.
   - A second base path, /produit-gravipack/, holds exact duplicates. The Sherpa Kaki title appears on 3 URLs. Light Promax has 3 URLs; Cargo Max, Business Talk V4 25L and G-Pack have 2 each; two slugs end in '-copie'.
   - Without ProductGroup and variesBy markup, or a single variable product, Google sees near-duplicate, unrelated products.
3. **Review display.**
   - Search snippets of product pages (Rome, Kingston, Hiking Terracotta, Tokyo, Hiking Gris, Sherpa Kaki…) show an 'Avis Google 4,7' badge with hard-coded counts that do not match: 'plus de 1121 avis', 'plus de 1126 avis', and 'plus de 1175 avis' on an 'Avis Google des clients Gravipack' page.
   - **Correction to the earlier hypothesis:** the rating is not uncorroborated. A directory page (groupe-ranque.fr) reports 4,7/5 from 998 Google reviews for Gravipack Vincennes. A blog (compostelle-autrement.com) reports 4,8/5 from 900+. Both are weak sources, but they fit a real Google Business Profile that keeps gaining reviews.
   - The real problems are the inconsistent hard-coded counts, and the risk that this business-level rating is marked up as a Product aggregateRating.
   - Third-party ratings are lower: Trustpilot 3,1/5 (9 reviews; profile claimed since Dec 2020; negative reviews from June 2026 still unanswered), Decathlon brand page 3,88/5 (16), Decathlon collection 4,1/5 (26), Fnac Road Adventure about 3/5 (8).
   - No evidence of on-site product reviews was found. /gravipackers/ is a testimonials page, not product reviews.
4. **Identifiers.** No GTIN or EAN appeared in any official listing snippet, although the same models are sold on Decathlon, Fnac and Nature & Découvertes, which normally require EANs.
5. **Channel context.**
   - No Gravipack offer was found on Amazon.fr.
   - Cdiscount's /r-gravipack.html is an internal search page that returns lookalike products.
   - In the model queries we sampled, marketplace and reseller listings (Decathlon, Nature & Découvertes, Au Vieux Campeur, Ergo-Corner) often rank above the official product page.
   - Google free listings are the main comparison surface where the official offer could appear beside them.
6. **Feed API.** The Content API for Shopping was sunset on 18/08/2026. It has returned intermittent HTTP 410 errors since 01/09/2026 and shuts down completely in early 2027. A WooCommerce feed plugin still on that API silently stops updating prices and stock. Scheduled-fetch, manual and Google Sheets feeds are not affected.
7. **Legacy store.** presta.gravipack.com still shows the Feather at 149 € 'in stock', although the model is no longer in the main store.

**When to raise the severity:**
- **Medium** if product pages have missing or invalid Product markup, or Merchant Center shows disapprovals.
- **High** if the 'Avis Google 4,7' badge is output as a Product aggregateRating.

Why it matters: - **Required data.** Merchant listings need a name, an image and an Offer with a price above zero and a priceCurrency. GTIN, shippingDetails and hasMerchantReturnPolicy add annotations and improve product matching.
- **Price mismatches.** Google compares the visible price, the structured-data price and the feed price, and disapproves offers that differ. gravipack.com already shows 2 to 3 prices for the same model.
- **Review rules.** Google's review-snippet guidelines exclude ratings collected on other sites, so the 'Avis Google 4,7' badge is a policy risk if it is marked up. Misusing review markup can lead to a structured-data manual action that removes product rich results across the site.
- **Feed API.** Since the Content API sunset, a feed plugin that has not migrated stops updating prices and stock. That creates mismatches on its own.

Effect on SEO: - Valid Offer and ProductGroup markup plus an approved Merchant Center feed make the official store eligible for merchant-listing displays in Search (price, availability, strikethrough price, shipping and return annotations) and for free listings in the Shopping tab and Images.
- In model queries where Decathlon, Nature & Découvertes, Au Vieux Campeur and Ergo-Corner currently appear, the official offer could then show next to them.
- Product snippets (stars) are possible only from on-site product reviews.
- Price mismatches cause item disapprovals. Ratings borrowed from Google or Trustpilot risk a manual action.
- No direct effect on organic rankings.

Impact 5/10 · Effort Medium · Confidence needs-on-site-check
findings.recommendation: 1. **Baseline first (verify on-site, no changes yet).** - Run the Rich Results Test on Sherpa bleu, Sherpa kaki, Pearl 29L gris, Tokyo, Kingston and /boutique-gravipack/. - For each, record: - which tool outputs the markup (WooCommerce core, Yoast WooCommerce SEO, Rank Math, a review widget) and how many Product nodes there are; - Offer or AggregateOffer (merchant listings need an Offer per variant); - price compared with the visible price, priceCurrency and availability; - brand and gtin; - aggregateRating and its source; - shippingDetails and hasMerchantReturnPolicy. - In Search Console, open the Shopping reports: Fiches de marchand and Extraits de produits. - In Merchant Center, check whether an account exists, whether the canonical host is verified and claimed, what the product source is, and what Diagnostics shows. - If everything is complete, valid and approved, close this item. 2. **One price per variant, everywhere** (do this with the price-parity fix). - The visible price, Offer.price and the feed price must be identical. - For promotions, keep the selling price in `price` and put the reference price in a price specification of type StrikethroughPrice. Give the sale window with validFrom and validThrough. Do not rely on priceValidUntil: it does not apply to price specifications. - Under French law the struck price must be the lowest price charged in the 30 days before the reduction (Code de la consommation L112-1-1). The 249 € reference prices need checking. ```json "offers": { "@type": "Offer", "url": "https://gravipack.com/produit/<sherpa-45>/?attribute_pa_couleur=bleu", "price": "119.00", "priceCurrency": "EUR", "priceSpecification": { "@type": "UnitPriceSpecification", "priceType": "https://schema.org/StrikethroughPrice", "price": "149.90", "priceCurrency": "EUR" }, "validFrom": "2026-11-01T00:00:00+01:00", "validThrough": "2026-11-30T23:59:59+01:00", "availability": "https://schema.org/InStock", "itemCondition": "https://schema.org/NewCondition", "seller": { "@id": "https://gravipack.com/#organization" } } ``` The prices above are illustrative; use the real live prices. 3. **Variants** (do this with the duplicate-URL fix). Choose one model: - **(A)** One WooCommerce variable product per model (attribute « Couleur »). 301-redirect the old colour URLs, every /produit-gravipack/ duplicate and the '-copie' URLs to it. - **(B)** Keep self-canonical colour pages, each marked up as a variant of one ProductGroup with isVariantOf. Either way, output ProductGroup with variesBy and productGroupID, and use the same ID as item_group_id in the feed. Never canonicalise colour pages to a parent while submitting them as separate feed items. WooCommerce core does not output ProductGroup: use your SEO plugin's variant support if it has it, or extend `woocommerce_structured_data_product`. Example for model (A): ```json { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "ProductGroup", "@id": "https://gravipack.com/produit/<sherpa-45>/#productgroup", "name": "Sac à dos de randonnée Sherpa 45 L Gravipack", "url": "https://gravipack.com/produit/<sherpa-45>/", "productGroupID": "SHERPA45", "brand": { "@type": "Brand", "name": "Gravipack" }, "variesBy": ["https://schema.org/color"], "hasVariant": [{ "@type": "Product", "sku": "SHERPA45-KAKI", "gtin13": "<EAN-13>", "name": "Sac à dos Sherpa 45 L Gravipack – kaki", "color": "Kaki", "image": ["https://gravipack.com/wp-content/uploads/<sherpa-kaki>.jpg"], "offers": { "@type": "Offer", "url": "https://gravipack.com/produit/<sherpa-45>/?attribute_pa_couleur=kaki", "price": "149.90", "priceCurrency": "EUR", "availability": "https://schema.org/InStock" } }] } ``` Repeat the hasVariant entry for each colour. 4. **Identifiers and brand.** - Fill the native WooCommerce field « GTIN, UPC, EAN ou ISBN » (Inventaire tab, set per variation; WooCommerce 9.2+) with the EAN-13 codes already used on the Decathlon, Fnac and Nature & Découvertes listings. - Keep the SKU as the MPN. - If the active markup generator does not output these fields, add them: ```php add_filter( 'woocommerce_structured_data_product', function ( $markup, $product ) { $markup['brand'] = [ '@type' => 'Brand', 'name' => 'Gravipack' ]; if ( method_exists( $product, 'get_global_unique_id' ) && $product->get_global_unique_id() ) { $markup['gtin13'] = $product->get_global_unique_id(); } return $markup; }, 10, 2 ); ``` This filter only works if WooCommerce core outputs the markup. If Yoast or Rank Math replaces it, set the fields in that plugin instead. 5. **Reviews: mark up only on-site, product-specific ratings.** - In WooCommerce > Réglages > Produits > Avis produits, turn on: - product reviews; - « Afficher le badge “propriétaire vérifié” »; - « Les avis ne peuvent être laissés que par des “propriétaires vérifiés” »; - mandatory star ratings. - WooCommerce core then outputs aggregateRating and review from these reviews only, which follows Google's rules. - Ask every buyer for a review about 3 weeks after delivery. Do not filter out unhappy customers. - Never output the Google 4,7 badge, Trustpilot (3,1/5, 9 avis), Decathlon or Fnac ratings as a Product aggregateRating. Google's guidelines require ratings collected on your own site, and a business rating is not a product rating. If the badge plugin has a 'rich snippet' or schema option, turn it off. - Keep the Google rating, since third parties corroborate about 4,7 from 998 reviews and 4,8 from 900+. Replace the inconsistent hard-coded counts with either: - one dated figure linked to the profile, after checking the live number in the Business Profile, e.g. « Note Google : 4,7/5 – [nombre] avis au [date] (voir les avis) »; or - a live widget that follows Google's attribution rules. - Near the reviews, add the notice required by Code de la consommation L111-7-2 / D111-17, e.g. « Les avis sont déposés par des clients ayant acheté le produit sur gravipack.com (badge “propriétaire vérifié”). Ils sont publiés sans modification, qu’ils soient positifs ou négatifs, par ordre chronologique. » - Disclose any incentive given for a review (loi n° 2023-451). 6. **Shipping and returns.** Declare them once, with values identical to the CGV, in one of these places: - Merchant Center: Paramètres > Expédition et retours; - Search Console's shopping settings, if there is no Merchant Center account; - markup: shippingDetails on the Offer, and hasMerchantReturnPolicy on the Offer or once at Organization level. ```json "shippingDetails": { "@type": "OfferShippingDetails", "shippingRate": { "@type": "MonetaryAmount", "value": "0.00", "currency": "EUR" }, "shippingDestination": { "@type": "DefinedRegion", "addressCountry": "FR" }, "deliveryTime": { "@type": "ShippingDeliveryTime", "handlingTime": { "@type": "QuantitativeValue", "minValue": 0, "maxValue": 2, "unitCode": "DAY" }, "transitTime": { "@type": "QuantitativeValue", "minValue": 2, "maxValue": 5, "unitCode": "DAY" } } }, "hasMerchantReturnPolicy": { "@type": "MerchantReturnPolicy", "applicableCountry": "FR", "returnPolicyCountry": "FR", "returnPolicyCategory": "https://schema.org/MerchantReturnFiniteReturnWindow", "merchantReturnDays": 14, "returnMethod": "https://schema.org/ReturnByMail", "returnFees": "https://schema.org/ReturnFeesCustomerResponsibility" } ``` Use the real shipping rates, delivery times, return window (14 days minimum) and return fees. 7. **Merchant Center and the feed.** - **Account:** if none exists, create one, verify and claim the canonical host (through Search Console or Site Kit), and enable free listings for France. - **Product source:** check that the feed plugin (Google for WooCommerce, CTX Feed, Product Feed PRO…) is on a release that uses the Merchant API. The changelog and the plugin's sync log will show 410 errors otherwise. Alternatively, switch to a scheduled-fetch XML feed, which is not affected by the sunset. - **Feed titles:** model + capacity + colour + brand, without unproven health claims while the claims review is pending (Merchant Center Misrepresentation policy, unreliable claims). Example: « Sac à dos de randonnée Sherpa 45 L kaki – bretelles exosquelette – Gravipack ». - **Legacy store:** once presta.gravipack.com is redirected, make sure it no longer exposes in-stock offers. 8. **Validate, then monitor.** - Run the Rich Results Test (merchant listings and product snippets) on the 5 URLs. - Check the Search Console Shopping reports and Merchant Center Diagnostics. - Add a schema check on three URLs to the release checklist for every price or promotion change.

findings.title: #37 Organization markup should carry the verified legal identity and sameAs links (verify on-site)
findings.description:
**We could not inspect the current markup.** The sandbox network policy blocked gravipack.com, so we could not read its JSON-LD. WordPress SEO plugins (Yoast, Rank Math) normally output an Organization node already (name, URL, logo, sometimes social profiles). The likely gap is missing or outdated properties, not a missing block. Verify on-site before changing anything.

**What the off-site evidence shows, and why the properties matter here:**
- **Legal identity is now verified in the registries.** The operator and brand owner is EXOSQUELETTE LIGHT SAS, SIREN 840 543 383 (siège SIRET 840 543 383 00045), share capital 16 960 €, president Mohammed Errafi since June 2018.
  - Created on 12/06/2018 in Sens as GRAVIBAG.
  - Renamed GRAVIPACK from 01/07/2022.
  - Renamed EXOSQUELETTE LIGHT by the AGE of 02/01/2025 (BODACC 28/02/2025).
  - Seat history: Sens, then 46 rue de la Bienfaisance, 94300 Vincennes (late 2022), then **10 rue de la Paix, 75002 Paris since 19/05/2026**.
  - The GRAVIPACK trademark was filed on 27/05/2019 and is valid to 2029, per societe.com.
  - The /mentions-legales/ search snippet already names EXOSQUELETTE LIGHT, Paris. That is good, and the markup should repeat it.
- **Old facts still circulate on third-party pages.** They show Vincennes: rubypayeur ('EXOSQUELETTE LIGHT à VINCENNES'), PagesJaunes ('Gravipack à Vincennes – Maroquinerie', 0 reviews), Mappy (46 r Bienfaisance), gravipacker.com, the groupe-ranque.fr directory ('Gravipack – Vincennes') and the AI-generated directory motherbase.ai. Other directories still list the former name GRAVIBAG.
- **No knowledge-graph entity exists.** Searches filtered to Wikidata, Wikipedia and Crunchbase found only lookalikes: Gravis, Gravitas Packaging, Gpack, a 'Zero Gravity' YouTube channel and the Instagram handle @granipack.
- **Owned profiles exist and can go in sameAs:**
  - LinkedIn company page fr.linkedin.com/company/gravipack
  - YouTube @Gravipack (also reachable as /c/Gravipack)
  - Instagram @gravipack (about 23K followers in a snapshot from around March 2023)
  - Facebook /gravipack
  - Trustpilot gravipack.com (claimed since December 2020; 3.1/5 from 9 reviews)
  - Founder profile: linkedin.com/in/errafi/
- **Documented awards:**
  - Concours Lépine 2018 silver medal, reported consistently by Europe 1 and Neozone. No official palmarès was found.
  - Trophées INPI 2022 finalist, Start-up category, on inpi.fr.
  - A separate 'military innovation' silver medal is claimed by the founder but not documented.
- **Brand results are volatile.** For 'gravipack', in the search results we sampled (a US-located, non-Google index), the home page ranked #7 in one run and #9 in another. The first owned URL ranked #4 to #6. The 2020 KissKissBankBank campaign ranked #1 in both runs.
- **Kid'abord is a separate company.** It acts as licensee and marketplace seller (Decathlon, Nature & Découvertes) and must not be merged into the Gravipack Organization node.

Why it matters: Organization markup is the site's machine-readable statement of who it is. Google uses it, alongside other sources, to choose the logo and to match the brand to the right legal entity. legalName, iso6523Code (the SIREN) and sameAs give an unambiguous key for that matching.

The ambiguity is real here: three legal names in eight years, three seats (Sens, Vincennes, Paris), lookalike brands, and no Wikidata item. LLMs and Google can repeat the stale Vincennes or GRAVIBAG facts, or confuse Gravipack with Gravis or Gravitas.

Keep the effort proportionate. Google says Organization markup is optional and gives no rich result beyond logo eligibility, and Google's AI guidance does not treat it as an AI-specific lever. One accurate block is enough, hence Low.

Effect on SEO: Clearer entity matching in the Knowledge Graph and AI answers: the brand (Gravipack), the company (EXOSQUELETTE LIGHT), the founder and the official profiles are tied to one ID. The logo becomes eligible to show in results. Brand descriptions become more consistent, which indirectly helps control the brand results. No direct ranking effect.

Impact 3/10 · Effort Low · Confidence needs-on-site-check
findings.recommendation: 1. **Measure before changing anything (verify on-site).** - Run the Rich Results Test and validator.schema.org on the home page, /a-propos-de-nous-gravipack-au-service-de-votre-dos/ and /mentions-legales/. - Note which plugin outputs the markup (Yoast, Rank Math, the theme, WooCommerce or a review widget). - Check whether more than one Organization node exists. - Check which host (www or apex) the `@id` and `url` use, compared with the canonical host. - List which of the properties below are missing. - Extend the existing node. Never paste a second Organization block. 2. **Fix the visible facts first.** The markup must repeat what the pages say. The mentions légales (LCEN art. 1-1 since loi SREN 2024) and the About page should carry the same identity block, for example: « Gravipack® est une marque de la société EXOSQUELETTE LIGHT SAS (SIREN 840 543 383), dont le siège est situé 10 rue de la Paix, 75002 Paris. La société a été fondée en 2018 par Mohammed Errafi, inventeur des bretelles à exosquelette Gravipack. Médaille d’argent au Concours Lépine 2018 ; finaliste des Trophées INPI 2022 (catégorie Start-up). » List only awards you can link to a source. 3. **Plugin settings.** - **Yoast:** SEO > Réglages > Représentation du site. Choose « Organisation », name « Gravipack », an alternate name, and a logo (square, at least 112×112 px, crawlable URL). Put the profile URLs under « Autres profils ». Recent Yoast versions also have extra organisation fields on this screen (legal name, founding date, VAT ID, ISO 6523 code…). Fill them where available. - **Rank Math:** Titres & Méta > Local SEO. Set type Organization, name, logo, URL and address. - Add anything the interface lacks with a filter (step 4). 4. **Add the missing properties with a filter.** Use the child theme's functions.php or a small mu-plugin: ```php // Yoast SEO add_filter( 'wpseo_schema_organization', function ( $data ) { $data['legalName'] = 'EXOSQUELETTE LIGHT'; $data['alternateName'] = [ 'GRAVIPACK', 'GRAVIBAG' ]; $data['iso6523Code'] = '0002:840543383'; // ICD 0002 = SIRENE $data['foundingDate'] = '2018-06-12'; $data['address'] = [ '@type' => 'PostalAddress', 'streetAddress' => '10 rue de la Paix', 'postalCode' => '75002', 'addressLocality' => 'Paris', 'addressCountry' => 'FR', ]; $data['founder'] = [ '@id' => home_url( '/#fondateur' ) ]; $data['award'] = [ 'Médaille d’argent, Concours Lépine 2018', 'Finaliste des Trophées INPI 2022, catégorie Start-up' ]; return $data; } ); // Rank Math: add the same keys to the Organization entity with add_filter( 'rank_math/json_ld', ... ). ``` 5. **Target result.** This is what the validator should show. Replace the placeholders and use the canonical host: ```json { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "Organization", "@id": "https://gravipack.com/#organization", "name": "Gravipack", "alternateName": ["GRAVIPACK", "GRAVIBAG"], "legalName": "EXOSQUELETTE LIGHT", "url": "https://gravipack.com/", "logo": "https://gravipack.com/wp-content/uploads/<logo-gravipack>.png", "description": "Marque française de sacs à dos équipés de bretelles à exosquelette (inserts carbone) conçues pour répartir la charge portée.", "foundingDate": "2018-06-12", "iso6523Code": "0002:840543383", "vatID": "<n° de TVA intracommunautaire figurant sur vos factures>", "address": {"@type": "PostalAddress", "streetAddress": "10 rue de la Paix", "postalCode": "75002", "addressLocality": "Paris", "addressCountry": "FR"}, "contactPoint": {"@type": "ContactPoint", "contactType": "customer service", "email": "<adresse de contact vérifiée>", "availableLanguage": ["fr"]}, "founder": {"@type": "Person", "@id": "https://gravipack.com/#fondateur", "name": "Mohammed Errafi", "jobTitle": "Président et inventeur", "sameAs": ["https://www.linkedin.com/in/errafi/"]}, "brand": {"@type": "Brand", "name": "Gravipack"}, "award": ["Médaille d’argent, Concours Lépine 2018", "Finaliste des Trophées INPI 2022, catégorie Start-up"], "sameAs": [ "https://www.linkedin.com/company/gravipack/", "https://www.youtube.com/@Gravipack", "https://www.instagram.com/gravipack/", "https://www.facebook.com/gravipack/", "https://www.trustpilot.com/review/gravipack.com", "https://annuaire-entreprises.data.gouv.fr/entreprise/exosquelette-light-840543383" ] } ``` Give the customer-service or returns address on the contact page and in the CGV if it differs from the registered seat. Do not put it in Organization.address. 6. **Link the rest of the markup to this node.** - Define the founder `Person` once, with name, role and LinkedIn sameAs only, and reuse its `@id` on the About page and on author bylines. - Every Product carries `"brand": {"@type": "Brand", "name": "Gravipack"}`. Each Offer's `seller` and the WebSite `publisher` point to `{"@id": "https://gravipack.com/#organization"}`. - Kid'abord is a separate company acting as licensee and marketplace seller. Do not declare it as parentOrganization. Use `manufacturer` only where it is true for a given product. 7. **Keep sameAs clean.** - List only profiles that represent the brand, using their canonical URLs (www.linkedin.com/company/gravipack/, www.trustpilot.com/review/gravipack.com). - Leave out the Decathlon brand page, the KissKissBankBank campaigns and reseller pages. - Add the Wikidata item once it exists. It must be created transparently, with independent references (see the knowledge-graph finding). - Update those profiles to the same legal name and Paris seat: the LinkedIn siège, the Facebook « À propos » section and the Trustpilot company information. 8. **Validate, then stop.** - Re-run the Rich Results Test (logo detected, 0 errors). - Check the rendered HTML in Search Console URL Inspection. - Do not invest further. More markup will not create a knowledge panel; off-site sources (registry citations, Wikidata, PagesJaunes) do that.
