findings.title: #10 Gravipack is missing from the third-party comparison and 'meilleur …' articles that rank for generic ergonomic, hiking and school-bag queries
findings.description:
In the search results we sampled (a US-located, non-Google index), no comparison or 'meilleur …' article naming Gravipack appeared for generic ergonomic, hiking, laptop or school-bag queries:
- 'meilleur cartable ergonomique comparatif 2026': avis-parents x4, meilleurtest x3, futura-sciences x2.
- 'meilleur cartable ergonomique 2026': 8 of 9 results are comparisons (futura-sciences, avis-parents x2, meilleurs.fr, lemeilleuravis, coin-pratique, mafamillezen, zoneled). They list ergobag Prime, Satch, Baagl, Eastpak and Tann's.
- 'sac à dos randonnée ergonomique': Glisshop x2, Cdiscount, Rayonrando, Ridepark, Toporando ('11 modèles comparés'), Hardloop ('15 meilleurs'), mon-sac-a-dos and Millet. The lists name Osprey, Deuter, Gregory, Millet and Mammut.
- 'sac à dos ordinateur ergonomique': mon-sac-a-dos x2, sac-a-dos-france, Eastpak, Darty, Karkoa, Accergo ('5 meilleurs'), ma-boutique-ergonomique and Ergonovie.
- 'meilleur sac à dos ergonomique comparatif 2026': Snowleader top 10, Toporando x2, Clubic, TechRadar FR, Globe-Trotting and Athleteside. None of the top 9 is a comparison focused on ergonomics, which is itself a content gap.
- 'sac à dos ergonomique' and 'cartable ergonomique' (extended mode): no Gravipack URL at all. Phase-1 standard sets #22, #26 (tonton-outdoor best-of), #39 (TechRadar, meilleurtest) and #47 (fflose best-of) show the same pattern.

Two more checks found nothing either:
- A search that excluded Gravipack's own sites, resellers and marketplaces returned only single-product tests (i-trekkings Oslo 70 L), press (Gomet, PresseSanté, INPI) and reseller pages, never a list.
- A search limited to accergo, karkoa, mon-sac-a-dos, ma-boutique-ergonomique, techradar, norveya and le-repaire showed no Gravipack mention in the snippets.

Scope correction: Gravipack is not absent from its own niche. Extended-mode data show gravipack.com ranking for the 'anti mal de dos' head terms:
- scolaire: #1-#3
- 'ergonomique mal de dos': #2 and #4
- 'sac à dos anti mal de dos': #4-#6
- randonnée: #5-#6
- ordinateur: #3-#5
For 'meilleur sac à dos anti mal de dos', ergo-corner's Gravipack brand page is #1 and the gravipack.com home page is #5. The gap is the generic 'ergonomique / randonnée / cartable' wording and the third-party lists.

Gravipack sells a product for each segment:
- hiking: Sherpa, Hiking, Oslo;
- laptop: Business Talk V4, Kingston, Rome;
- collège and lycée: G-Pack, Kingston.
Primary-school cartables (ergobag, Satch) are a neighbouring segment rather than a direct match.

Caveats:
- The evidence is snippet-level only.
- The full text of the extended-mode lists (accergo, norveya, karkoa, le-repaire, zeoutdoor comparatif) was not checked, and some may already mention Gravipack.
- Several of the lists that rank are published by competing shops or brands (karkoa, norveya, mon-sac-a-dos, ma-boutique-ergonomique, sacados.fr). They will not feature a rival.

Why it matters: For research-before-buying queries ('meilleur …', 'comparatif', 'sac à dos ergonomique'), search engines mostly rank comparison articles and retailer category pages. ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google's AI features build their 'which bag should I buy' shortlists largely from those same articles. A brand missing from them is invisible to buyers at the shortlist stage, however good its own pages are.

Effect on SEO: Each inclusion brings:
- referral traffic;
- a brand mention next to category terms (sac à dos ergonomique, cartable ergonomique, sac randonnée), which helps search and AI systems associate the brand with the category and makes AI citations more likely;
- sometimes an editorial link.
Truly independent editorial links can be followed. Affiliate links, and links given in return for a free or loaned product, must be marked rel="sponsored" (or nofollow) and pass no ranking credit. Their value is visibility, sales and places in AI shortlists, not PageRank.

Impact 6/10 · Effort High · Confidence likely
findings.recommendation: 1. **Verify before outreach (1-2 days).** Open the full text of each ranking list. In a sheet, record: whether it names Gravipack (yes/no), any link and its rel value, last-updated date, how it makes money (affiliate, Amazon), and the author's contact. Start with: - accergo.fr/meilleurs-sacs-a-dos-ergonomiques/, the norveya and karkoa guides, le-repaire, zeoutdoor comparatif; - TechRadar FR, meilleurtest.fr, avis-parents, futura-sciences (cartable), Clubic (laptop); - the Snowleader top 10, Toporando (journée and trekking), Ridepark, Hardloop, Glisshop conseils, tonton-outdoor, fflose. 2. **Sort the targets into three groups.** - (a) Independent editors and testers (meilleurtest, avis-parents, futura-sciences, Clubic, TechRadar FR, Toporando, Ridepark, tonton-outdoor, fflose, i-trekkings): pitch them. - (b) Retailer buying guides (Snowleader, Glisshop, Hardloop, Au Vieux Campeur, Nature & Découvertes, ergo-corner, Équilibre France Ergonomie): these guides list what the shop stocks. Ask current resellers to add Gravipack to their own 'meilleurs sacs' and 'bien choisir' guides, and approach the others through wholesale. - (c) Competing shops and brands (karkoa, norveya, mon-sac-a-dos, ma-boutique-ergonomique, sacados.fr): skip. 3. **Fix the facts writers will check.** Prepare a one-page fiche technique per model: poids à vide, volume mesuré, dimensions, plage de réglage taille/poids, prix public conseillé, garantie. For the Sherpa 45, publish a measured volume, because its capacity is publicly disputed (Outzer measured about 30 L). Put the same table on each product page in the HTML. Present any efficacy figure ('92 %') only as the brand's own figure, linked to the evidence page once it exists. Align prices across channels first, because lists print prices. 4. **Match the model to the list.** - hiking: Sherpa 45 / Hiking 33 / Oslo 60+10; - laptop: Business Talk V4 / Kingston; - collège/lycée: G-Pack / Kingston; - vélotaf: Tokyo / Rome; - artisans and porte-outils: Light Promax / ExoTool. 5. **Pitch honestly: offer a loan or test unit, and never pay for placement.** Example: > Objet : Proposition de test – sac à dos à exosquelette Gravipack pour votre comparatif « [titre] » > Bonjour [Prénom], nous suivons votre comparatif « [titre] ». Gravipack conçoit des sacs à dos dont les bretelles intègrent un exosquelette destiné à soulager les épaules. Nous pouvons vous prêter un [modèle] pour un test en conditions réelles : vous restez entièrement libre de votre avis. Fiche technique : [lien]. Visuels HD et informations société : https://gravipack.com/dossier-de-presse/. Bien cordialement, [Nom], [fonction], Gravipack If the product is gifted or any payment is involved, the publisher must disclose it ('collaboration commerciale' / 'produit offert') under the French influencer law (loi n° 2023-451). The links should carry rel="sponsored" or nofollow. If you run an affiliate programme (e.g. Awin, Effiliation, or a WooCommerce plugin such as AffiliateWP), its links must be rel="sponsored". 6. **Time the pitches.** - Now (Oct-Dec 2026): the 2027 editions of 'meilleur … 2026' lists, since titles are re-dated around the new year. - April-June 2027: back-to-school lists (cartable, sac collège). - February-April 2027: hiking lists. 7. **Extra angle.** Neozone covered the competing LEX exoskeleton backpack. Pitch them a piece comparing exoskeleton approaches for backpacks that includes Gravipack. 8. **Own the comparison too.** Publish a fair comparison page ('sac à dos à exosquelette vs sac à dos ergonomique classique', with a table and stated limits). On the existing hubs, add 'ergonomique' as a secondary term without removing 'anti mal de dos'. Both tasks belong to the on-page clusters. 9. **Domain-level gap (later).** Once Moz or DataForSEO is set up, run `/seo backlinks gap gravipack.com ergobag.fr` (or the French Deuter or Osprey sites) to get a referring-domain gap list. Bing's comparison only works for sites you own.

findings.title: #18 Press and partner mentions of Gravipack have unknown link status and should be checked and reclaimed as links
findings.description:
These pages mention Gravipack by name (confirmed in the saved search logs):
- **Editorial:** Maddyness (2024-02-08), Journal du Geek (2021-09-04), ICI/France Bleu (2021-09-02 and 2020-09-03), the ICI 'Les nouveaux inventeurs du concours Lépine' page (first for 'sac à dos anti mal de dos' in the search results we sampled), franceinfo / France 3 BFC (about 2018), Europe 1 (Trophées de l'Avenir 2023), Neozone, Le Matin (2020), Challenge.ma, the FNH.ma founder interview, Gomet, PresseSanté and Maginfrance.
- **Tests and blogs:** the i-trekkings Oslo 70 L test and compostelle-autrement.
- **Institutional:** the INPI Trophées page (2022 finalist).
- **Directories and profiles you can edit or ask to edit:** Les Pépites Tech, MyFrenchStartup, Motherbase (an AI-generated directory, on two subdomains) and four KissKissBankBank campaigns (2020, 2022, 2023 SmartBag, 2024 children's bag).
- **Resellers and partners with brand content:** ergo-corner (/55-gravipack, /content/13-le-sac-a-dos-gravipack and blog b14, which rank in 8 extended-mode 'anti mal de dos' result sets), Équilibre France Ergonomie (/les-nouveaux-sacs-gravipack/ and product pages), Au Vieux Campeur and Nature & Découvertes.
- **Licensees:** the founder interview names Kid'abord, Packcraft and BSGroupe as licensees (unverified for the last two). Kid'abord is a separate company that acts as licensee and as the marketplace seller on Decathlon and Nature & Découvertes; it posts about Gravipack on LinkedIn.

Search data cannot show whether each page links, the rel value, the anchor text, or which host it points to (apex, www, presta. or .fr). Link status is therefore unknown, not 'missing'.

Corrections:
- The francebleu.fr URLs have probably moved to ici.fr after the 2025 rebrand; check the live URL first.
- Decathlon and Fnac seller and brand pages generally do not allow outbound links to brand sites, and nofollow or UGC links pass little or no equity, so they are not realistic targets.
- KKBB support now redirects to Ulule; only the creator can still post updates on the campaign pages.
- Old regional articles (franceinfo 2018) are rarely edited, so expect few successes there.
- RATP-owned pages are covered in the ratp-proof-point finding.

Why it matters: A page that already names the brand is the cheapest link available. The editor has already judged the brand newsworthy, and the request is a small correction for readers. Links that point at retired hosts (presta.gravipack.com, gravipack.fr) or dead URLs waste equity the brand has already earned.

Effect on SEO: Turning even a few of the high-value mentions (Maddyness, Journal du Geek, ICI, Europe 1, INPI) into followed links to the canonical gravipack.com URL would add relevant, authoritative referring domains. How much this helps is unknown without link data. Correcting reseller and directory profiles gives search engines and AI systems consistent entity signals (name, URL, description) that tie mentions to the official site, and it brings referral traffic.

Impact 5/10 · Effort Low · Confidence needs-on-site-check
findings.recommendation: 1. **Settle the target first.** Agree the canonical host (apex or www). Make sure presta.gravipack.com and gravipack.fr redirect page-to-page with 301s to it. Reclaimed links should point to final URLs, never to a redirect chain. 2. **Check link status (1-2 hours).** Build `links.json` from the URLs above, e.g. `[{"source_url": "https://www.maddyness.com/2024/02/08/votre-sac-a-dos-est-toujours-beaucoup-trop-lourd-la-soluce-de-cette-startup/"}, {"source_url": "https://www.journaldugeek.com/2021/09/04/gravipack-ce-sac-a-dos-a-un-exosquelette-qui-libere-les-epaules/"}]`. Replace francebleu.fr URLs with their live ici.fr versions. From a machine with network access, run: ```bash "$HOME/.claude/skills/seo/scripts/claude-seo" run verify_backlinks.py --target https://gravipack.com/ --links links.json --json > gravipack-com.json "$HOME/.claude/skills/seo/scripts/claude-seo" run verify_backlinks.py --target https://gravipack.fr/ --links links.json --json > gravipack-fr.json ``` The gravipack.com run also catches www. and presta. links (match_type domain_match or subdomain_match); open each match to see the exact target URL. Pages reported as `unverifiable_js` (social and JavaScript-rendered pages) count as unknown, not missing. 3. **Sort the results.** - Followed link to a live canonical URL: nothing to do. - Link to presta., .fr or a 404: make that URL 301 to the closest matching live page (Redirection plugin or a server rule). Ask the site to update the link only if it is high-value. - nofollow link: accept it. - No link: request one (step 4). 4. **Request the link.** Start with Maddyness, Journal du Geek, ICI, Europe 1, INPI and i-trekkings. Template (verified facts only): > Objet : Votre article sur Gravipack – lien vers le site officiel > Bonjour [Prénom], merci encore pour votre article « [titre] » du [date]. Pour vos lecteurs qui souhaitent en savoir plus, serait-il possible d'ajouter un lien vers notre site officiel, https://gravipack.com/ (ou [page la plus pertinente]) ? Visuels HD et informations à jour : https://gravipack.com/dossier-de-presse/. Bien cordialement, [Nom], [fonction], Gravipack Do not add unverified claims such as sales volumes ('plus de 20 000 sacs vendus') or efficacy percentages. Send one follow-up after 10 days, then stop. 5. **Edit what you control.** - Update the website field and description on Les Pépites Tech, MyFrenchStartup, LinkedIn, YouTube, Facebook, Instagram and the claimed Trustpilot profile. - Ask Motherbase to correct its facts. - On each of the 4 KKBB campaigns, post a final news update as the creator with the official-store link (KKBB support now redirects to Ulule). 6. **Work with partners.** - Send ergo-corner, Équilibre France Ergonomie, Au Vieux Campeur and Nature & Découvertes a brand kit: a short, unique description (not copied from gravipack.com), the logo, the official URL and verified claims only. Ask for a « Site officiel de la marque » link on their brand pages. - Ask the licensees (Kid'abord, plus Packcraft and BSGroupe if confirmed) to add a « Technologie Gravipack® » block linking to https://gravipack.com/. - Do not ask Decathlon or Fnac for links. 7. **Log and re-check every quarter.** Use the same sheet as new press wins: URL, date, rel, anchor, target, status.

findings.title: #19 Independent press coverage is thin at the top end, and none dated 2025 or 2026 was found
findings.description:
No independent editorial piece dated 2025 or 2026 was found. Phase 2 ran 25 freshness searches, and verification added three more angles (English-language news, awards, VivaTech/Le Parisien).

Dated coverage that was found, oldest first:
- franceinfo / France 3 Bourgogne-Franche-Comté: about 2018 ('en voie de commercialisation')
- Neozone: about 2018-2019
- ICI (France Bleu) Auxerre: 2020-09-03 ('le cartable révolutionnaire de la société Gravipack à Sens fait un carton')
- Le Matin (Morocco): 2020
- ICI (France Bleu): 2021-09-02
- Journal du Geek: 2021-09-04
- Objets du Futur: 2022-02-14
- Europe 1, Trophées de l'Avenir: 2023 candidate profile
- Maddyness: 2024-02-08
- ICI, 'La RATP innove avec les exosquelettes': about early 2024 (fits RATP's release of 29/02/2024)
- C8 'William à midi' segment on the Hiking bag: YouTube copy from June 2024

Undated:
- ICI's 'Les nouveaux inventeurs du concours Lépine' page on Gravipack, which ranked first for 'sac à dos anti mal de dos' in the extended sample. Its date is unknown and it could be recent; check it.
- A BFM TV segment hosted on the brand's Facebook page.
- The 'Samuel Etienne découvre…' video (owner unknown).
- Gomet, PresseSanté, Maginfrance, Challenge.ma and an FNH.ma interview with the founder.

Institutional mentions:
- the INPI Trophées 2022 finalist page;
- RATP pages, including VivaTech 2023 and a 2024 annual-report page that was probably published in 2025 (unverified).

The owned post slug '/gravipack-au-salon-vivatech-…-le-parisien/' suggests a Le Parisien article about VivaTech 2023 exists. So the accurate statement is 'few high-authority national titles found', not 'no national press or TV'.

The topic gap is clearer than the national one. No health, consumer, parenting or occupational-safety coverage appeared. A search on CPAM / Assurance Maladie / médecine du travail found nothing about Gravipack.

This is absence of evidence, not proof:
- The tool could not search eight major French press domains: Le Parisien, actu.fr, L'Yonne Républicaine, Ouest-France, francetvinfo, 20 Minutes, BFM and TF1info.
- Link velocity cannot be measured without DataForSEO, so this is not a finding about link velocity.

The brand itself is not inactive:
- a Decathlon marketplace promotion ran from 18/06 to 30/08/2026;
- YouTube uploads continued until about mid-June 2025;
- 2026 models are on pre-order: Business Talk V4 20 L (June 2026), Tokyo (mid-September 2026), Barracuda claie (mid-November 2026);
- there have been four KissKissBankBank campaigns (2020, 2022, 2023 SmartBag, 2024 children's bag);
- owned posts cover SOFINS, RATP and the Concours Lépine.
Meanwhile, the freshest third-party content about the brand is user-generated and partly negative. Trustpilot has 2026 reviews, including an unanswered June 2026 complaint about a refund.

Why it matters: Journalists, buyers and AI engines describe a brand from its most visible recent independent sources. With nothing new since 2024, they keep repeating 2018-2021 facts ('en apesanteur', 'en voie de commercialisation', patent counts, the 2019 pre-study), while sceptical forum and review content is fresher. claude-seo's GEO guidance treats brand mentions as more strongly correlated with AI visibility than backlinks. The product sits close to health topics (YMYL), so the most important gap is authority from health, consumer and parenting media.

Effect on SEO: New independent, dated coverage adds referring domains and brand mentions. It gives AI engines recent sources that describe the current range and the B2B use, and it helps push sceptical third-party results down the brand results page. In our samples the official home page sat only at #7 to #9 for 'gravipack', and the order changed between runs. The effects build over months; there is no quick ranking switch.

Impact 5/10 · Effort Medium · Confidence likely
findings.recommendation: 1. **Close the evidence gap first (half a day).** Check the 8 domains the tool could not search, the date of the ICI 'concours Lépine' page and the Le Parisien VivaTech 2023 article. Use Google News with `site:` filters, Europresse (through a library or BnF access) or a DataForSEO SERP call. Add every confirmed article to the coverage list. 2. **Make /dossier-de-presse/ the press hub.** It already exists, so do not create a new /presse/ URL. Add: - a dated list ('Ils parlent de nous', newest first) giving the medium, date, title and an outbound link for each article; - a downloadable kit with HD visuals and the logo; - a verified fact sheet: EXOSQUELETTE LIGHT SAS, 10 rue de la Paix 75002 Paris; founder Mohammed Errafi, président; founded 2018; awards with proof (INPI Trophées 2022 finalist, confirmed on inpi.fr; Concours Lépine 2018 silver medal as reported by Europe 1 and Neozone, with the official certificate if you have it); - a press contact. Remove unverified figures such as sales volumes and client counts. 3. **Publish every real event first as a dated owned post** in /actualites-gravipack-2/, so coverage has a source to link to. Show the publication date on the page. Use BlogPosting, not NewsArticle: NewsArticle gives a brand blog no Top Stories benefit. In Rank Math, set Titres & Méta > Articles > Type de schéma = Article (BlogPosting); Yoast outputs it by default. Expected output: ```json {"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"BlogPosting","headline":"Gravipack lance la claie de portage Barracuda","datePublished":"2026-11-16T09:00:00+01:00","dateModified":"2026-11-16T09:00:00+01:00","author":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Gravipack","url":"https://gravipack.com/"},"publisher":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Gravipack","logo":{"@type":"ImageObject","url":"https://gravipack.com/wp-content/uploads/[logo].png"}}} ``` Update dateModified only when the content really changes; faking freshness goes against Google's guidance. 4. **Plan news hooks for the next 12 months.** - Late Oct-Nov 2026: Christmas gift guides. - Nov 2026: Barracuda claie deliveries and the 2026 range (Tokyo, Business Talk V4), for outdoor and tech media and as a Maddyness follow-up. - Q1 2027: the RATP story, if RATP validates updated figures (transport and HSE trade press, ICI Paris, Le Parisien). - Spring 2027: Concours Lépine / Foire de Paris, with a former-prizewinner angle. - June 2027: Semaine QVCT, with an occupational musculoskeletal (TMS) angle. - June-July 2027: back-to-school pitches for August-September publication. - 2027: SOFINS (held every two years) and Préventica, if exhibiting; ask to be listed in their exhibitor directories, which are indexed. - World Spine Day (16 October): too close for press in 2026, so use an owned post this year and pitch for 2027. 5. **Run data-led PR only once the evidence page exists.** Example: weigh pupils' bags with a partner collège, publish the method and data on gravipack.com, then pitch « Rentrée 2027 : combien pèse vraiment le sac de nos collégiens ? Nos mesures sur [n] élèves », with real numbers only. Pitch health, parenting and consumer titles (Santé Magazine, Top Santé, Magicmaman, Parents.fr) only after the evidence page and the health-claim clean-up are done. Brand searches already surface unanswered, unverified third-party forum allegations about the 2019 pre-study, and journalists will find them. 6. **Pitch in layers.** - Regional: ICI Yonne, ICI Paris, L'Yonne Républicaine, Le Parisien. - Business: Maddyness, Le Journal des Entreprises, Les Echos Entrepreneurs, L'Usine Nouvelle (the licensing model and French manufacturing, after checking the facts are current). - Trade: occupational safety, transport, defence. - Outdoor: Trekmag, Montagnes Magazine, an i-trekkings follow-up. 7. **Follow the rules.** Label any paid advertorial ('publi-rédactionnel') and give its links rel="sponsored". Never buy articles for links. Log every win in a sheet: URL, date, follow/nofollow, anchor, target URL.

findings.title: #22 RATP's own pages document its use of Gravipack, but this has not been turned into a case study or links
findings.description:
RATP's own websites describe its use of Gravipack in more places than phase 1 found. A search restricted to ratpgroup.com and ratp.fr returned at least six RATP-owned pages and documents (eight URLs) that name Gravipack:
- the CSR page in French and English. The English page cites 'the exoskeleton backpack, developed by Gravipack, to alleviate the weight carried by staff in charge of infrastructure monitoring who walk along tracks';
- the VivaTech 2023 newsroom article and the VivaTech 2023 event page. They say close to 50 roaming maintenance workers were already using the backpack and that RATP planned to equip all track teams;
- the 'Cahiers d'expertise' innovation PDFs (FR and GB);
- an undated reportage in Askip', RATP's internal magazine;
- the 2024 annual-report (ASDR) 'development' page. The search returned it for 'Gravipack', but the passage itself was not seen. It was probably published in 2025, so verify the wording and the date.
RATP also repeats the brand's '92 %' figure. That is Gravipack's own number, not an RATP measurement.

Independent press backs this up. ICI's 'La RATP innove avec les exosquelettes' dates from about early 2024, which fits RATP's press release of 29/02/2024 on its arm exoskeletons. It mentions Gravipack backpacks for 'parcoureurs de voie' as a project under way.

On gravipack.com the same story is split across two undated news posts:
- /gravipack-au-salon-vivatech-cet-outil-de-pointe-au-service-des-voyageurs-et-des-agents-du-metro-le-parisien/ ('Sac à dos porte-outils exosquelette Gravipack des agents RATP');
- /le-porte-outils-anti-mal-de-dos-gravipack-soulage-les-agents-ratp/ ('Gravipack : le porte-outils anti-mal de dos utilisé par la RATP').
There is also an RATP video on the brand's YouTube channel (1Xq8EKyINTw). The VivaTech year behind the 'Le Parisien' post is 2023, when RATP had a stand. The Le Parisien article itself could not be searched because the tool cannot reach that domain.

Phase-1 notes record the owned post quoting '250 agents équipés', attributed to Le Parisien. RATP's own dated figure is about 50 (2023). The two numbers conflict.

No case-study or references URL (/cas-clients/, /references/) appeared in site: searches. An indexed /nos-clients/ page exists, but its content is unknown. It is also unknown whether any RATP page links to gravipack.com. RATP describes its own use and trials; nothing in the evidence amounts to an endorsement or recommendation, and the wording must stay at that level.

Why it matters: B2B and public-sector buyers (HSE managers, occupational doctors, procurement) look for proof that an organisation like theirs uses the product. A large transport operator describing, on its own sites, how its track staff use Gravipack is the strongest independent proof the brand has. It is dated, verifiable and separate from the brand's own health claims, which are disputed in brand search results. Today that proof is scattered across RATP's sites and two undated owned posts, one of which uses a figure that contradicts RATP's own. There is no structured reference page for 'Gravipack RATP', and no single clean source for sales teams or AI engines to point to.

Effect on SEO: Merging the two posts into one dated case-study URL ends the duplication between them. It gives the B2B hub, the outillage category and the porte-outils product pages a proof asset to link to. It gives AI answer engines a fact they can attribute and check against RATP's pages. Any link granted from ratpgroup.com or ratp.fr would be a high-authority, topically relevant referring domain, and even an unlinked RATP mention reinforces the brand entity. The most likely first gain is conversion: more trust on quote (devis) journeys.

Impact 5/10 · Effort Low · Confidence likely
findings.recommendation: 1. **Inventory and check link status.** Save the RATP URLs above as `links.json` (`[{"source_url": "https://ratpgroup.com/fr/engagements-responsabilite-sociale-environnementale/exosquelettes/"}, ...]`). From a machine with network access, run `"$HOME/.claude/skills/seo/scripts/claude-seo" run verify_backlinks.py --target https://gravipack.com/ --links links.json --json`, then repeat with `--target https://gravipack.fr/`. Check the PDFs and the ratp.fr 'coulisses' story by hand. For each URL, log: does it link, the rel value, the anchor, and the date and figures it states. 2. **Get RATP's agreement before publishing.** Contact the RATP innovation/CSR team behind the VivaTech 2023 stand and the CSR page. Ask for: - permission to publish a case study naming RATP (use the logo only with written permission, as it is a registered trademark); - the current, citable figure (number of agents equipped, with a date); - a short quote from an operational sponsor; - a link from the FR and EN CSR pages to the case study or the home page. Do not count on links from archived newsroom pages or PDFs, which are rarely edited. 3. **Keep one URL, not two.** Check GSC (Performance and Links) for impressions or links on either post. If one has them, rewrite that post in place as the case study. If neither does, publish at `/nos-clients/ratp-agents-de-voie/`, a child of the existing /nos-clients/ page. Redirect the other post (or both) to it with the Redirection plugin (Outils > Redirection > Ajouter : URL source = old slug, URL cible = case study, type 301) on the canonical host. On Apache the equivalent is `Redirect 301 /le-porte-outils-anti-mal-de-dos-gravipack-soulage-les-agents-ratp/ https://gravipack.com/nos-clients/ratp-agents-de-voie/`. Do not leave the old posts live next to the new page. 4. **Write a dated, factual case study.** Suggested H1: « Cas client : le sac porte-outils Gravipack chez les agents de voie de la RATP ». Sections: - Le besoin: agents who walk along the tracks carrying their tools. - La solution: the model used, confirmed with RATP (probably the porte-outils 'outillage parcours'). - Chronologie: prototype trials, then VivaTech 2023, then the current status as confirmed by RATP. - Ce que dit la RATP: the exact quote, with an outbound link. - Limites: label '92 %' as a Gravipack figure and link to the evidence page. Example copy: « En juin 2023, à l'occasion de VivaTech, le Groupe RATP indiquait que près de 50 agents de maintenance itinérants utilisaient déjà le sac porte-outils à exosquelette Gravipack, avec l'objectif d'en équiper l'ensemble des équipes de voie (source : ratp.fr). » Replace '250 agents' with RATP's dated figure unless RATP confirms 250 in writing. Never write « approuvé » or « recommandé par la RATP ». Embed the existing RATP YouTube video. Show « Publié le / Mis à jour le ». 5. **Add markup.** It helps entity clarity only; there is no rich result. In Rank Math or Yoast, set the schema type to Article, or add: ```json {"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Article","headline":"Cas client : le sac porte-outils Gravipack chez les agents de voie de la RATP","datePublished":"2026-11-02","dateModified":"2026-11-02","author":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Gravipack","url":"https://gravipack.com/"},"mentions":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Groupe RATP","url":"https://ratpgroup.com/"},"citation":["https://ratpgroup.com/fr/engagements-responsabilite-sociale-environnementale/exosquelettes/","https://www.ratp.fr/en/groupe-ratp/vivatech2023"]} ``` Use the real dates, and change dateModified only when the content changes. 6. **Link to it internally.** Use the anchor « cas client RATP » or « agents de voie de la RATP » from the B2B/entreprises hub, the outillage category, the porte-outils product pages, /devis/ and /dossier-de-presse/. Add a 'trust strip' on the home or B2B page only if RATP approves. 7. **Reuse it.** If RATP validates updated figures, a joint communication is a fresh news hook for transport, HSE and regional press (see press-coverage-freshness). Include the case-study link when you request links from the CSR pages and Askip'.

findings.title: #33 The backlink profile cannot be measured with the current tooling; no toxic patterns were seen in the sample
findings.recommendation: 1. **Google Search Console.** Verify gravipack.com and gravipack.fr as Domain properties (DNS TXT record at the registrar). In Liens, export 'Principaux sites d'origine', 'Pages les plus liées' and 'Texte d'ancrage principal'. This export is the baseline. 2. **Bing Webmaster Tools (free).** Import the sites from GSC or verify them by DNS (Bing has no 'Domain property'). Use the Backlinks report, which shows inbound links with anchors. Bing's index also feeds Microsoft Copilot. 3. **Ahrefs Webmaster Tools** (free for verified sites): referring domains, broken backlinks and anchors. 4. **Optional, for a scored claude-seo report.** Create `~/.config/claude-seo/backlinks-api.json` containing: ```json {"moz_api_key": "…", "bing_api_key": "…"} ``` Alternatively, set the environment variables MOZ_API_KEY and BING_WEBMASTER_API_KEY, or connect DataForSEO for link velocity and gap analysis. Then run `/seo backlinks gravipack.com`. A Tier 0 run with Common Crawl from an unrestricted machine is a free first pass. 5. **Recover wasted equity.** From 'Pages les plus liées', list linked URLs that return 404 or redirect to the home page. Redirect each one with a 301 to the closest live page: - on gravipack.com, with the Redirection plugin (one rule per URL, type 301); - on presta.gravipack.com, with server-level or Cloudflare rules on the presta host, kept for at least a year. Example: ```apache # vhost presta.gravipack.com RewriteEngine On RewriteRule ^accueil/19-sac-a-dos-gravipack-sherpa-45\.html$ https://gravipack.com/produit/[slug-actuel-sherpa]/ [R=301,L] ``` Do not send everything to the home page; Google treats that as a soft 404. 6. **Do not create a disavow file.** Re-run the toxic check (`/seo backlinks toxic gravipack.com`) once real data exists. Disavow only if a clear manipulative pattern or a negative-SEO spike appears (claude-seo flags a toxic share above 10 %). Never disavow presta.gravipack.com; redirect it. 7. **Monitor monthly.** Track new and lost referring domains and broken targets against the baseline.

findings.title: #3 Review and 'arnaque' searches surface critical content the brand has not answered (Trustpilot 3.1/5 with unanswered 2026 complaints, the Outzer review, sceptical forum threads)
findings.description:
Searches that combine the brand with 'avis', 'test' or 'arnaque' return mostly third-party pages. The tone is mixed: sceptical forum threads are prominent, and no brand reply is visible anywhere. These positions come from the search results we sampled, a US-located, non-Google index in extended mode, and are not Google.fr rankings.

**'gravipack avis'**
- #1 fr.trustpilot.com/review/gravipack.com
- #2 Fnac Hiking 33 Gris reviews
- #3 Outzer Sherpa 45 review
- #4 Fnac Road Adventure (8 reviews, about 3/5)
- #5 lespepitestech
- #6 ergo-corner
- #7 Tokyo product page, the first owned URL
- #8 i-trekkings test
- #9 randonner-leger thread 37663, page 2

**'gravipack arnaque'** (a query we built, so its search demand is not validated)
- #1 Trustpilot
- #2 i-trekkings ('Idée de génie ou arnaque ?', a favourable test)
- #3 Outzer, titled 'Gravipack Sherpa 45 : Un sac a dos terrifiant'
- #4 and #7 randonner-leger
- #5 the Outzer brand hub
- #6 rubypayeur (a stale Vincennes company listing)
- #8 franceverif ('site fiable')
- #9 a ScamAdviser page for gravipack.archemia.fr
- No owned URL appears.

**Standard-mode runs** (this mode under-represents gravipack.com, so treat 'no owned URL' with caution)
- 'gravipack sherpa avis test': Outzer, 4 randonner-leger threads and Trustpilot.
- 'gravipack arnaque efficace 92%': 8 randonner-leger posts and the KissKissBankBank FAQ. The FAQ is brand-written, not user content.
- 'gravipack étude Lyon' (also a query we built): 6 randonner-leger posts plus moodle.univ-lyon1, Maddyness and Europe 1.
- The same Gravipack threads (570298, 570316, 570392) also rank for generic queries: 'sac à dos qui soulage le dos et les épaules' and 'bretelles ergonomiques sac à dos soulager épaules'.

**Trustpilot**
- The profile has been claimed ('revendiqué') since December 2020, so the brand already has access.
- TrustScore 3 (3.1/5) from only 9 reviews. Ratings are polarised: 56 % 5-star and 33 % 1-star.
- No review has a reply, and no invitations have been sent 'for a long time'.
- A June 2026 review reports pain, a returned bag, no refund and two months without an answer. Another 2026 review calls the company dishonest for the same reason.
- Older complaints: straps coming loose from the fabric, a 3-month pre-order delay, a long wait for a custom order, and about a week of collarbone, shoulder-blade and hip pain after the GR20.
- Positive reviews praise durability, comfort and quick strap replacements under warranty.

**Outzer**
- One Sherpa 45 review (bought for about €240) reports a heavy bag, weak materials and neck pressure.
- The reviewer estimates the capacity at about 30 L rather than 45 L. That is an estimate, not a measurement.
- The reviewer also says the bag was 'conçu en Chine', contrary to the advertising.

**Forums**
- randonner-leger thread '[Sac à dos] gravipack: une vraie révolution?' (2020-2021, about 13 indexed URLs). Posts include '10 kg dans le sac, on en ressent 11' and 'rien sur PubMed', and argue the load moves to the lumbar area. Some posters call it 'publicité déguisée'; others call it 'un projet en développement'. The allegation about the study is covered in the study finding.
- forum.bushwalk.com (Australia, 2024): the 'weightless' bag weighs 890 g; one poster calls it 'just another con'.

**Positive signals the brand does not use**
- The i-trekkings 7-month test (Oslo 70 L on the GR5/GR51: no neck, back or hip pain; 2.4 kg).
- Decathlon: collection 4.1/5 (26 reviews); Hiking 33 4.13/5 (8 reviews).
- Positive Fnac and Trustpilot reviews.

**Owned pages that address these searches but do not rank for them:** /gravipackers/ (testimonials), /inventeur-dun-sac-a-dos-en-apesanteur/, the Concours Lépine post and the legacy presta.gravipack.com study page.

**Reassurance (Info):** more than 10 checks found no DGCCRF, ARPP, Que Choisir or signal-arnaques record about Gravipack. A signal-arnaques hit (#947856) cannot be tied to the brand; it most likely matched the keyword 'Trustpilot'. ScamDoc rates gravipack.com 86 % (first analysis 31/07/2020), and franceverif rates it 'site fiable'. The issue is unanswered criticism, not a fraud record.

Why it matters: People search for 'avis', 'arnaque', 'fiable' or 'test' just before they buy. Gravipack sells bags at roughly €90-€290 on health-adjacent claims. For that kind of product, Trust is the most important part of E-E-A-T, and Google's Quality Rater Guidelines tell raters to judge reputation from independent reviews. An unanswered June 2026 refund complaint in the #1 result tells a buyer that ordering is risky and that nobody will answer. A public, factual reply is also what every later reader sees, so one reply works for months. The positive material (i-trekkings, Decathlon 4.1/5, 5-star Trustpilot reviews) exists but is not linked from any owned page. AI answer engines that draw on these same pages may summarise the brand the same way. That is a hypothesis to test with an AI-visibility check, not established evidence.

Effect on SEO: The main effect is on click-through and conversion for brand + 'avis'/'arnaque' searches, and on the reputation signals behind Trust. It is not a direct ranking penalty. Replies turn the #1 Trustpilot result from a liability into proof of service. A substantial owned 'avis' page, built by upgrading an already-indexed URL, can earn a top-10 place for 'gravipack avis'. Product reviews collected from verified buyers on the site make product pages eligible for review snippets (Product aggregateRating). Third-party ratings never are.

Impact 7/10 · Effort Medium · Confidence confirmed
findings.recommendation: 1. **This week: settle the open cases before replying.** Find the June 2026 order and any other unrefunded return in WooCommerce > Commandes and issue the refund (Commande > Rembourser, through the payment gateway). The legal deadline is 14 days after the customer withdraws, and the refund can wait until the goods come back (art. L221-24 C. conso). If the buyer ordered from a marketplace seller (Kid'abord on Decathlon or Nature & Découvertes), arrange the refund with that seller. 2. **Within 7 days, reply publicly to all 9 reviews from the existing claimed account** (business.trustpilot.com > Avis > Répondre), starting with the 2026 refund complaints. Sign with a first name. Make no health promises. Never ask a reviewer to change a rating; Trustpilot lets them update the review once the case is resolved. Do not flag genuine negative reviews. French templates (fill the brackets; post the refund reply only once the refund has gone through): - Refund: « Bonjour [Prénom], merci d'avoir pris le temps d'écrire, et pardon : deux mois sans réponse après un retour, ce n'est pas acceptable. Nous avons retrouvé votre commande n° [xxxx]. Le remboursement de [montant] € a été effectué le [date] sur votre moyen de paiement d'origine. Si vous ne le voyez pas sous 5 jours ouvrés, écrivez-nous à [adresse SAV] avec ce numéro : je m'en occupe personnellement. [Prénom], service client Gravipack » - Pain or comfort: « Bonjour [Prénom], merci pour ce retour détaillé. Les bretelles se règlent selon votre taille et la charge, et un réglage inadapté peut créer des points de pression. Nous vous proposons un appel de 15 minutes pour vérifier le réglage ensemble [ou un échange de bretelles d'une autre taille]. Nos sacs ne sont pas un traitement médical : si la douleur persiste, parlez-en à un professionnel de santé. [Prénom], Gravipack » - Strap or quality defect: « Bonjour [Prénom], désolés que la sangle se soit détachée : c'est couvert par la garantie. Envoyez une photo et votre n° de commande à [adresse SAV], nous expédions la pièce de remplacement sous [x] jours. » - Delay: « Vous avez raison, [x] mois d'attente sur une précommande, c'est trop long et nous aurions dû vous prévenir. Les délais de livraison sont désormais datés sur chaque précommande : [lien]. » (only if true) - Positive: « Merci [Prénom] ! Ravis que le remplacement sous garantie ait été rapide. Bonnes randonnées avec votre [modèle] ! » 3. **Set a 48-hour reply standard.** Send Trustpilot alerts to the customer-service inbox and reply to every new review, positive or negative. 4. **Invite every buyer, with no filtering.** Install the official Trustpilot WooCommerce plugin and turn on automatic invitations (AFS), triggered when an order reaches 'Terminée', about 7-10 days after delivery. Alternatively, BCC the AFS address in the 'Commande terminée' email. Use one review platform; Trustpilot is the one that ranks first. Choosing which customers to invite breaks Trustpilot's rules. Art. L111-7-2 and D111-16 to D111-19 C. conso also require a public notice. Example: « Comment nous collectons les avis : tous nos clients reçoivent une invitation après livraison ; les avis sont publiés sans sélection, positifs comme négatifs, par Trustpilot, qui indique s'ils sont vérifiés. » 5. **Collect product reviews on the site.** In WooCommerce > Réglages > Produits, enable reviews, star ratings, the 'Propriétaire vérifié' label and 'avis uniquement par des propriétaires vérifiés'. Send a review-request email to every completed order (e.g. CusRev or a similar plugin). Use only these reviews for Product aggregateRating. Never mark up Trustpilot, Google or Fnac ratings, and never put a rating on the Organization or the home page; Google treats that as self-serving. 6. **Turn the existing /gravipackers/ page into the owned answer page** rather than creating a new URL; it already appears in brand searches. - New title and H1: « Avis Gravipack : avis clients et tests indépendants ». - Show each platform's rating as dated text with a link, low scores included: Trustpilot 3,1/5 (9 avis), Decathlon 4,1/5 (26), Google [x/y], Fnac. - Summarise the i-trekkings and Outzer tests fairly, with the brand's response: measured volume and measurement method, country of manufacture. - Add a section « Gravipack est-il fiable ? »: legal entity and SIREN, registered office, warranty, returns and refund process and deadlines, real delivery times, after-sales contact, links to the CGV and mentions légales. - Link to the evidence page about the 92 % claim and the study. - Add a footer link « Avis & preuves » and a link from every product page near the add-to-cart button. - FAQ content helps users and AI answers but earns no FAQ rich result for a commercial site. These were restricted in August 2023, and claude-seo records them as retired on 7 May 2026. 7. **Outzer:** post one courteous public response, using the comment or right-of-reply feature if Outzer offers one. Give the measured litre volume with its method and the countries of manufacture of the bag and the inserts, and offer the reviewer an exchange. Do not dispute the reviewer's experience. 8. **randonner-leger** (after the evidence page is live, and within the forum's rules on commercial posts): one post from a named account that discloses its affiliation. Example: « Bonjour, je suis [Prénom Nom], [fonction] chez Gravipack, je le précise d'emblée. Plusieurs questions de ce fil sont légitimes : ce que mesure exactement le chiffre de 92 %, le statut de l'étude de 2019 et le report de charge vers les lombaires. Nous avons publié les réponses, le protocole et ses limites ici : [URL]. Je réponds volontiers aux questions techniques. » Optionally, post an English version on bushwalk. Never use anonymous or fake accounts. 9. **Optional: lend units to independent testers** (i-trekkings, Outzer, outdoor YouTubers). Require clear disclosure under loi n° 2023-451, and never mark up incentivised reviews. 10. **Monitoring:** set up Google Alerts or Talkwalker Alerts for 'Gravipack' + avis/arnaque/escroquerie, and watch signal-arnaques, ScamDoc and Que Choisir. Check 'gravipack avis', 'gravipack arnaque' and 'gravipack fiable' monthly in a French rank tracker.

findings.title: #13 For 'gravipack', an obsolete 2020 crowdfunding page comes first and the home page ranked only #6-#9 in the results we sampled
findings.description:
All positions below come from the search results we sampled: a US-located, non-Google index in extended mode. They varied between runs and are not Google.fr rankings.

**Query 'gravipack', two runs**
- **Run 1:**
  - #1 KissKissBankBank /en/projects/gravipack (the 2020 campaign, in the English interface)
  - #2 LinkedIn company page
  - #3 YouTube @Gravipack
  - #4 YouTube /c/Gravipack
  - #5 equilibre-france-ergonomie (reseller blog)
  - #6 www /gravipackers/
  - #7 apex home page
  - #8 www Austerlitz product
  - #9 apex /nos-engagements/
- **Re-run:**
  - #1 KissKissBankBank
  - #2-#3 YouTube
  - #4 www /gravipackers/
  - #5 apex boutique
  - #6 www Austerlitz
  - #7 /nos-engagements/
  - #8 Hiking 30 L Gris
  - #9 apex home page
  - Owned URLs (site plus YouTube) took 8 of 9 slots.
- **What held in both runs:** the 2020 crowdfunding page was #1; the home page sat between #6 and #9 and was never the top owned result; apex and www URLs were mixed in the results.
- Earlier standard-mode runs that showed no gravipack.com URL at all are an artefact of that mode, which also missed gravipack.com on generic searches where extended mode ranked it. They are discarded.

**Other brand-modifier searches**
- **'gravipack prix':**
  - #1 Decathlon brand collection
  - #2 Fnac brand page (most listings out of stock)
  - #3 the 2023 KissKissBankBank SmartBag campaign 'à 89 €'
  - #4 /boutique-gravipack/
  - #5 www /boutique-gravipack/?order=price (a sorting-parameter duplicate)
  - #6-#8 Rome, Helsinki, G-Pack
  - #9 legacy presta.gravipack.com
- **'gravipack sac à dos':** #1 i-trekkings, #2 ergo-corner, #3 /nos-engagements/ (title 'GraviPack®' or 'Nos engagements'), #4 compostelle-autrement, #5 boutique, #6 home page.
- **'gravipack exosquelette':** works well, with 8 of 9 results owned and the home page at #3.
- 'gravipack avis' and 'gravipack arnaque' are covered in the review-SERP finding.

**The 4 KissKissBankBank campaigns**
- /projects/gravipack (ended 10/10/2020; 745 contributions; 1,437 % of goal, not 1,437 pre-orders; Sherpa 45 limited edition at 89 € instead of 149 €)
- gravipack-lesacadosenapesanteur (2022; 294 contributions; 962 %)
- the SmartBag campaign (2023; 618 contributions; 2,544 %; 89 € offer)
- the children's schoolbag campaign (2024; 100 contributions)

The 2020 and 2023 pages still advertise 89 € prices, while current store prices are higher (e.g. Sherpa 45 at €119-€149.90). KissKissBankBank support now redirects to Ulule, so asking the platform for edits is unlikely to work, but the project owner can still post news updates.

Why it matters: People who type the brand name are the brand's highest-intent visitors. If a 2020 campaign page with an 89 € price is the first thing they see, some leave the official funnel or arrive with a wrong price in mind. When the home page sits at #6-#9 and is never the first owned result, search engines are not getting a clear signal about which URL is the brand's home. Duplicate apex and www URLs, an indexed legacy subdomain and a parameter duplicate all add to that noise. AI search tools that ground answers in non-Google indexes (Copilot through Bing, ChatGPT search) build their 'what is Gravipack' answer from the same top results.

Effect on SEO: Brand clicks leak to KissKissBankBank, retailers and reviews. Sitelinks and a knowledge panel become less likely, and AI answers are anchored on outdated third-party pages. On Google.fr the official home page may already rank first, which only Search Console can confirm. If it does, the problem is mostly about Bing and AI-index visibility, and severity should drop to Low.

Impact 5/10 · Effort Medium · Confidence likely
findings.recommendation: 0. **Measure before changing anything.** - In Search Console > Performance, filter the query to exactly 'gravipack', then to the regex ^gravipack. Note the average position, CTR and landing pages (home page vs /gravipackers/ vs others), split by host (apex vs www). - Run a manual google.fr check in a private window with &gl=fr&hl=fr, or use a French rank tracker. - In Bing Webmaster Tools (import the site from Search Console), check the same query, since Bing feeds Copilot. - If the home page is #1 on Google.fr with sitelinks, treat this finding as Low and do only steps 3-5. 1. **Consolidate the hosts** (host-consolidation finding). Keep whichever host Google already selects as canonical. Match WordPress Address and Site Address to it, then redirect the other host in one hop, path preserved: ```apache # Only once the canonical host is confirmed (www shown as an example) RewriteEngine On RewriteCond %{HTTP_HOST} ^gravipack\.com$ [NC] RewriteRule ^ https://www.gravipack.com%{REQUEST_URI} [R=301,L] ``` - Let the SEO plugin's canonical tags send ?order= and other parameter URLs to the clean URL, and stop linking to sorted URLs. - Retire presta.gravipack.com with 1:1 301 redirects to the matching new URLs (legacy-presta finding). 2. **Home page title and site name.** Confirm the live title starts with the brand: one snapshot showed 'Gravipack : le sac révolutionnaire…', another 'Le sac bureautique ou randonnée révolutionnaire…'. Set it in Yoast or Rank Math (the static home page's SEO box) to « Gravipack® – Sac à dos à exosquelette | Site officiel » (53 characters). Output WebSite JSON-LD with name 'Gravipack' through the plugin's site-name setting (Yoast: Représentation du site; Rank Math: Titres & métas > SEO local) so Google can show the right site name. 3. **KissKissBankBank, all 4 campaigns.** As project owner, post a final news update on each, and add the store link to the creator profile wherever the dashboard still allows it. Example: « Cette campagne est terminée – merci à nos 745 contributeurs ! Les modèles et les prix actuels sont sur notre boutique officielle : https://[hôte canonique]/boutique-gravipack/. Garantie et SAV : [lien contact]. » Adjust the contributor count for each campaign. 4. **Make the owned URLs that already rank explicit.** - Give /nos-engagements/ a descriptive title, e.g. « Nos engagements : fabrication, garantie et SAV | Gravipack », and a meta description. - Turn /gravipackers/ into the reviews and independent-tests page (review-SERP finding). - Keep /boutique-gravipack/ consistent on price with the marketplaces. 5. **Point owned profiles to the canonical home page.** Rename the YouTube channel from 'Gravipack zero gravity backpack' to « Gravipack – sac à dos à exosquelette », and set its About links, the LinkedIn website field and the Instagram and Facebook bio links to the canonical home page. These profiles already hold #2-#4 on the brand query. 6. **Track monthly.** Do a brand results-page snapshot ('gravipack', 'gravipack prix', 'gravipack sac à dos') in a French rank tracker, plus the Search Console brand-query report.

findings.title: #23 Company facts are stale or conflicting across the contact page and third-party profiles (legal name, seat, headcount, awards)
findings.description:
**What the registries say** (annuaire-entreprises.data.gouv.fr, societe.com, verif.com, Pappers): there is one company, EXOSQUELETTE LIGHT SAS, SIREN 840 543 383.
- Name history: created on 12/06/2018 in Sens as GRAVIBAG, renamed GRAVIPACK on 1 July 2022, then EXOSQUELETTE LIGHT (shareholders' meeting of 02/01/2025).
- Registered office: Sens (2018), then 46 rue de la Bienfaisance, 94300 Vincennes (end of 2022), then 10 rue de la Paix, 75002 Paris since 19/05/2026 (siège SIRET 840 543 383 00045).
- Share capital 16 960 €. President Mohammed Errafi since 2018. Active, with no employees declared.
- These are successive states of one company, so the address history is a timeline, not a contradiction. The mentions légales (indexed snippet: EXOSQUELETTE LIGHT, Paris, hosted by Gandi) already match.

**Still stale or inconsistent:**
- **Owned site:** two contact URLs, /contacts/ (apex) and /contact-gravipack/ (www), showing the Vincennes address in the phase-1 snapshot. The seller identity in the CGV has not been checked.
- **LinkedIn company page:** headquarters Vincennes and a size band of '201-500 employees', while the page's own structured data says 5 and the registry declares none. It has 1,850-1,884 followers.
- **Facebook:** places the brand in Sens, with the bio 'Sac a Dos en Apesanteur - Innovation Française'.
- **Four descriptors for one product:** the YouTube channel is named 'Gravipack zero gravity backpack', the 2023 KissKissBankBank campaign says 'SmartBag', Facebook says 'apesanteur' and the site says 'exosquelette'.
- **Model names:** Atlas 33 (Facebook), Hiking 33 (Decathlon, Fnac), Hiking 30 L (site).
- **Sales:** '500 000 clients satisfaits' on the site against '>20 000' sold in Maddyness (2024); see the social-proof finding.
- **Patents:** 13 (site, LinkedIn) against 9 (older founder posts, fnh.ma). The two counts are compatible: INPI's 2022 profile lists 1 French, 9 international and 3 pending. But no owned page shows the breakdown or any publication numbers.
- **Third-party listings** (not owned, but they can be claimed or corrected):
  - PagesJaunes pros/60790927 ('Gravipack à Vincennes - Maroquinerie', 0 reviews) and a duplicate, pros/62263007
  - Mappy entry at 46 r Bienfaisance
  - rubypayeur ('EXOSQUELETTE LIGHT à VINCENNES'), which ranks #6 for 'gravipack arnaque' in our sample
  - motherbase.ai (Vincennes), an AI-generated directory that appears in brand results
  - myfrenchstartup (company name GRAVIBAG)
  - lespepitestech (Sens, plus a 'French Tech Aix-Marseille Région Sud' tag with no registry basis)
- **Press attribution:** Journal du Geek (2021) calls it 'un sac conçu par Kid'abord'. Kid'abord is a separate company acting as licensee and marketplace seller ('vendu et expédié par KID'ABORD' on Decathlon and Nature & Découvertes). SODILOG in Colmar is the returns address for those listings. These are distribution roles, not competing identities, but no owned page explains them.

**Not real conflicts (no action needed):** the head-office moves; the Concours Lépine 2018 silver and the Ministry of Defence innovation silver, which are two separate claimed awards; the INPI Trophées 2022 profile saying 'Sens', which was correct at the time; forumeco's 'Gravibag, la SAS détentrice de la marque Gravipack', which is historically correct.

**Unknown:** /faq/ and /nos-engagements/ are indexed but we could not see their content, so we cannot say the site has no facts page. The existing about page (/a-propos-de-nous-gravipack-au-service-de-votre-dos/) is the right place for the facts; a new URL is not needed.

Why it matters: Google's Quality Rater Guidelines begin the Trust assessment with 'who is responsible for this website'. French law requires the site to identify its publisher (LCEN art. 1-1, since the loi SREN of 2024). Search engines and AI assistants reconcile company facts across sources. When LinkedIn says 201-500 staff in Vincennes, Facebook says Sens and the registry says Paris with no employees, answers either hedge or repeat the stale value. Forum sceptics also treat such inconsistencies as red flags. Gravipack is an e-commerce brand, not a local shop, so the gain is a clearer company identity rather than local ranking, and any knowledge-panel benefit is indirect.

Effect on SEO: Google's Knowledge Graph and AI assistants can resolve the company more cleanly ('Qui est derrière Gravipack ?', 'où est basée l'entreprise ?'), and fewer stale facts get quoted. It also produces the reliable references a future Wikidata item would need. Expect no direct ranking effect; the gain is in Trust and in how the brand is described.

Impact 4/10 · Effort Low · Confidence confirmed
findings.recommendation: 1. **Write one internal master fact sheet** with an owner and a review date. It should cover: - legal name and former names with dates; SIREN and the registered-office SIRET - registered office and, if one exists, an operating or after-sales address, labelled as such. Whether 10 rue de la Paix is a domiciliation address is unverified, so don't present it as a shop. - founding date and place, and the president - the GRAVIPACK trademark (filed 27/05/2019 according to societe.com; add the registration number) - patents as a dated breakdown with publication numbers - awards (see the awards finding) and a sales figure with its date and source - distribution roles: Kid'abord as licensee and marketplace seller, SODILOG Colmar as returns logistics, other licensees only if confirmed - headcount, stated honestly 2. **Publish a dated « Gravipack en bref » block on the existing about page** /a-propos-de-nous-gravipack-au-service-de-votre-dos/. Check /faq/ and /nos-engagements/ first so nothing is duplicated. Example: « Gravipack® est une marque d'EXOSQUELETTE LIGHT SAS (anciennement GRAVIBAG puis GRAVIPACK SAS), SIREN 840 543 383, fondée le 12 juin 2018 à Sens (Yonne) par Mohammed Errafi, inventeur de l'exosquelette de bretelles. Siège social : 10 rue de la Paix, 75002 Paris (depuis mai 2026). Brevets : 1 français, 9 internationaux, 3 demandes en cours (au [date] ; n° …). Nos sacs sont vendus sur gravipack.com et, sous licence, par Kid'abord sur Decathlon.fr et Nature & Découvertes. Mise à jour : [date]. » 3. **Bring the mentions légales in line with LCEN art. 1-1.** Article 6-III no longer exists since 23/05/2024. Text: « Le site gravipack.com est édité par EXOSQUELETTE LIGHT, SAS au capital de 16 960 €, RCS Paris 840 543 383, siège social : 10 rue de la Paix, 75002 Paris. TVA intracommunautaire : FR[clé]840543383. Contact : [e-mail] – [téléphone]. Directeur de la publication : Mohammed Errafi, Président. Hébergeur : Gandi SAS, [adresse, téléphone]. Gravipack® est une marque d'EXOSQUELETTE LIGHT. » Use the same identity for the seller in the CGV and in WooCommerce > Réglages > Général > Adresse de la boutique, which appears on invoices and emails. 4. **Merge the contact pages.** Keep whichever of /contacts/ or /contact-gravipack/ has more links and traffic, and 301 the other to it (Rank Math > Redirections or the Redirection plugin). Show « Siège social : 10 rue de la Paix, 75002 Paris » and, if relevant, « Adresse SAV / d'exploitation : … ». 5. **Update the owned profiles within 2 weeks:** - LinkedIn: headquarters Paris 75002, the real size band (e.g. 2-10), website = the canonical home page - Facebook About: location and descriptor - Instagram bio - YouTube channel name and About, e.g. « Gravipack – sac à dos à exosquelette » - the KissKissBankBank creator profile - the Decathlon brand text, through the licensee - Pick one descriptor (« sac à dos à exosquelette ») and map the old names openly, e.g. « Atlas 33, aujourd'hui Hiking 33 » and « SmartBag (campagne 2023) ». 6. **Third-party listings:** - Claim the PagesJaunes listing with a free Solocal account, merge pros/62263007 into pros/60790927, change the category from 'Maroquinerie' to a backpack-manufacturing category, and update the address in step with the local SEO finding. - Ask for corrections at myfrenchstartup (company name), lespepitestech (remove the Aix-Marseille tag unless it is real) and motherbase.ai (address). - Registry-fed sites (rubypayeur, societe.com) update themselves. - Leave INPI's 2022 page as it is. 7. **Ask Journal du Geek for a one-line attribution fix**, only if it is accurate: « inventé par Mohammed Errafi (Gravipack), fabriqué et distribué sous licence par Kid'abord ». 8. **Use the same sheet for the Organization JSON-LD** on the home and about pages only, on the canonical host (this links to the schema finding). In recent Yoast versions: Réglages > Représentation du site > Organisation, including the extra organisation fields (legal name, founding date, VAT, ISO 6523). In Rank Math: Titres & métas > SEO local, plus the `rank_math/json_ld` filter for missing properties. Example: ```json {"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Organization","@id":"https://www.gravipack.com/#organization","name":"Gravipack","legalName":"EXOSQUELETTE LIGHT","alternateName":["GRAVIPACK SAS","GRAVIBAG"],"url":"https://www.gravipack.com/","logo":"https://www.gravipack.com/wp-content/uploads/[logo].png","foundingDate":"2018-06-12","founder":{"@type":"Person","name":"Mohammed Errafi","jobTitle":"Président"},"iso6523Code":"0002:840543383","vatID":"FR[clé]840543383","address":{"@type":"PostalAddress","streetAddress":"10 rue de la Paix","postalCode":"75002","addressLocality":"Paris","addressCountry":"FR"},"sameAs":["https://fr.linkedin.com/company/gravipack","https://www.youtube.com/@Gravipack","https://www.instagram.com/gravipack/","https://www.facebook.com/gravipack/"]} ``` Use whichever host the host-consolidation fix selects; www is only an example. Trustpilot, Decathlon and KissKissBankBank pages are weak sameAs targets. 9. **Optional: a Wikidata item**, only with independent references and a declared conflict of interest. Record past head offices with start and end dates rather than overwriting them.

findings.title: #27 On-site social-proof figures ('4,7 sur Google' from 1,121-1,175 reviews, '500 000 clients satisfaits') are not independently verified
findings.description:
Search snippets of gravipack.com pages, on both the apex and www hosts, show a '4,7' Google rating. Each page gives a different review count:
- 'plus de 1121 avis' (Hiking model)
- 'plus de 1126 avis' (Kingston)
- 'plus de 1175 avis' on a page titled 'Avis Google des clients Gravipack'

Pages seen with the rating: Rome, Hiking Terracotta, Kingston, Tokyo, Hiking Gris, Sherpa Kaki (on the /produit-gravipack/ path) and accessories (strap buckle, shoulder pads). The same pages claim '500 000 clients satisfaits'.

**Outside support for the rating is weak, but it exists.**
- An aggregator page reports 4.7/5 from 998 Google reviews for 'Gravipack - Vincennes' (groupe-ranque.fr/gravipack/). That page is titled 'Gravipack - Vincennes - Sécurité et Stockage Blindé', and phase 1 flagged it as a possible unrelated business with the same name.
- compostelle-autrement writes '4,8/5 sur Google avec déjà plus de 900 avis'. It may be repeating the brand's own figure.
- Counts of 900, then 998, then 1,121-1,175 fit a real Google Business Profile that keeps gaining reviews. But no Google Maps or Business Profile URL surfaced in our searches, and PagesJaunes shows 0 reviews.
- The accurate status is therefore 'not independently verified', not 'false' or 'first-party only'.

**Other platforms are lower, not contradictory:** Decathlon collection 4.1/5 (26 reviews), Decathlon brand page 3.88/5 (16), Trustpilot 3.1/5 (9), Fnac Road Adventure about 3/5 (8).

**'500 000 clients satisfaits' has no source** and is far out of scale with every other sales figure. Maddyness (February 2024) reports more than 20 000 bags sold, and other brand and press material says '20 000 sacs vendus'. 'Satisfaits' also implies a satisfaction measure that is never shown.

The site could not be fetched, so we could not check whether any of these figures feeds Product aggregateRating markup.

Why it matters: 1. **Credibility.** Three different counts typed into page text look made up to careful buyers, to forum sceptics who already question the brand's figures, and to AI systems that cross-check numbers. A '500 000' figure that is 25 times the documented '20 000' undermines every other claim on the page.
2. **French law.** Art. L111-7-2 and D111-17 C. conso require anyone who displays reviews to say whether and how they are checked. Unsupported figures can count as a misleading commercial practice (art. L121-2 C. conso).
3. **Structured data (conditional).** Google's review-snippet rules require product ratings to be about the specific product and collected on the page. Google reviews of the business are not product reviews, and Google ignores self-serving ratings on Organization or LocalBusiness markup. If a widget injects this 4.7 into Product aggregateRating, the site risks losing review rich results or a structured-data manual action.

Effect on SEO: These figures bring no ranking gain; the risk only runs the other way. Possible consequences: lost review snippets or a manual action if business reviews are marked up as product ratings; weaker Trust signals and 'conflicting ratings' in AI shopping answers; and a hook for a consumer complaint that would then rank for brand searches. A single dated figure with a source link removes all three risks.

Impact 4/10 · Effort Low · Confidence likely
findings.recommendation: 1. **Trace the source.** In Google Business Profile Manager, confirm that the 'Gravipack' profile with about 1,100 reviews belongs to EXOSQUELETTE LIGHT, and note its current rating, count and address. If it is not yours (for example, if the Vincennes aggregator listing is a different business), remove every '4,7 sur Google' mention. The profile's eligibility (an online-only seller whose Vincennes address became outdated after the May 2026 move to Paris) is covered in the local SEO finding. Fix that first, because a suspended profile would make the figure vanish. 2. **Show one figure from one place.** Replace the per-product text with a single reusable block: a Gutenberg synced pattern, or a shortcode in the WooCommerce single-product template. Example: « ★ 4,7/5 sur Google – 1 175 avis au 1er octobre 2026 · Voir tous nos avis Google » linking to the profile's reviews. Update it monthly. Alternatively, use a widget that fetches the rating live with Google attribution and does not store review content beyond what Google Maps Platform terms allow. 3. **Check the markup.** Run the Rich Results Test on 3 product pages. - aggregateRating must come only from product reviews collected on that page (native WooCommerce reviews from verified owners). - If a Google-reviews widget plugin, or custom schema in Rank Math or Yoast, outputs aggregateRating or Review from Google reviews, turn that schema output off. - Never add a rating to the Organization or home-page markup. 4. **'500 000 clients satisfaits'.** Find every occurrence, for example with `wp db search "clients satisfaits" --all-tables` (the '500 000' may contain a non-breaking space). - Either source it with a dated count of orders across the store and its licensees, or replace it with a documented figure, e.g. « plus de 20 000 sacs vendus (chiffre 2024) ». - Drop 'satisfaits' unless a satisfaction survey with a stated method and date backs it. 5. **Add the review notice required by L111-7-2 / D111-17** next to every rating, or as a linked « Comment nous collectons les avis » page: « Les notes Google affichées proviennent de notre fiche Google [lien] au [date] ; Gravipack ne contrôle pas ces avis. Les avis produits publiés sur ce site sont réservés aux clients ayant acheté le produit (libellé « Propriétaire vérifié ») ; ils sont publiés sans sélection, positifs comme négatifs, et classés du plus récent au plus ancien. » 6. **Don't cherry-pick.** On the reviews page (see the review-SERP finding), show every platform's rating with its date, including Trustpilot 3,1/5, so the Google figure is seen in context.

findings.title: #32 Awards are real but under-sourced, and the army and special-forces claims rest on founder statements and undated owned posts
findings.description:
**Confirmed**
- **Trophées INPI 2022:** finalist in the 'Start-up' category, stated on inpi.fr's Gravipack profile and in INPI's list of 15 finalists for 2022.
- **Concours Lépine:** a 2018 silver medal is stated consistently by Europe 1 (Trophées de l'Avenir 2023 profile: 'médaille d'argent au concours Lépine 2018') and Neozone. No source gives 2017. The brand adds 'parmi 523 participants internationaux'. The legacy presta.gravipack.com page ('Médaille d'argent concours Lépine international') gives no year, and no official results list from the organiser was found.
- **Europe 1 Trophées de l'Avenir 2023:** nominee.

**Founder-sourced only**
- 'Testé par l'armée française' (Neozone) and 'l'armée de terre teste, en conditions réelles' (forumeco) are the inventor's statements relayed by the press.
- Only challenge.ma names the Légion étrangère (a 6-month test in 2017).
- A 2018 'médaille d'argent de l'innovation militaire' (Ministry of Defence silver) is relayed by Neozone, fnh.ma and challenge.ma without an event name.
- No Ministère des Armées or DGA document was found.

**Owned surfaces**
- The home page lists Armée de Terre, Légion étrangère, Préfecture de police, gendarmerie, pompiers and régions/départements as users.
- The YouTube channel has a playlist presenting an Army/Légion test.
- The founder's LinkedIn mentions 'invité d'honneur de deux salons militaires', 57 delegations, and 'intégré au sein de l'Armée française et des FS'.
- Blog posts:
  - /gravipack-soulage-les-forces-speciales-au-sofins/: exhibiting at SOFINS, an industry seminar, is not an endorsement, and 'soulage les forces spéciales' implies more than attendance. No third-party SOFINS page was found. Its /test/ duplicate is covered in the duplicate-pages finding.
  - /gravipack-presentees-au-salon-militaire-techterre-combat-futur/: our searches found no trace of a 'Techterre Combat Futur' show.
  - The two posts give different capacity ranges (20-100 L and 20-60 L), possibly for different products (needs a page check).
- The blog has dates (/articles/, 2022-2025), so 'undated' applies only to how these posts appear in search snippets.

**For contrast, a documented institutional reference:** RATP documents its own use on ratpgroup.com. Its CSR page names 'the exoskeleton backpack, developed by Gravipack', and its VivaTech 2023 pages report about 50 roaming maintenance workers equipped. So institutional-user claims are not all owned-only. The owned figure of '250 agents' still has to be reconciled with RATP's figure (RATP finding).

Why it matters: Awards and institutional references are standard authority signals, but only when a reader can check them at the source. The INPI finalist status is the strongest third-party trust asset the brand has, and it is barely used. Vague military endorsements imply institutional backing. Under art. L121-4 C. conso, claiming that a public body approved a product when it did not is treated as misleading. On the brand's forum threads, sceptics already test claims like these, and an unverifiable one turns into evidence against the brand. Defence and public buyers also check references.

Effect on SEO: The SEO effect is small. A dated, sourced awards page gives journalists and AI engines quotable facts, supports Organization award markup and can earn links from inpi.fr or event organisers. Rewording the military claims removes a trust liability that sceptics could cite. Expect no direct ranking change.

Impact 3/10 · Effort Low · Confidence likely
findings.recommendation: 1. **Create one « Distinctions & preuves » page**, or a section of the existing about page. For each item give the date, organiser, category, result and a source link: - « Trophées INPI 2022 – finaliste, catégorie Start-up » → link to the inpi.fr profile - « Concours Lépine International (Paris), 2018 – médaille d'argent [catégorie] » → a photo of the diploma or an attestation from the organiser (AIFF); link the Europe 1 profile until an official results list is found - « Trophées de l'Avenir Europe 1, 2023 – nommé » → europe1.fr - « Médaille d'argent [nom exact du concours d'innovation de défense], 2018 » → only with the exact event name and a document; otherwise leave it out - « Salon SOFINS [année] – exposant » → the organiser's exhibitor list - RATP → link RATP's own pages 2. **Reword the military claims to what is documented:** - « Présenté au salon SOFINS [année] » instead of « soulage les forces spéciales ». - « Prototype évalué en 2017 par des militaires de l'Armée de terre (retours d'essai internes, non publiés) » only with a written attestation. Otherwise remove the army test wording. - Remove « Légion étrangère », army insignia and institutional logos from the home page's user list and from the YouTube playlist title unless you hold written permission. 3. **Techterre 'Combat Futur' post:** add the organiser, date, place, a link and stand photos. If the event cannot be documented, unpublish the post and 301 it to the blog's military category. Use one capacity range in both posts, or name the product each range refers to. 4. **Dates and markup on news posts:** make sure every post shows a visible publication date and outputs BlogPosting or Article with datePublished and dateModified. Yoast and Rank Math do this for posts by default; check that the theme doesn't hide the date. Do not use NewsArticle, which brings no Top Stories eligibility for a brand blog. 5. **Organization markup:** add the award property, e.g. `"award": ["Finaliste des Trophées INPI 2022 (catégorie Start-up)", "Médaille d'argent, Concours Lépine International 2018"]`. 6. **Consolidate the award pages.** Move the presta Lépine page into the new page and 301 it there (part of the presta redirect plan). Link the two existing award posts (the Concours Lépine post and 'récompensé et prêt à conquérir…') to the new page. 7. **Ask for listings with a website link:** the SOFINS organiser's exhibitor directory, and the Concours Lépine organiser's winners list.

categories.name: E-commerce & Marketplaces (supplementary)
what_works: Broad distribution (Decathlon, Nature & Découvertes, Au Vieux Campeur, Fnac) gives demand-side visibility

findings.title: #2 Marketplaces, resellers and old crowdfunding pages outrank gravipack.com for its own model names (Sherpa, Hiking 33, Feather, Business Talk)
findings.description:
**What we saw.** In the search results we sampled, third-party pages outrank gravipack.com for the brand's own model names, and for some models the official store does not appear at all. These positions come from a US-located, non-Google index in extended mode, which is closer to a real top 10. Brand results change between runs, so treat positions as indicative.
- **'gravipack sherpa' (run twice).** Positions #1-#6 are KissKissBankBank (2020 campaign), Trustpilot, KissKissBankBank (2022 campaign), the Decathlon Sherpa 45 listing, the Nature & Découvertes Sherpa bleu and the Au Vieux Campeur Sherpa 45. The first gravipack.com URL (Sherpa orange) is #7; it was #6 in the first run.
- **'gravipack hiking 33' (run twice).** decathlon.fr/vc/gravipack is #1 and KissKissBankBank #2. Three Fnac Hiking 33 listings with tracking parameters hold #3, #5 and #6, the Decathlon Hiking 33 listing #4, Équilibre France Ergonomie #7 and the Nature & Découvertes Hiking Terracota #8. The legacy presta.gravipack.com Hiking33 page is #9. The main store is absent from the top 10; it was #9 in the first run.
- **'gravipack feather cartable'.** The main store is absent. KissKissBankBank, Au Vieux Campeur, Nature & Découvertes (4 URLs), Fnac and Kiabi (2) rank, and only the legacy presta Feather page appears, at #10.
- **'gravipack business talk'.** The first owned URL (Business Talk V4 20 L) is #7, behind KissKissBankBank (2), Au Vieux Campeur, two YouTube videos (one from BFMTV) and Équilibre. The presta Business Talk page is #9.
- **'gravipack oslo 60+10' is the exception.** Owned pages hold #2-#4 behind the i-trekkings test. The Oslo has the same name everywhere and is rarely sold elsewhere.

**Three visible causes:**
1. **Names do not match.** Retailers and the legacy store say 'Hiking 33' and 'Sherpa 45'. gravipack.com says 'Hiking 30L gris', 'Hiking Terracotta', 'Sherpa bleu', 'Sherpa orange 45L' and 'Sherpa Kaki'. Its titles put the model last and often leave out the capacity, e.g. 'Sac randonnée léger anti mal de dos exosquelette bretelles Sherpa' and 'Sac à dos exosquelette anti-mal de dos de montagne Hiking Gris Gravipack'. No official page contains the query term '33'.
2. **Some models are sold elsewhere but not on the official store.** Feather and Feather Plus are missing from the main store; only presta lists Feather, at 149 € 'en stock'. They are still sold by Decathlon (including Gravipack's own seller account, at 149 €), Nature & Découvertes, Au Vieux Campeur, Kiabi and Fnac. Road Adventure and Safar Vibe are still listed by Fnac, Decathlon or Nature & Découvertes, with no successor shown on gravipack.com.
3. **Legacy and crowdfunding pages keep ranking.** The four KissKissBankBank campaigns are the brand's own pages: /projects/gravipack (2020), gravipack-lesacadosenapesanteur (2022), the 2023 SmartBag campaign and the 2024 children's bag. All four end on a closed campaign instead of a current product. presta.gravipack.com still serves Hiking33, Sherpa 45, Feather, Business Talk, Road Adventure and Safar Vibe pages; the redirect plan for them is in the presta finding.

**Most models do have a successor, but no page says so:**
- Business Talk continues as Business Talk V4 (20 L, 25 L, 25 L EVA).
- Hiking 33 continues as Hiking 30 L gris and Terracotta.
- Sherpa 45 continues as Sherpa 45 L (bleu, orange, kaki).
- City Connect continues as City.
Only Feather, Road Adventure and Safar Vibe have no visible successor.

**Not every one of these clicks is lost.** Part of the Decathlon offer is sold by Gravipack's own account, and the KissKissBankBank pages are the brand's own.

Why it matters: People who search 'gravipack + modèle' have already chosen the brand. These are the brand's highest-intent, highest-margin queries. When they land on a marketplace or a closed crowdfunding page:
- Gravipack loses the direct sale, or the licensee makes it;
- Gravipack loses the customer relationship;
- Gravipack loses control of the price, claims and specs the buyer sees.
Out-of-stock Fnac pages and legacy presta pages with old prices also make a poor first impression.

Effect on SEO: Model pages can win back #1 for 'gravipack <modèle>' queries when they:
- contain every name people search (current name, capacity, legacy name);
- get internal links with the model name as anchor text;
- absorb the presta and KissKissBankBank signals.
This also concentrates links and engagement on official URLs that are eligible for Product rich results and merchant listings, and it reduces how often out-of-stock third-party pages appear for the brand.

Impact 7/10 · Effort Medium · Confidence likely
findings.recommendation: 1. **One canonical URL per model**, with colours as WooCommerce variations (see the duplicate-products finding). Use a short slug, e.g. /produit/sherpa-45/ or /produit/hiking-30/. 2. **Model-first SEO titles and H1s that include the capacity**, set in Yoast or Rank Math: - `Sherpa 45 L – sac de randonnée à exosquelette | Gravipack` - `Hiking 30 L (ex-Hiking 33) – sac de randonnée à exosquelette | Gravipack`.
