First confirm that the Hiking 30 L is the bag retailers sell as Hiking 33, and settle the measured capacity (see the product-data finding). - `Business Talk V4 20 L – sac à dos ordinateur à exosquelette | Gravipack` - H1 example: `Gravipack Sherpa 45 L`. The titles finding decides the 'anti mal de dos' wording. Do not strip it site-wide here. 3. **Show the model's history on each product page**, in a visible line near the title and in the specs table. For example: « Anciennement Hiking 33 : c'est sous ce nom que vous le trouverez chez nos revendeurs (Decathlon, Au Vieux Campeur, Fnac). » Add the legacy name as `alternateName` in the Product JSON-LD. It has no rich-result effect, but it ties the names together. 4. **Publish a page « Nos modèles et leurs anciens noms »** at /modeles-gravipack/ with this table: - Hiking 33 → Hiking 30 L (gris, terracotta), en vente - Sherpa 45 → Sherpa 45 L (bleu, orange, kaki), en vente - Business Talk → Business Talk V4 (20 L, 25 L, 25 L EVA), en vente - City Connect → City, en vente - Feather / Feather Plus → to be decided (step 5) - Road Adventure, Safar Vibe → successor, or « modèle arrêté » Link the page from the footer and the shop. 5. **Decide what to do with Feather.** - Gravipack still sells Feather on Decathlon itself, so the default is to add a Feather / Feather Plus product page on gravipack.com (school bag; sizes under and over 1,55 m). - If Feather is really discontinued, publish « Gravipack Feather – modèle remplacé par … » with `availability: https://schema.org/Discontinued` and a link to the successor. Redirect it once its traffic fades. - Do the same for Road Adventure and Safar Vibe. 6. **Redirect each legacy-store product to its model page:** Hiking33 → Hiking 30 L, Sherpa 45 → Sherpa 45 L, Business Talk → Business Talk V4 20 L, Feather → the Feather page. The presta finding covers how to implement this and the rule that the presta host must keep serving the 301s. 7. **KissKissBankBank.** KKBB support is winding down and points to Ulule, so post the update yourself as the creator. Add a final news update to each of the 4 campaigns, for example: « Le projet est terminé : retrouvez le Sherpa 45 L et toute la gamme sur la boutique officielle → https://www.gravipack.com/produit/sherpa-45/ ». If the project page allows it, also point the creator website link to gravipack.com. 8. **Internal links.** Link every model page from the home page and from the matching category hub, with model-name anchors ('Sherpa 45 L', 'Hiking 30 L', 'Business Talk V4'). 9. **Partner and own listings.** Retitle Gravipack's own Decathlon listings now, e.g. 'Gravipack Business Talk V4 20 L – sac à dos ordinateur à exosquelette'. Ask Kid'abord, Au Vieux Campeur, Équilibre, Ergo-Corner and Nature & Découvertes to use the same model names (content pack in the licensee finding). 10. **Measure in Google Search Console.** Under Performance > Queries, use the regex filter `gravipack.*(sherpa|hiking|feather|business|oslo|city|tokyo)` and track position and clicks per model. Also check the google.fr top 10 by hand once a month.

findings.title: #17 Who sells, makes and services Gravipack products is not explained, and partner listings are partly outside the brand's control
findings.description:
Gravipack products reach buyers through at least three different companies. No owned page that surfaced in our searches explains who does what.

- **Brand owner.** EXOSQUELETTE LIGHT SAS (SIREN 840 543 383, 10 rue de la Paix, 75002 Paris) is registered under NAF 7740Z (licensing of intellectual property) and has no declared employees. In an fnh.ma interview, the founder says the brand and patents are licensed to Décathlon, Packcraft, Kid'abord and BSGroupe. This is his statement; Packcraft and BSGroupe were not checked.
- **Licensee and marketplace seller.** Kid'abord is a separate company that acts as licensee and marketplace seller.
  - On Decathlon.fr, the Sherpa 45, the Hiking 33 and most Feather offers are 'Vendu et expédié par KID'ABORD'.
  - On Nature & Découvertes, Kid'abord sells the Feather Plus and the Hiking Terracota, and returns go to 'SODILOG / RETOUR GRAVIPACK' in Colmar.
  - Journal du Geek (2021) describes Gravipack as a bag 'conçu par Kid'abord, une entreprise de Loire-Atlantique'.
- **The brand's own marketplace account.** Gravipack also sells on Decathlon directly: Business Talk (199 €) and one Feather noir offer (149 €) are 'Vendu et expédié par GRAVIPACK'. Part of the Decathlon content is therefore already under the brand's control, and opening a seller account as a fallback is not needed.
- **Manufacturing origin is unclear.** Third parties describe it differently: compostelle-autrement says 'conçu en France, fabriqué au Portugal ou en Chine', and an Outzer reviewer says 'conçu en Chine'. No owned page in the results states the origin.

**Partner listings diverge from the official line.**
- Decathlon titles carry 'Allège la charge de 92%' (Sherpa 45, Hiking 33, Feather, Pearl).
- Nature & Découvertes files hiking and school bags under /sacs-a-dos-velo/ (bike backpacks).
- The Decathlon brand page averages 3.88/5 (16 ratings), and the Feather noir is at 1.5/5.

**After-sales confusion is visible in the reviews that rank for the brand.** The Trustpilot profile has 3.1/5 from 9 reviews. It has been claimed since December 2020, and none of the negative reviews has a reply.
- A June 2026 review describes a returned bag with no refund and no answer for two months.
- A second 2026 review makes the same complaint.
- An earlier review reports an order that arrived three months late.
A buyer cannot tell whether to contact Gravipack, the licensee or the logistics provider.

**Not checked on the site.** gravipack.com could not be fetched from the audit environment. We could not check whether its CGV, mentions légales and product pages name the seller of record, the manufacturer and the returns handler. The mentions légales snippet shows only EXOSQUELETTE LIGHT (Paris) and the host Gandi.

Why it matters: **Trust.** For online shops, Google's Search Quality Rater Guidelines look at who is responsible for the site, who sells and how customer service and returns work. Buyers ask the same questions about a 90-289 € product sold with health-adjacent claims.

**Law.** Two rules apply:
- The EU General Product Safety Regulation (Reg. 2023/988, art. 19), applicable since 13/12/2024, requires every distance-sale offer to show the manufacturer's name and postal and electronic address, plus product identification and safety information. This covers gravipack.com and marketplaces. If the manufacturer is outside the EU, an EU responsible person must also be shown.
- French distance-selling rules (C. conso. art. L111-1 and L221-5) require the seller's identity and contact details before the order.

If the 'dispositif médical' wording relayed in the press were ever adopted, an identifiable manufacturer under the MDR would also be needed (see the health-claims finding).

**Visible symptom.** The unanswered refund complaints that rank for the brand today come from buyers who do not know who is responsible.

Effect on SEO: This is not a direct ranking factor. The effects are:
- Clear seller, manufacturer and returns information supports Trust and conversion on product pages.
- A business identity that is the same in the CGV, the Organization and Product markup, and the Merchant Center business information reduces misrepresentation risk for merchant listings and free listings.
- Aligned partner titles, claims and categories mean the marketplace pages that hold many brand and model results repeat the official facts. That helps brand-SERP click-through and the facts AI answers repeat.
- A clear after-sales route reduces the new negative reviews that rank for 'gravipack avis'.

Impact 5/10 · Effort Medium · Confidence likely
findings.recommendation: 1. **Map the roles internally (about 1 day).** For each channel and product line, record: - the seller of record; - the GPSR 'fabricant', meaning the company that has the bag designed or made and markets it under its name or trademark (confirm with counsel for licensed products); - the EU responsible person, if the bag is made outside the EU; - the warranty guarantor; - the returns address (e.g. SODILOG Colmar); - the customer-service contact. This table is the single source for steps 2-7. 2. **CGV and mentions légales.** Add an article « Vendeur, fabricant, garanties et retours » to the CGV with: - the seller for gravipack.com orders: EXOSQUELETTE LIGHT SAS, 10 rue de la Paix, 75002 Paris, RCS Paris, SIREN 840 543 383; - the manufacturer; - the returns address and procedure, and the refund deadline (14 days, art. L221-24 C. conso.); - the 2-year garantie légale de conformité plus one Gravipack commercial-warranty duration, stated the same everywhere; - this paragraph: « Les produits Gravipack achetés chez un revendeur (Decathlon, Nature & Découvertes…) sont vendus par ce revendeur : retours et SAV se font auprès de lui. Sans réponse sous 7 jours, contactez-nous à [e-mail SAV]. » Keep the mentions légales identical (LCEN art. 1-1 since the 2024 loi SREN). 3. **GPSR block on every product page.** Add a « Fabricant et garanties » tab fed from product meta, so it is maintained in one place, in a child theme: ```php add_filter( 'woocommerce_product_tabs', function ( $tabs ) { $tabs['gp_fabricant'] = array( 'title' => 'Fabricant et garanties', 'priority' => 25, 'callback' => function () { global $product; $html = get_post_meta( $product->get_id(), '_gp_bloc_fabricant', true ) ?: get_option( 'gp_bloc_fabricant_defaut' ); echo wp_kses_post( wpautop( $html ) ); }, ); return $tabs; } ); ``` Example copy: « Vendu par : Gravipack – EXOSQUELETTE LIGHT SAS, 10 rue de la Paix, 75002 Paris – [e-mail SAV]. Fabricant : [raison sociale], [adresse postale], [e-mail]. Origine : conçu en France, fabriqué en [pays]. Retours et SAV : [adresse de retour], réponse sous 2 jours ouvrés. Garanties : garantie légale de conformité 2 ans + garantie commerciale Gravipack [X] ans ([lien conditions]). » Add the safety and care warnings. 4. **Structured data that says the same.** Product JSON-LD should carry `brand`, `manufacturer` and `offers.seller`. Declare the return policy at Organization level (`hasMerchantReturnPolicy`) or in Search Console's shopping settings. To extend the Product piece, use the `wpseo_schema_product` filter in Yoast WooCommerce SEO or `rank_math/snippet/rich_snippet_product_entity` in Rank Math. For example: ```json {"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Product","name":"Gravipack Sherpa 45 L", "brand":{"@type":"Brand","name":"Gravipack"}, "manufacturer":{"@type":"Organization","name":"[Fabricant]","address":{"@type":"PostalAddress","streetAddress":"[…]","addressLocality":"[…]","addressCountry":"[FR/PT/…]"}}, "offers":{"@type":"Offer","price":149.90,"priceCurrency":"EUR","availability":"https://schema.org/InStock", "seller":{"@type":"Organization","name":"EXOSQUELETTE LIGHT (Gravipack)"}}} ``` Make the Merchant Center business information (name, address, customer-service contacts, return policy) match the CGV. 5. **Licence and partner content pack.** Through the licence with Kid'abord and the reseller agreements, agree on: - the title template « Gravipack [Modèle] [capacité] L – sac à dos à exosquelette »; - specs and GPSR manufacturer data from the master product sheet (see the product-data finding); - claim wording approved against the evidence page, with no 'Allège la charge de 92%' until it is substantiated; - correct categories (randonnée, scolaire, ville; not 'sacs à dos vélo' at Nature & Découvertes); - recommended, not imposed, prices (see the price finding); - an after-sales SLA that says who answers reviews and refund requests, and within what time. Fix Gravipack's own Decathlon listings (Business Talk, Feather noir) first: they are fully in its control. 6. **Split the models between the two Decathlon accounts.** Agree which account lists which model, so Gravipack and Kid'abord do not run competing offers for the same bag (Feather noir at 149 € and at 90 €). 7. **Publish the list of authorised sellers** on the 'Où acheter' page (see the where-to-buy finding). Label each channel « vendu par Gravipack » or « vendu par Kid'abord, licencié Gravipack ». 8. **Answer the ranking after-sales complaints** (Trustpilot, June 2026 and later) and point buyers to the route from step 2 (see the reviews-SERP finding).

findings.title: #20 Prices differ across channels and on gravipack.com itself, with struck 'reference' prices almost everywhere
findings.description:
Prices are as shown in search snippets checked on 12/10/2026. We do not know when the snippets were captured, so some differences reflect timing.

**On gravipack.com itself, one model shows 2-3 prices:**
- Sherpa 45 L: bleu 119 € (struck 249 €), orange and kaki 149.90 €, orange 99 € in a promo list.
- Tokyo: 189 € on one page, 129 € (was 249 €) on another.
- Pearl: 89 € (was 99.90 €), and 119 € in a list.
- Rome: 94.90 € (was 119.90 €), and 119.90 € on its own page.
- Hiking: 89-89.90 €, with list prices of 229 € or 129.90 €.
- Earlier snippets also show the Austerlitz at 79.90, 89.90, 129 and 149.90 €, and the Oslo rouge at 289, 239.92 and 149.90 €.

**Struck 'reference' prices appear on almost every channel:**
- 229 € on the Hiking (Decathlon 129.90 €, Nature & Découvertes 129 €, Au Vieux Campeur 160.30 €);
- 249 € on the Sherpa;
- 299.90 € on the Helsinki (sold at 149 €);
- 149 € on the Austerlitz (89.90 €) and the Business Talk (129 €).
The pattern is long-running: the 2020 KissKissBankBank campaign sold the Sherpa 45 at '89 € au lieu de 149 €', and a 2026 brand result shows a 35 L military model at '89,90 € au lieu de 149 €'. A Decathlon Hiking 33 buyer calls the promotional price 'mensonger', and that review ranks.

**Across channels, the live spread is about 1.5x, not 2.6-2.8x.** The earlier 2.6-2.8x figure mixed live prices with struck reference prices (249 €) and a stale out-of-stock Ergo-Corner price (89.10 €).
- Live Sherpa offers cluster at 149-149.90 €: official orange and kaki, Nature & Découvertes orange, Ergo-Corner bleu and orange.
- Decathlon was at 149.90 € during its promotion of 18/06-30/08/2026; its current price is unknown.
- The outliers are 119 € (official bleu) and 174.30 € (Au Vieux Campeur).

**The brand's own Decathlon account does not match its own store:**
- Business Talk costs 199 € on Decathlon ('Vendu et expédié par GRAVIPACK') and 129 € (was 149 €) on gravipack.com.
- On the same marketplace, Feather noir is offered at 149 € by Gravipack and at 90 € by Kid'abord. The offer dates are unknown.
- The legacy presta store still shows Feather at 149 € 'en stock', while marketplaces sell it at 90-127 €.

**Other gaps:**
- G-Pack: 69.20 € at Ergo-Corner vs 89.90 € official.
- Tokyo: 109.90 € at Ergo-Corner vs 189 € or 129 € official.
- Austerlitz: 99.90 € at Ergo-Corner vs 89.90 € official.
- Business Talk: 139.30 € at Au Vieux Campeur (reference 199 €).
- City is at parity (129.90 €).
- A ProSportEquip snippet showing a Hiking 33 at 40.08 € is unverified.

Why it matters: **Consumer law.** Since 28/05/2022 (art. L112-1-1 Code de la consommation, ordonnance 2021-1734), any announced price reduction in France must use as its reference the lowest price charged in the 30 days before the reduction. Permanent 'was 229/249/299.90 €' prices are a DGCCRF risk. They also damage trust and feed the 'arnaque' narrative in brand results.

**Google.** The risk sits in Gravipack's own data. Merchant listings and Merchant Center check that the price in your feed and structured data matches your landing page. Several prices for one model on gravipack.com, cached promo lists and stale struck prices invite mismatches. Price differences between different sellers do not cause disapprovals by themselves.

Effect on SEO: One live price per model, with real dated promotions marked up correctly, has three effects:
- product pages stay eligible for merchant listings and Shopping, with correct price and sale annotations;
- price-mismatch warnings are avoided;
- a recurring trigger for negative reviews that rank for brand queries goes away.
It does not change organic rankings directly.

Impact 5/10 · Effort Medium · Confidence likely
findings.recommendation: 1. **Fix gravipack.com first.** - Export all products (WooCommerce > Produits > Exporter) and set one regular price per model and colour. If colours really have different prices, say why on the page. - Find where the extra prices come from: duplicate product URLs (see the duplicate-products finding), stale promo pages or blocks with hard-coded prices, and page-cache copies. - Delete or update the promo lists, e.g. the one showing the Sherpa orange at 99 €. - Purge the cache after every price change. 2. **Run promotions only with WooCommerce scheduled sale prices** (Prix promo → « Planifier », with start and end dates), so the regular price comes back automatically. - Set the struck price to the lowest price of the previous 30 days (L112-1-1). - Display it, e.g. « Prix le plus bas des 30 derniers jours : 149,90 € ». Several WooCommerce 'Omnibus' price-history plugins can do this. - Remove any struck price that was never actually charged. 3. **Mark up sales the way Google's merchant-listing documentation now asks:** - the active price in `price`; - the reference price as a `priceSpecification` with `priceType` StrikethroughPrice; - the sale period with `validFrom`/`validThrough`; - not `priceValidUntil`. ```json "offers": { "@type": "Offer", "url": "https://www.gravipack.com/produit/sherpa-45/", "price": 129.00, "priceCurrency": "EUR", "availability": "https://schema.org/InStock", "validFrom": "2026-11-27T00:00:00+01:00", "validThrough": "2026-12-01T23:59:59+01:00", "priceSpecification": { "@type": "UnitPriceSpecification", "priceType": "https://schema.org/StrikethroughPrice", "price": 149.90, "priceCurrency": "EUR" } } ``` Check whether Yoast WooCommerce SEO or Rank Math outputs this; if not, extend their Product schema filter. In the Merchant Center feed, send `price` (regular price), `sale_price` and `sale_price_effective_date`. 4. **Align Gravipack's own Decathlon offers with the store** (Business Talk at 199 € vs 129 €). Decide with Kid'abord which account sells the Feather, so that offers at 149 € and 90 € no longer run side by side. 5. **Recommend prices to partners; never impose them.** Publish a prix de vente conseillé list and a shared promo calendar for Kid'abord and the resellers. Imposing minimum resale prices is prohibited: Code de commerce art. L442-6 since ordonnance 2019-359, and a hardcore restriction under Reg. (EU) 2022/720 art. 4(a). Get legal advice before adding any pricing clause. Remind partners that L112-1-1 applies to their struck prices too. 6. **Take a monthly price snapshot** of the official store, presta (until it is redirected), Decathlon (both sellers), Nature & Découvertes, Au Vieux Campeur, Fnac, Ergo-Corner, Kiabi and Bureau Vallée. Log each price with its date.

findings.title: #21 Model names, capacities, weights and warranty terms conflict across channels, and some specs are publicly disputed
findings.description:
The same bags are described with different names, capacities, weights, sizes and warranties across gravipack.com, the brand's other storefronts and retailers.

- **Hiking.**
  - Capacity: 33 L at Decathlon, Au Vieux Campeur, Équilibre, Fnac, Kiabi and on the legacy store ('Hiking33'); 30 L on gravipack.com ('Hiking 30L gris', 'Hiking Terracotta') and on one Fnac listing. A gravipack.com Hiking page whose URL says 30L has also been seen stating 33 L.
  - Weight: 900 g, 990 g or 1,200 g depending on the source.
- **Sherpa.**
  - Name: 'Sherpa 45' on presta, Decathlon, Au Vieux Campeur and Kiabi; 'Sherpa bleu', 'Sherpa orange 45L' and 'Sherpa Kaki' on gravipack.com; 'Sherpa 45L bleu/orange/kaki' at Ergo-Corner.
  - Weight: 1.2, 1.25 or 1.4 kg.
  - An Outzer reviewer estimates, without stating a method, that the Sherpa 45 holds about 30 L, and writes that it was 'conçu en Chine… contrairement à la publicité'. compostelle-autrement says the bags are designed in France and made in Portugal or China. The Outzer review ranks for 'gravipack sherpa avis'.
- **Feather.**
  - Laptop size: 14 inches on one listing, 15 inches on the brand page.
  - Weight: 780 g vs 890 g.
  - Size threshold between Feather and Feather Plus: '<1m50 et 30 kg' at Kiabi, '<1m55' elsewhere.
- **Pearl.** Bureau Vallée's title says '33 litres', but its URL says '29-litres'. Nature & Découvertes lists 'Pearl 29L'.
- **Oslo and Rome.**
  - Oslo: '60+10 L' and 2.9 kg on the official product page; '70 L' on other gravipack.com snippets, Ergo-Corner, i-trekkings and a rental listing (2.4 kg).
  - Rome: 1.6 kg vs 1.9 kg across gravipack.com pages.
- **Warranty.** '1 an' appears on the gravipack.com school category snippet, the official Sherpa Bleu listing, the Ergo-Corner Sherpa kaki page and the gravipack.ma bureautique category. '10 ans' appears in the KissKissBankBank FAQ, at Équilibre and on other brand pages.
- **Broken prices.** Kiabi's indexed titles show '0.00€' or 'nu€' for the Feather, Feather Plus, Sherpa 45 kaki, Pearl Gray and an unavailable Hiking 33.
- **Name changes.** Business Talk became Business Talk V4 (20 L, 25 L, 25 L EVA). gravipack.ma uses yet other names (Trek Air 25L, Summit Air 35L, Sherpa Peak 50L, Dublin).

**Covered elsewhere or not actionable:**
- Duplicate gravipack.com URLs are handled in the duplicate-products finding. The two G-Pack URLs may be two different products.
- Fnac's indexed URLs with junk parameters are Fnac's problem; Gravipack cannot fix them.
- Cdiscount's /r-gravipack.html internal search page appeared only in domain-filtered searches.

We could not check whether gravipack.com and marketplace listings carry GTINs.

Why it matters: Specs are what buyers compare and what reviewers test. When the 'Sherpa 45' is estimated at about 30 L, or the warranty is 1 year on one page and 10 years on another, the brand looks unreliable, returns increase, and the contradiction is what reviews and AI summaries repeat. Google's shopping systems and AI answer engines match products by brand, name and identifiers: GTIN first, with brand plus MPN as a fallback. Conflicting names and specs make it harder to tie all offers and reviews to one product.

Effect on SEO: One master data set with GTINs, pushed to every channel:
- improves offer matching in Google's Shopping Graph;
- reduces contradictory facts in AI answers;
- gives the official pages a specs table others can cite;
- removes the spec disputes that keep critical reviews relevant for 'gravipack <modèle> avis' queries.

Impact 5/10 · Effort Medium · Confidence confirmed
findings.recommendation: 1. **Build one product master sheet.** A shared Google Sheet is enough, with one row per model and variation. Columns: - official name, plus legacy and retailer names; - GTIN-13/EAN and MPN/SKU; - capacity in litres, measured with a stated, repeatable method (e.g. filled with small balls of known volume, with pockets listed separately); - weight with and without the exoskeleton, and dimensions; - laptop size; - user height and weight range, and the fitting tolerance (±10 cm / ±8 kg); - materials and origin wording; - warranty; - GPSR manufacturer. 2. **Settle the disputed values first.** Measure the Sherpa 45 and the Hiking. If the Sherpa holds less than 45 L, either rename it or state what the figure includes, e.g. « 45 L poches comprises, [x] L compartiment principal ». 3. **Use accurate origin wording on each product page**, e.g. « Conçu en France (exosquelette breveté), fabriqué au [pays] ». Write only what is true and documented. 4. **Use one warranty statement everywhere:** « Garantie Gravipack [X] ans sur l'exosquelette et les bretelles + garantie légale de conformité de 2 ans ». Fix the school category description, the Sherpa Bleu page and gravipack.ma first. 5. **Set up WooCommerce.** - Enter GTINs in the native « GTIN, UPC, EAN ou ISBN » field (Données produit > Inventaire, WooCommerce 9.2+, also per variation). - Make sure Yoast WooCommerce SEO or Rank Math and the feed plugin output it as `gtin13`. - Store capacity, weight and laptop size as global attributes (Produits > Attributs), so the same values feed the specs table, the schema and the feed. 6. **Push the sheet to every channel:** - Gravipack's own Decathlon listings, now; - Kid'abord, through the licence; - Ergo-Corner, Équilibre, Au Vieux Campeur, Nature & Découvertes and Fnac; - Bureau Vallée: correct the Pearl volume; - Kiabi: fix the 0.00 € offers or delist the discontinued items; - gravipack.ma. 7. **Publish the measured values and the method** in a specs table on each product page. Link to it in the reply to the Outzer review (see the reviews-SERP finding). 8. **Re-check every quarter** for the five best-selling models across the top channels.

findings.title: #26 Marketplace ratings are weak and split across legacy model names (Decathlon brand page 3.88/5, Feather noir 1.5/5, Fnac Road Adventure about 3/5)
findings.description:
Ratings on marketplaces are modest, few in number and attached to names gravipack.com no longer sells.

- **Decathlon.**
  - The brand page vc/gravipack averages 3.88/5 (16 ratings), and the collection page 4.1/5 (26).
  - Hiking 33: 4.13/5 (8). Buyers say the adjustment is hard and that the straps rub the neck when the bag is lightly loaded. One buyer got custom straps after contacting the brand, and one calls the promo price 'mensonger'.
  - Feather noir: 1.5/5. Feather Plus gris: 4.5/5, from very few reviews.
- **Fnac.**
  - Road Adventure Noir: about 3/5 from 8 reviews (finish, size).
  - Feather Plus: 1/5 from 1 review (strap discomfort). Safar Vibe: 5/5 from 1. Hiking 33 Gris: 1 review. Feather Bordeaux: 2 reviews.
  - Fnac review pages ranked #2 and #4 for 'gravipack avis' in the results we sampled.
- **Au Vieux Campeur.** Feather has 0 reviews. Hiking 33 has 1 review, positive on value but noting little back-panel padding.
- **Amazon.fr.** No listing was found in 2 searches.

**The names do not match the current range.** Hiking 33, Road Adventure, Safar Vibe and Feather do not match gravipack.com's current range (Hiking 30 L, Tokyo, Kingston, G-Pack), so a buyer cannot tie these reviews to products on the official site. Business Talk is the exception: it continues as V4.

**Gravipack can reply only on its own offers.** It can respond as the seller only on offers sold through its own Decathlon account (Business Talk, one Feather noir). Kid'abord sells the Sherpa 45, the Hiking 33 and most Feather offers, so replies there need the licensee's cooperation.

**Some first-party proof exists.** A /gravipackers/ testimonials page is indexed; it ranked #4 for 'gravipack' in one run.

**Covered elsewhere:**
- Whether product pages carry on-site reviews and AggregateRating is checked in the schema/Merchant Center finding.
- Trustpilot (3.1/5, 9 reviews) is covered in the review-SERP finding.

Why it matters: Marketplace ratings appear in marketplace search, in Google results for those listings and in AI shopping answers. A 1.5/5 or 3/5 on a discontinued SKU shapes opinion of the current range. Replies show prospects that problems get solved. The Hiking 33 complaints are about strap adjustment, and the brand already offers a fix for that (adjustment guide, custom straps).

Effect on SEO: The effects are indirect:
- Better ratings, with replies, improve click-through on marketplace and brand results and improve the sentiment AI answers summarise.
- Mapping legacy SKUs to current models lets the review history support the current products.
- On-site verified reviews, if displayed with AggregateRating, can earn review stars for gravipack.com product results.

Impact 4/10 · Effort Medium · Confidence confirmed
findings.recommendation: 1. **Reply where Gravipack is the seller** (Business Talk and Feather noir on its own Decathlon account), within a week and in French, with the fix. For strap rubbing, for example: « Merci pour votre retour. Les bretelles se règlent selon votre taille et votre poids : voici le guide pas à pas [lien vers /comment-regler-les-bretelles-exosquelette-de-mon-gravipack/]. Si le frottement persiste, écrivez-nous à [e-mail SAV] avec votre numéro de commande : nous ajustons ou échangeons les bretelles. » 2. **Agree in the licence who replies to reviews on Kid'abord listings, and how fast.** Use the same templates. Start with the Feather noir (1.5/5) and the 'prix mensonger' review, and also fix the promo practice behind it (see the price finding). 3. **Map legacy SKUs to current models** using the lineage page (see the model-SERP finding). Ask Fnac and Kiabi either to delist discontinued SKUs or to relist current models with GTINs, so new reviews land on current products. 4. **Collect on-site reviews from every buyer, without selection.** - In WooCommerce > Réglages > Produits, tick « Activer les avis produits », « Afficher le libellé 'propriétaire vérifié' sur les avis client » and « Les avis ne peuvent être laissés que par des 'propriétaires vérifiés' ». - Send one review request to every customer about 3 weeks after delivery. Do not tie any incentive to a positive rating. - If you use a provider (e.g. Avis Vérifiés/Skeepers or Trustpilot product reviews), choose one that can feed Google's Product Ratings and, where supported, syndicate to marketplaces. - State next to the reviews whether and how they are checked, as art. L111-7-2 C. conso. requires. 5. **Mark up only reviews that are visible on the page** with AggregateRating. Never mark up Google or Trustpilot ratings (see the schema finding). 6. **Ask satisfied B2B and repeat customers** (e.g. the people featured on /gravipackers/) to review the model they bought, on the channel where they bought it. 7. **Treat Amazon.fr (with Brand Registry) as a later business decision**, once names, data and prices are aligned.

findings.title: #39 A reseller's Gravipack brand page and Decathlon lead several generic 'anti mal de dos' results
findings.description:
**Ergo-Corner (extended mode).** The specialist reseller Ergo-Corner has a Gravipack brand page, ergo-corner.com/55-gravipack. In the extended-mode results we sampled (US-located, non-Google index), it ranks at or above gravipack.com for several generic 'anti mal de dos' queries:
- #1 for 'sac à dos ergonomique mal de dos', 'meilleur sac à dos anti mal de dos', 'sac à dos porte-outils anti mal de dos' and 'sac à dos tactique anti mal de dos';
- #2 for 'sac à dos anti mal de dos';
- #3 for 'sac à dos randonnée anti mal de dos' and #4 for 'sac à dos exosquelette'.
In total it appears in 7 of the 12 extended result sets, 6 of them 'mal de dos' queries. Ergo-Corner's editorial page /content/13-le-sac-a-dos-gravipack and a blog post also rank. For 'meilleur sac à dos anti mal de dos', Ergo-Corner holds #1 and #2 and the gravipack.com home page is #5.

**gravipack.com is still present** in the same sets: #4-#6 for 'sac à dos anti mal de dos', #2 for 'sac à dos ergonomique mal de dos', and #2 for the tactical query with the Austerlitz.

**Decathlon (standard mode).** decathlon.fr/vc/gravipack was:
- listed first for 'sac à dos anti mal de dos';
- also present for 'meilleur sac à dos pour le mal de dos' and 'sac à dos collège léger dos mal aux épaules ado';
- #1 even for a competitor-brand query ('Bodypack sac à dos ergonomique anti mal de dos marque').
In extended mode, Decathlon is absent for 'sac à dos anti mal de dos'. Its Hiking 33 listing does appear for 'sac à dos exosquelette'.

**These pages sell Gravipack products.** The clicks still go to Gravipack products, and an AI answer that cites them still names Gravipack. We did not measure whether AI assistants cite these pages rather than gravipack.com; that is an inference. The real cost is control of facts, price and margin.

**Their facts diverge from the official ones:**
- Decathlon titles say 'Allège la charge de 92%'.
- Ergo-Corner's Sherpa kaki page states a 1-year warranty (10 years elsewhere) and sells exoskeleton sizes M/L/XL/XXL.
- The Decathlon Sherpa 45 promotion (149.90 € instead of 249 €, 18/06-30/08/2026) has ended and is not a current price.

Why it matters: Resellers that rank for the category are useful distribution. But their pages become the version of Gravipack that shoppers and AI answer engines read first. If their claims, specs, warranty or prices differ from the official ones, those differences get repeated. The official pages also lose the chance to show the evidence and the fitting service that justify the price.

Effect on SEO: Aligned reseller content turns these slots into consistent support for the brand's facts, which helps entity consistency in AI answers. Where a reseller links to the official evidence and fitting pages, it also sends referral traffic and link signals to gravipack.com. It does not directly move gravipack.com rankings; that comes from the category-hub work.

Impact 3/10 · Effort Low · Confidence likely
findings.recommendation: 1. **Treat Ergo-Corner and the Decathlon brand page as partners.** Send them the brand content kit: the master product sheet (measured specs, one warranty term), approved claim wording that matches the evidence page, current model names and images. 2. **Ask Ergo-Corner for links.** Ask for links from /55-gravipack and /content/13 to the official evidence page and to the fitting guide (/comment-regler-les-bretelles-exosquelette-de-mon-gravipack/), e.g. « Voir l'étude et les mesures sur le site officiel Gravipack ». Specialist resellers usually accept this. Decathlon marketplace pages generally do not allow outbound links, so on vc/gravipack only align the text. 3. **Correct the Ergo-Corner Sherpa kaki page:** replace the 1-year warranty with the official term, and fix any old prices or model names. 4. **Remove or substantiate 'Allège la charge de 92%' in Decathlon titles.** Change Gravipack's own listings now, and Kid'abord's listings through the licence. The wording itself is owned by the health-claims finding. 5. **Keep the richest content on gravipack.com.** Do not give resellers the gravipack.com product copy. Give them a shorter, different description. Keep the measured spec table, the fitting by height and weight, videos, evidence and FAQ on gravipack.com. 6. **Strengthen gravipack.com's own pages where Ergo-Corner leads:** the existing 'tous les sacs' category for 'sac à dos anti mal de dos', and the outillage and tactique categories. This is covered by the cannibalisation and category findings. 7. **Measure branded share separately.** For the 12 head queries, track 'Gravipack-branded share' (official plus reseller URLs) separately from 'official share'. Each quarter, ask ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Mode « meilleur sac à dos anti mal de dos ». Note which URLs they cite and whether the facts they quote match the master sheet.

findings.title: #24 The likely Google Business Profile and local citations still show the old Vincennes address, while the registered seat is now in Paris
findings.description:
Gravipack's local listings still show an address the company has left. The listing that probably matters most, a Google Business Profile carrying about 1,000 reviews, has not been found or audited.

**1. The registered seat has moved.** Registry data (annuaire-entreprises, societe.com, verif.com) put EXOSQUELETTE LIGHT SAS at 10 rue de la Paix, 75002 Paris since 19/05/2026 (siège SIRET 840 543 383 00045). This company (SIREN 840 543 383, previously named GRAVIBAG and then GRAVIPACK SAS) owns the Gravipack brand. The previous seat, from the end of 2022, was 46 rue de la Bienfaisance, 94300 Vincennes. We could not verify whether the Paris address is a domiciliation (an address with no customer reception).

**2. Directory citations still point to Vincennes, under the wrong category.**
- PagesJaunes pros/60790927: 'Gravipack à Vincennes – Maroquinerie', 0 reviews; the page was about 670 days old when sampled.
- PagesJaunes pros/62263007: a second ID surfaced in a registry-filtered search. It is probably a duplicate listing.
- Mappy POI 605d2e7de32c7c1ed765382d: 'Gravipack – Maroquinerie, 46 r Bienfaisance, 94300 Vincennes'.
- 'Maroquinerie' (leather goods) is the wrong category for a maker of exoskeleton backpacks.
- Other surfaces still showed Vincennes in the search results we sampled: rubypayeur ('Société EXOSQUELETTE LIGHT à VINCENNES'), the motherbase.ai startup profile and the LinkedIn company page. The site's own contact pages, /contacts/ and /contact-gravipack/, showed 46 rue de la Bienfaisance in phase-1 search snippets (verify on-site). The mentions légales and CGV name EXOSQUELETTE LIGHT, Paris. The contact page gives a mobile number and contact@gravipack.com. Two contact URLs therefore carry the NAP.

**3. A Google Business Profile very probably exists, but we did not find it.** Two searches ('Gravipack Vincennes adresse téléphone' and 'Gravipack Vincennes avis Google My Business 998 avis') returned no Google Maps URL, and the search tool cannot see Maps or knowledge panels. Four other signals point to a profile:
- An aggregator page (groupe-ranque.fr/gravipack/, titled 'Gravipack – Vincennes – Sécurité et Stockage Blindé') reports '4.7/5 pour 998 avis sur Google My Business'.
- A third-party blog (compostelle-autrement.com) reports '4,8/5 sur Google avec déjà plus de 900 avis'.
- gravipack.com product pages show a '4,7' Google rating with 'plus de 1121 avis' (Hiking) and 'plus de 1126 avis' (Kingston), and the 'Avis Google des clients Gravipack' page shows 'plus de 1175 avis'.
- The sequence 900+ → 998 → 1,121–1,175 fits a live profile that is still gaining reviews.

The corroboration is weak. Phase 1 treated the aggregator as a homonym because of its odd category title, and the blog may simply repeat the brand's own figures. The earlier statement 'no GBP signal surfaced' is therefore corrected to: a GBP likely exists, unverified, and most likely still shows Vincennes.

**4. The risk.** A Google Business Profile is only eligible if staff meet customers in person at the address during stated hours, or if the business serves customers at their own locations (a service-area business). Online-only businesses, virtual offices and mail-drop addresses are not eligible. The evidence describes an online-first seller:
- Sales go through gravipack.com and marketplaces. On the marketplaces, Kid'abord, a separate company, acts as licensee and marketplace seller.
- Returns go to a logistics warehouse in Colmar.
- We found no showroom, and a 2020 forum post says the bags were sold only through the website.

Changing the profile's address to the Paris seat normally triggers re-verification. If the Paris address is a domiciliation, or no staffed premises exist, the profile could be suspended. Suspension would remove about 1,000+ Google reviews from Maps and the brand's knowledge panel. It would also leave the '4,7 Google' figure, the main trust figure the site displays, with no public source. Leaving the profile untouched is not safe either: it keeps sending people to an address Gravipack may no longer use.

Why it matters: Gravipack sells mainly online, so ranking in the local pack is worth little. A probable Google Business Profile with about 1,000 reviews is a different matter. It is the source of the '4,7 Google / plus de 1 100 avis' figure shown on product pages, and those reviews appear in Maps and in the brand knowledge panel. As it probably stands (old Vincennes address, an online-only business behind it), the profile is exposed to a policy suspension. The address change will force re-verification, which makes that more likely. Losing the profile would erase the brand's largest review base, which cannot be rebuilt quickly. Separately, out-of-date NAP on PagesJaunes, Mappy, Bing and LinkedIn contradicts the registry. That weakens the entity data search engines and AI assistants use to describe the company. Bing Places data, for example, feeds Bing Maps, Copilot and ChatGPT search. The wrong 'Maroquinerie' category also mislabels the business.

Effect on SEO: There are three mechanisms.
- **Entity reconciliation.** Google, Bing and AI answer engines cross-check name, address and phone across the registry, the site and directories. Conflicting Vincennes and Paris data lowers confidence in knowledge-panel and AI-answer facts and can surface a wrong address.
- **GBP trust surface.** A verified, eligible profile keeps the review count and rating visible on Maps and in brand searches, which supports CTR and conversion. A suspended profile drops out of Maps and the knowledge panel, and its reviews disappear from public view.
- **Category relevance.** 'Maroquinerie' puts the business in the wrong local and directory classification.

On the website, aligned NAP (contact page, mentions légales, Organization JSON-LD) supports entity consistency. GBP reviews must never be marked up as Product aggregateRating.

Impact 4/10 · Effort Medium · Confidence likely
findings.recommendation: **Phase A: locate and secure the GBP (week 1, before any other change).** 1. Find the profile. In Google Maps, logged out and from France, search 'Gravipack', 'Gravipack Vincennes' and 'Gravipack Paris'. A faster route is the WordPress plugin that renders the '4,7 Google' widget (for example Trustindex, Widgets for Google Reviews, Elfsight or a custom block): its settings hold the Place ID, which starts with `ChIJ`. You can also view the source of a product page and search for `ChIJ` or `place_id`. Then open `https://www.google.com/maps/place/?q=place_id:ChIJ…`. 2. Check who owns it. Sign in to business.google.com with every account that might hold it: contact@, the President's account, and any former agency or freelancer. If nobody does, use « Vous êtes propriétaire de cet établissement ? » and request access. If the current owner does not respond, Google usually offers to let you verify after about a week. Make a company-controlled Google account the primary owner, not a personal or agency account. 3. Record a baseline before editing anything: Place ID, CID, name, primary and secondary categories, address, phone, website URL, rating and exact review count, plus screenshots. Archive the reviews through the Business Profile API reviews endpoint or a review-monitoring tool. **Phase B: decide eligibility. This decision drives every later step.** 4. Pick one model and document it in the entity master fact sheet. - **(a) Staffed location.** A real place (atelier, showroom or click-and-collect point) with signage, where staff meet customers during posted hours. This can be Vincennes if it is still in use, or a Paris showroom. Keep the address visible and set opening hours. - **(b) Service-area business.** Use this only if staff genuinely travel to customers, for example on-site fittings and demonstrations for employers and CSE days, or B2B deployments of the kind done with RATP. Hide the address (Infos → Adresse → supprimer l'adresse) and add service areas (Paris, Hauts-de-Seine, Val-de-Marne…; maximum 20). - **(c) Neither.** The business is online-only and not eligible. Do **not** move the profile to 10 rue de la Paix if that address is a domiciliation or virtual office; that is the most likely route to suspension. Leave the profile as it is, accept the risk knowingly, and stop relying on it as the site's main trust figure. Build Trustpilot, marketplace and on-site product reviews instead (see the review findings). 5. Never create a new profile for the Paris seat. A new profile starts at 0 reviews and creates a duplicate. Edit the address on the existing profile so the reviews move with it. Prepare for re-verification first (usually a video showing signage, premises, stock or tools, and a business document such as the Kbis), and align the website (Phase E) at the same time, because Google compares the two. **Phase C: update the profile.** 6. Set the fields: - **Name:** exactly `Gravipack`. Do not add keywords such as 'sac à dos anti mal de dos'; keyword-stuffed names are a common cause of suspension. - **Primary category:** replace 'Maroquinerie' with the closest option in the picker for what actually happens at the location. That is a bag/luggage store or sporting-goods store category for a showroom, or a manufacturer category for an atelier. - **Website:** the canonical host's homepage, with `?utm_source=google&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=gbp`. - **Phone:** the same company number shown on the site and PagesJaunes. - **Description:** at most 750 characters, with no health claims or unverifiable claims. For example: « Gravipack conçoit et vend des sacs à dos équipés d'un exosquelette qui reporte une partie de la charge des épaules vers les hanches : modèles randonnée, urbains, ordinateur et scolaires. [Showroom : essayez les sacs sur place et retirez vos commandes passées sur gravipack.com.] Service client : contact@gravipack.com. Gravipack® est une marque d'EXOSQUELETTE LIGHT SAS. » 7. Reply to recent reviews, starting with the negative ones. After the edit, check the profile weekly for « modification en attente » or a suspension notice. If it is suspended, fix the eligibility problem first, then appeal with evidence (Kbis, lease, photos of the signage). **Phase D: clean up citations (identical NAP, character for character).** 8. Write one NAP reference line: `Gravipack (EXOSQUELETTE LIGHT SAS) – [adresse publique retenue ou « vente en ligne, pas d'accueil du public »] – [téléphone] – contact@gravipack.com – https://[hôte canonique]/`. 9. PagesJaunes: - Claim pros/60790927 through the free PagesJaunes pro space (« Vous êtes ce professionnel ? »). - Update the address, website and description, and replace the 'Maroquinerie' activity with suitable rubriques (for example articles de sport, sacs/bagages). - Open pros/62263007. If it is the same business, ask PagesJaunes customer service to merge or delete it as a « fiche en doublon ». - If there are no public premises, ask PagesJaunes to remove the street address or close the listing rather than keep showing Vincennes. 10. Mappy: re-check POI 605d2e7de32c7c1ed765382d about 6 weeks after the PagesJaunes change. If it still shows the old data, submit a correction through the POI's report/modify link. 11. Bing Places: claim the listing and import it from Google Business Profile so Bing, Copilot and ChatGPT search get the same data. Apple Business Connect: claim a place card only under model (a) or (b). 12. Ask motherbase.ai to update its profile and update the LinkedIn company HQ. Registry mirrors (societe.com, pappers, rubypayeur) refresh from the RNE on their own; just re-check them in 1–2 months. **Phase E: align the WordPress/WooCommerce site.** 13. Keep a single contact page and 301 the other one, either with the Redirection plugin or in .htaccess: `Redirect 301 /contacts/ https://[hôte canonique]/contact-gravipack/`. On the contact page, give the same NAP as the GBP and PagesJaunes. Under model (a), add the address, opening hours and a lazy-loaded map. Under model (c), say so plainly, for example: « Gravipack est une marque d'EXOSQUELETTE LIGHT SAS – siège social : 10 rue de la Paix, 75002 Paris (adresse administrative, pas d'accueil du public). Service client : contact@gravipack.com, du lundi au vendredi. Retours : voir notre page Retours. » 14. Update the remaining on-site copies of the address: - WooCommerce → Réglages → Général → Adresse de la boutique (used in emails and the tax base). - The shop address in any invoice plugin. - The footer widget, mentions légales and CGV. 15. Schema: keep one site-wide Organization node, merged with the node from the entity finding. With Rank Math, use the Local SEO module (Titres & méta → Local SEO). With Yoast, set Site representation, and add the address with Yoast Local SEO or the `wpseo_schema_organization` filter. The node should carry the seat address and, once known, the Maps CID in sameAs: ```json {"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Organization","@id":"https://[hôte canonique]/#organization","name":"Gravipack","legalName":"EXOSQUELETTE LIGHT","url":"https://[hôte canonique]/","address":{"@type":"PostalAddress","streetAddress":"10 rue de la Paix","postalCode":"75002","addressLocality":"Paris","addressCountry":"FR"},"contactPoint":{"@type":"ContactPoint","contactType":"customer service","email":"contact@gravipack.com","telephone":"+33-[numéro]","areaServed":"FR","availableLanguage":"fr"},"sameAs":["https://maps.google.com/?cid=[CID]","https://www.pagesjaunes.fr/pros/60790927"]} ``` Under model (a) only, add a `Store` node on the showroom page. Give it `parentOrganization` {"@id":"https://[hôte canonique]/#organization"}, the showroom's own address, `openingHoursSpecification` and `hasMap`. Never output the GBP rating as Product `aggregateRating`. If Phase A shows that no GBP exists, downgrade this finding to Low. In that case do Phases D and E only, and do not create a profile unless model (a) or (b) is genuinely true.
